result.description: Fires on the word piece 'yn' inside multi-token words such as nucleos-yn-thesis, photos-yn-thesis, pol-yn-omial and Ke-yn-esian. It mostly predicts 'thesis' next.
result.label: 'yn' piece in nucleosynthesis

result.description: Fires on the verb "lies" (also " rely") in "relies" where a subject depends on something, typically just before "on/heavily on". Weaker on similar "X on" verbs like capitalize/focuses.
result.label: "relies" before "on"

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' (also 'astic') inside words like acidic, elicit, elastic, in chemistry/acid-base and economics-style text. It is silent on 'ic' in other words such as phenolic or monoprotic.
result.label: 'ic' suffix in acidic/elastic words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ular' completing "cardiovascular" (as in cardiovascular system). It stays silent on 'ular' in "cellular" and at the start of a document, so it needs the cardiovasc- prefix.
result.label: cardiovasc-'ular' word ending

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'ot' and 'u' inside abstract philosophical/linguistic terms (den-ot-ation, individ-u-ation), where a suffix such as -ation is expected next. Silent on 'ot' in other words like negotiation or stereotypes.
result.label: Mid-word 'ot'/'u' in academic terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ir" at the start of "irony" (situational irony, verbal irony), as a split-word fragment. Members detect " ir" and similar word-start pieces like irrigation and par(adox). Weak firing on "primary".
result.label: " ir" piece in "irony"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " mascul" (masculine/masculinity) in gender-studies style text, and weakly on " side" and a few name fragments. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: " mascul" in masculine/masculinity

result.description: Fires on 'expand' and the 'ing' ending of expanding/broadening-type verbs (expand, expanding, broadening), especially where the verb takes an object like scope, reach or territory. Silent on 'ing' in unrelated words like mining or spurring.
result.label: expand / expanding verb forms

result.description: Fires on the word " there" in many uses: existential "there is/are", "out there", "over there", "thereof". Members are mostly detectors of " there" at earlier layers. Weakly predicts words like "after".
result.label: the word " there"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'oid' ending scientific terms like solenoids, toroids, geoid, steroid, paraboloid. Members are mostly 'oid' detectors; weak firing on ' am' in amines and 'igen' in antigen.
result.label: 'oid' suffix in science terms
' ess' word-piece in essence/essay
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ess' when it begins a word like "essence" or "essay", usually after "the". Silent when ' ess' is at document start with no preceding context. Predicts continuations such as "entials" or "ence".

Fires on " art" and " music" (also "arts") in historical/Renaissance-era cultural passages, especially where "art" begins a word like "artistic" or is a modifier. It stays silent on "art" as a plain standalone noun in other phrasing.
result.label: art/music in Renaissance cultural history

result.description: Fires on word pieces that begin an art/culture "-ism" or "-ist" term: "ge" in zeitgeist, " Cub" in Cubism, " Symbol" in symbolism. Context is art movements and cultural analysis; upstream members are art-name and word-start detectors.
result.label: Art-movement word stems (Cub, zeitge)

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after the prefix "anti" (anti-inflammatory, anti-CTLA, anti-particles), and weakly on other split pieces of "anti". It stays silent on hyphens after other words like self-, far-, life-.
result.label: Hyphen after "anti" prefix

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ep' completing the word "creep" (material deformation under stress) in engineering text. Members are mostly 'ep' token detectors plus some mechanical-engineering context members.
result.label: 'ep' in "creep" (materials)

result.description: Fires on verbs and prepositions like "develop/developing", "towards", "improve", and "and" in policy or public-health text, where a policy-related object comes next (policy, education, strategy). Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Policy-directed verbs and 'towards'

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ther' inside a longer word, mainly in "Panthera" and also "Ethernet". Members are detectors of 'ther' and of word-initial pieces like 'pan', 'E' and 'A-mp'.
result.label: 'ther' inside Panthera/Ethernet

result.description: Fires on "estimation" and "-ators" (estimators) in statistics text about point and interval estimation, after a word like point, interval, or unbiased. It is weaker on cost estimation and linear regression.
result.label: Statistical estimation / estimators

result.description: Fires on the token right after "audio" (encoding, Com-, Sign-, dec-, hyphen, signal), where a technical audio term is being continued. Silent on hyphens after other words such as Real- or Single-. Pushes toward video/visual/compression-type words.
result.label: Token following "audio" compound

result.description: Fires on the token ' ions' (plural of ion) in chemistry text about charged atoms, cations/anions and ionic bonding. Silent on nearby chemistry words like 'ionic' in the contrast. Members include ion-token detectors and chemistry context features.
result.label: chemistry 'ions' token

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' prepar' and ' veget' (preparing, preparation, vegetables) in cooking text, where the next piece is likely a suffix like -ation. Silent on 'prepare food' in the contrast.
result.label: prepar-/veget- stems in cooking

result.description: Fires on the token " instrument" (and the piece "ast"), including as a stem in instrumental/instrumentation. Members are mostly detectors of "instrument" and similar words such as tools. Predicts suffixes like -al and -ation.
result.label: ' instrument' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'a' piece inside "Versailles" (Vers|a|illes), mainly in "Treaty of Versailles". It stays silent on 'a' in other words or as the article, and the logits favor the continuation "illes".
result.label: 'a' in Treaty of Versailles

result.description: Fires on ' before' ending a comparative "than ever before" phrase, meaning previously. Weak on other "before"/earlier-time uses. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: "than ever before" – before

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'omed' in "Biomedical" (mostly at document start in course/field lists) and on 'ial' suffixes in words like factorial or adverbial. It seems to detect unfinished word fragments rather than a topic.
result.label: Word fragments: 'omed' and 'ial'

result.description: Fires on the noun completing an "In the fast-paced/dynamic ... world/realm/environment of" opening, right after stacked adjectives near document start. It stays quiet on "world" in other phrases, such as "the business world".
result.label: "In the dynamic world of" opener

result.description: Fires on commas inside a long list of single abstract nouns (e.g. "humility, gratitude, awareness"), mainly after the third or later item. It stays quiet on commas after longer phrases or in adjective lists.
result.label: Comma in lists of bare nouns

result.description: Fires on the word " alongside" after a noun phrase, where a coordinate item follows (e.g. "creativity alongside academic pursuits"). It pushes toward next words like "traditional", "those", "other", "existing". Members detect "alongside"/"with"/"against" style tokens.
result.label: ' alongside' connecting parallel items

result.description: Fires on the word " means", both as a noun ("by means of", "a means of") and as a verb ("X means increased demand"). Members are mostly detectors of " means" itself. Next-token logits are unclear.
result.label: ' means' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' proportion' (also ' combination', ' ratio') as a noun or word start, mostly in art, design and cooking text about balance and ratios. Members are proportion detectors plus art/design topic latents.
result.label: proportion / combination ratio words

result.description: Fires on mid-word suffix pieces like 'ular', 'abol', '-ative' in biology/biochemistry words (cellular, metabolic, neurodegenerative). Silent on 'ular' in cardiovascular, so it seems to need a cell/metabolism context.
result.label: Cell/metabolism word-piece suffixes

result.description: Fires on the word " when" introducing a subordinate clause after a main clause (e.g. "minimal storage space when compared", "professionalism when capitalizing"). Silent on "whenever". Members are mostly " when" detectors.
result.label: Subordinating " when" after clause

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ology' (also 'ics') ending a short science-field heading, most strongly in physiology titles like "Molecular physiology." in lists of academic topics. Stays silent on 'ology' in running text or other fields like ethnomusicology and dialectology.
result.label: Science field-name suffix 'ology'/'ics'

result.description: Fires on plural suffix pieces (-es, -ms, -ants, -ations, -iders) ending business/company nouns like franchises, firms, giants, corporations, in economic or business text. Predicts verbs like began, started, expanded.
result.label: Plural company-noun endings in business text

result.description: Fires on ' time' when it follows "a" and means an era or period, as in "In a time when/of...". It stays silent on "over time", "timeframes", "beyond time" and sentence-initial "time".
result.label: "a time" meaning an era

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' precip' (precipitate, precipitation, precipitated), a split-word fragment that expects a continuation like 'itate'/'itation'. Members are mostly ' precip' detectors across early layers.
result.label: ' precip' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' Korea', especially after 'North' or 'South' or in lists of Asian and world countries in geopolitical or historical text. Members are detectors of other country, region and Asia tokens.
result.label: ' Korea' in country lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mon' (also ' Orth') at the start of a longer word such as monastic, monk, monism or monopoly. It predicts word continuations like 'archy', 'opol' and 'odox'. It is quiet on text without such a word start.
result.label: ' mon' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on abstract head nouns like "form", "representation", "model", "entity" after an adjective or article (a dense representation, a whole new entity, a model to represent). Silent on "form" as a word piece (formulates) or in "language form".
result.label: Abstract head nouns: representation/model/form

result.description: Fires on linear-algebra nouns like " transformation", " matrix", " vector", especially right after "linear" or "orthogonal", in math text about vector spaces. Members detect transform/transformation tokens plus math-operation context.
result.label: Linear algebra transformation/matrix nouns

result.description: Fires on a digit, mostly '1', that begins a number in a heading or section numbering (e.g. "## 1", "### 1.", "2.1") or a matrix entry at the start of a line. It stays silent on '1' inside years or larger numbers in running prose.
result.label: Leading digit in section numbering

result.description: Fires on ' of' right after a quantity or measure noun (percentage, ratio, volume, proportion, quantity) in scientific or technical definitions. It stays silent after general nouns like property, study, law or accuracy.
result.label: ' of' after measure nouns

result.description: Fires on ordinal/onset words like " first", " early", " initial" when they come without a preceding "the" (e.g. at the start of a phrase). It stays silent on "the first ...", so it needs a particular construction slot.
result.label: first/early/initial without "the"

result.description: Fires on the word " curve" (also "curves"), mostly in calculus or math text about tangent lines, slopes and concavity. Members are mainly detectors of "curve" plus math-context features.
result.label: ' curve' in math contexts

result.description: Fires on the adverb " closely" (e.g. "closely related", "closely followed", "closely track"), weakly on other -ly adverb endings. Members detect "closely"/"close" and -ly suffixes. Logits favour participles like "tied", "linked".
result.label: Adverb "closely"

result.description: Fires on ' into' right after "insight(s)" (e.g. "valuable insights into"). It stays silent on physical-transformation "into", such as "deformed into".
result.label: ' into' after insight(s)

result.description: Fires on the word " based" when it follows a noun or verb phrase and introduces "based on" (e.g. "predict an outcome based on"). Members are mostly detectors of "based" and related "depending/depend" tokens.
result.label: " based" in "based on"

result.description: Fires on the noun completing a "social/type of X" phrase, mostly ' protection', also ' benefits', ' benefit' and ' advantage'. It follows a modifier such as social, differential or economic. Members detect protection, defense, assistance and welfare words.
result.label: protection/benefit noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after the word-piece "amples" (as in "examples of"), where the next word is a specific kind of thing. It stays silent on " of" in other noun-of-noun phrases such as "process of" or "use of".
result.label: ' of' after 'amples'

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "war" + suffix (warfare, warming, warmer, warms) and occasionally on repeated " war". It needs the preceding token "war" as a separate piece; silent elsewhere.
result.label: Suffix piece after "war"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'antic' in "Romantic" (Rom|antic), especially in text about the Romantic era or Romanticism. It is silent on some other "Romantic" cases in similar contexts, so the exact condition is unclear.
result.label: 'antic' in Romantic

result.description: Fires on the final piece "ure" in "obscure" used as a verb ("can obscure X"), after the "obsc" piece. It stays silent on "ure" in other words such as "pressure". Weaker on "obscurity".
result.label: "ure" completing "obscure"

result.description: Fires on the surname-initial or surname start (' B', ' Buff') right after the first name "Susan", as in "Susan B. Anthony". It stays silent on ' B' after other names like Albert B(ierstadt).
result.label: Susan B. Anthony surname start

result.description: Fires on the word right after "network" (performance, optimization, failures, quality, infrastructure) in computer-network text. It stays silent on "performance" after other words like "optimal" or "its". Members mostly detect "network" tokens.
result.label: Noun after "network" (performance)

result.description: Fires on ' in' or ' of' right after the noun phrase following "The significance" (e.g. "The significance of X in the..."). Silent on ' in' in other contexts, such as after "role" or "decline", so it needs the "significance of ..." frame.
result.label: "in/of" after "significance" phrase

result.description: Fires on the capital 'D' starting the abbreviation in parentheses after "Discounted Cash Flow" ("(DCF)"), in finance text. It also weakly fires on 'D' in other acronyms like DfD. Members include finance-topic latents.
result.label: D of (DCF) acronym

result.description: Fires on the token right after "albeit" (the "beit" piece, or a following comma or "without"/"with") in a concession phrase like "albeit limited,". Silent on ordinary commas elsewhere.
result.label: Tokens following "albeit" concession

result.description: Fires on the demonstrative " this" (also "these") before a noun, mostly in abstract technical prose about methods, techniques or strategies. It is silent after "of this" in some contexts, such as "of this theory/type".
result.label: demonstrative " this" before abstract noun

result.description: Fires on the 'pression' piece in "Great Depression" (and the following ' of'), relying on a preceding "Great De". Silent on 'pression' in lowercase "depression" or other contexts, so it needs the capitalized historical-event name.
result.label: Great Depression 'pression' piece

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ences' when it completes the word "preferences" (prefer + ences), mostly in economics or consumer text. It stays silent on 'ences' in "influences".
result.label: 'ences' ending "preferences"

result.description: Fires on " the" (occasionally " roughly") directly after "After" at the very start of a document, as in "After the war". The same word elsewhere in a text, after other verbs or prepositions, stays silent.
result.label: "the" after opening "After"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ively' (mostly after "collect-", i.e. "collectively") and other adverb endings mid-sentence. Members detect "collect"/"-ive" pieces. It is silent when 'ively' starts a text with no preceding stem.
result.label: 'collect-ively' adverb suffix

result.description: Fires on 'iding' in "Avoiding" at the start of a document or heading (after the "Avo" piece). It stays silent when the same word appears mid-sentence in running text. Weak activity on ' common' and a few other tokens.
result.label: "Avoiding" at document start

result.description: Fires on verbs meaning "take place" (happen, happens, occur, occurred), especially after a subject like "what" or "events" in abstract, explanatory text. Members detect happen/occur tokens in earlier layers.
result.label: happen/occur verbs

result.description: Fires on the animal-group noun (insects' final 's', birds, fish, animals) in biology lists comparing animal groups. It stays silent on plural 's' in non-animal words like ecosystems, contexts or 1800s.
result.label: Animal group nouns in biology lists

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'eries' completing "galleries" (gall|eries), most strongly in art and museum contexts. It is much weaker in "worldwide" and silent on other words in the exhibition passage. Members detect 'eries' and art/collection words.
result.label: 'eries' in galleries

result.description: Fires on the word right after "seem/seems" (mostly " like", also " seem", " to", " at"), as in "may seem like a trivial topic". Silent on " like" after "sound" or "something". Members detect "seem"/"seemingly".
result.label: word after "seem" (seem like)

result.description: Fires on tokens right after the name "Petrarch" (the suffix "an", then ",", " who", " an", " and") in Renaissance/humanist text. It stays silent on " and" in ordinary lists of names or concepts.
result.label: Token following Petrarch

result.description: Fires on the word right after a hedging modal like "may" or "might" (e.g. involve, seem, be, indicate, not). Members detect "may" and similar modals. The one silent case follows "would", not "may".
result.label: Verb after hedging modal "may"

result.description: Fires on ' up' right after a finite form of "opened/opens" (e.g. "has opened up new opportunities"). It stays silent on "opening up". Members detect open/opens plus "doors/opportunities" contexts.
result.label: "up" after "opened"

result.description: Fires on word pieces or suffixes (mostly 'ing', also ' flav', 's', ' is') directly following the word "contrast"/"contrasting". It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs like "maintaining" without contrast nearby.
result.label: Suffix after 'contrast' word

result.description: Fires on the word "cut" and the suffix pieces right after it (cut+s, cut+ter, cut+ters, cut+out, "cut is") in food and craft text, such as cuts of meat, julienne cut or pastry cutters. The contrast text without "cut" stays silent.
result.label: Suffix after "cut" (cuts, cutter)

result.description: Fires on word pieces that continue a word beginning with the prefix "over" (overconfidence, overabundance, overwhelming, overpowering, overfishing), at the piece right after "over". It is silent in text without such a prefix.
result.label: Word pieces after "over" prefix

result.description: Fires on ' to' in the idiom "When it comes to", at the start of a sentence introducing a topic. It stays silent on other uses of ' to', such as infinitive 'to' or 'to' after nouns and verbs.
result.label: "When it comes to" ' to'

result.description: Fires on " of" right after "analysis" (or similar nouns like determination, study) at the start of a document, in "The analysis of X". Silent on "of" after "analysis" mid-document or after other nouns like "aspect" or "difficulty".
result.label: "of" after analysis, document-initial

result.description: Fires on word pieces following an initial "r" in words starting with r (ripple, rhetoric, ruthless, ratios, rulers, righteous). Members detect the " r" token and the word-start pieces.
result.label: Word pieces after initial r-

result.description: Fires on the word after or within a "careful" phrase (selection, manipulation, preparation, consideration, attention, "and"), i.e. the noun slot following "careful". Silent on "careful" at the start of a document.
result.label: Noun following "careful"

result.description: Fires on ' for' right after "account/accounts/accounting" (also "accountable for"), in the sense of "account for". It stays silent on other uses of ' for' such as "scaffolding for" or "allows for".
result.label: 'for' after account(ing)

result.description: Fires on the word right after "experimenting/experimentation" (' with', ' different', ' various', hyphen), where the object of experimenting comes next. Silent on ' with' after other verbs like "infused with" or "resonates with".
result.label: Word after "experimenting"

result.description: Fires on " Rights" (and "Mov" of "Movement") right after "Civil" in "Civil Rights Act/Movement". It stays silent on "Rights" in "Bill of Rights", so it needs the preceding "Civil".
result.label: Civil Rights (Movement) after "Civil"

result.description: Fires on function words (on, over, with, in) and word pieces shortly after "tend/tends to" in generalizing statements about groups or tendencies. Members detect "tend/tends" tokens; the target is silent on "on" in fixed phrases like "on the other hand".
result.label: Function words after "tend to" generalizations

result.description: Fires on the word "writing"/"Writing", mostly in "Creative Writing" and similar workshop or course text. It stays quiet on some other "Writing" tokens, such as in a different narrative context or at a document start, so the context matters.
result.label: Creative Writing token

result.description: Fires on the first word or piece after a document-initial "While" (e.g. Brønsted, Cost, Agile), or on "While" itself, at the start of a title-like heading. Silent when "While" follows earlier text. Members detect document-start "While" and list-heading structure.
result.label: Document-initial "While" and following title word

result.description: Fires on the word right after "consumer" (behavior, preferences, spending, choice, confidence) in economics text. It stays quiet on "behavior" after other words like "human" or "data and". Members detect "consumer" and its pieces.
result.label: Word following "consumer"

result.description: Fires mostly on ' understanding' (and some other tokens like ' or', ' of', 'ic') following "deep" or similar academic phrasing, often before "of". It is silent on some "deep understanding" cases, so the condition is unclear.
result.label: Deep understanding (of) in academic text

result.description: Fires on the 'H' (or 'EM') of the abbreviation "(EMH)" right after "Efficient Market Hypothesis" is spelled out. Silent on 'H' elsewhere, such as a bare "H" or a later "EMH" mention. Members carry finance/economics and "Hypothesis" context.
result.label: EMH abbreviation after Efficient Market Hypothesis

result.description: Fires on the word "air" (and Air) in atmospheric, weather or air-pollution text, plus nearby tokens like "and" or "at" right after air. Members detect "air" and air- compounds (airport, airline, airborne) and cloud/atmosphere words.
result.label: "air" in atmosphere/weather text

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "Jurassic" (Jur-, -ass, -ic, -ical) and nearby tokens in lists of geological periods like Triassic/Jurassic/Cretaceous. Silent on other "-ic" endings like Mesozoic or atmospheric.
result.label: Jurassic word pieces in period lists
'met' in -metry analytical techniques
result.description: Fires on the piece 'met' (also 'ry', 'metric') inside words ending in -metry, most strongly in voltammetry in lists of electrochemical or analytical techniques. Silent on 'metering'.
Fires on the quantity word (" much", " little", also " far") directly after "too", as in "too much flour" or "too little". It stays silent on "much" in other uses like "much higher" or "as much".
result.label: quantity word after "too"

result.description: Fires on the name pieces of "Eugène" (ène, Eug) and the following token such as " Charles" in a full name like Eugène Charles Catalan; weaker on Eugene Stoermer/Odum. Silent on generic text.
result.label: Eugène name pieces

result.description: Fires on words right after the 'fs' token (from "chefs") in culinary text, e.g. ' are', ' must', ' can', ' sous'. It is quiet on the same verbs in other food-industry contexts, so it needs a chef-plural subject.
result.label: Verbs following 'chefs' (fs)

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'al' when it completes capitalized "Transactional" (Transaction|al Leadership/Analysis/Model), after a "Trans-" word start. Stays silent on lowercase "transactional" and on "behavioral" or "actional".
result.label: Capitalized "Transactional" suffix 'al'

result.description: Fires on the middle pieces of the split word "Enlightenment" (mostly 'light', also 'en'), after "En" in the Age of Enlightenment context. Members detect 'light'/'en' pieces and rational-thought or 18th-century context.
result.label: Enlightenment word-piece 'light'

result.description: Fires on the word right after "acts as" / "acting as" (e.g. " essentially", " both", " an", a quote mark), i.e. the start of the role description. Members detect "acts"/"act" tokens. Silent on " essentially" elsewhere.
result.label: Word after "acts as"

result.description: Fires on "creates"/"create" and the next few tokens after it (e.g. "where", the following adjective/noun) when an abstract subject like a combination or interplay of concepts creates something. Members detect create/give/provide verbs.
result.label: Abstract subject 'creates' and its object

result.description: Fires on tokens following the word "actual" (e.g. "actual knowledge", "actual growth", "actual income generated from"), a position one or a few tokens after "actual". Silent on "knowledge" without a preceding "actual". Members detect "actual" and "real".
result.label: Token after "actual"

result.description: Fires on function words or punctuation (of, from, are, by, ':') shortly after the word "steps" or "stages", in descriptions of multi-step processes. Members detect step/stage words. It stays silent on colons after non-step text.
result.label: Words following "steps" in processes

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ic, -icity, -ology, -ological) inside the word "ecotoxicology" and its relatives, in scientific text. It stays quiet on -ology in other words such as toxicology, biology and nanotechnology.
result.label: Ecotoxicology word suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the plural suffix piece 'ies' (also 'es') completing "energ-ies", in physics/chemistry text about bond energies. It stays silent on 'ies' in other words such as strategies, discoveries, varies.
result.label: 'ies' ending of "energies"

result.description: Fires on words following "typical"/"usual" (e.g. "typical example", "typical convention of", "typical management style"), at the next word or function word in the phrase. Silent on ordinary "of" without such a preceding modifier.
result.label: Word after "typical"/"usual" modifier

result.description: Fires on the end of "governments" (the 'ments' piece) and nearby tokens right after "governments" or in public-policy and economics text. It stays silent on 'ments' in "developments" and "investments".
result.label: 'ments' in "governments"

result.description: Fires on the token right after "IP" in internet-protocol terms, mainly the 'v' of IPv4/IPv6, also the digit 6 or 'C' (IPC). Needs the preceding "IP" in a networking context; members detect 'v' and ' IP'.
result.label: Version piece after IP (IPv4/IPv6)

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe token in contractions, especially "let's" (also there's, you're), where a suffix like s, re, ll or d comes next. The contrast shows it silent on some apostrophes in similar contexts, and the cause is unclear.
result.label: Contraction apostrophe, mainly let's

result.description: Fires mostly on " on" and " in" (also "ian") when used as prepositions after a noun like research or studies, with the topic following. Silent on "on" in other uses (ongoing, on the horizon). Members are mostly generic token detectors; evidence is mixed.
result.label: preposition 'on'/'in' after noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ics'/'ic' completing the word "plasmonics"/"plasmonic" (also " boundary" after plasmonic). Silent on 'ics' in Optics, Robotics, electronics, Dynamics, so it needs the plasmon stem.
result.label: Plasmon-ic/ics suffix

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ometric' and 'rics' completing "econometric(s)", after "econ"/"economet". Silent on "psychometric", so it needs the economics/statistics context. Members detect econ, omet, ric pieces plus stats/regression words.
result.label: econometric(s) word ending

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (offer, 'inary', 'utes', 'to', 'of') inside text about culinary institutes and culinary arts. Members detect cooking and culinary words. Silent on general cooking text without the culinary-institute framing.
result.label: Culinary institute/arts text tokens

result.description: Fires on tokens following forms of "internalize/internalizing" (the, these, of, ideas, phonetic), when the word internalize appears shortly before. Members detect "internal/external" tokens. Silent on "the" after other verbs like utilizing or emphasizing.
result.label: Words following "internalize"

result.description: Fires on the word piece completing "Feature" ('ature' in Fe-ature) or "extraction" ('ction' in extra-ction) when the phrase is repeated in a title-then-sentence pattern about feature extraction/selection/engineering. Silent on 'ction' in other words or mid-sentence.
result.label: Feature extraction/selection word-piece completion

result.description: Fires on tokens inside a "without ..." phrase, such as the comma, "the", "can" or "them" that close or continue the noun phrase after "without". It is silent on ordinary commas elsewhere.
result.label: Inside 'without' phrases

result.description: Fires on the piece "inding" (as in grinding/finding/binding) and on the comma or "or" right after it in lists of methods (grinding, sieving...). Silent on commas elsewhere, such as sentence-initial commas after a period.
result.label: "inding" and following list separators

result.description: Fires on distributive quantifiers like " each" (also " Every", and nouns after "each" such as " phase", " leaf") when each is the start of a noun phrase about individual items. It stays silent on some "each" cases after a clause break or in "each other".
result.label: Distributive "each" quantifier

result.description: Fires on "such as" / "including" / commas that introduce an example list after a general category or range noun (e.g. "a range of", "various methods"). Silent on some "including" cases after other noun phrases. Members detect "several", "range", "including".
result.label: Example-list introducers (such as, including)

result.description: Fires on varied words (' in', ' as', ' subject', ' technology', -ating) right after a numbered-list item's verb-ing fragment, e.g. "3.ating context as". Silent on ' in' in ordinary prose. Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Word after list-item gerund fragment

result.description: Fires on the word or word piece right after "studying" (e.g. "studying the composition/distribution/orientation"), in scientific text. Members detect "studying" and nearby science nouns. It stays silent on "the" after "insight into" or "interpret".
result.label: Object of "studying" in science text

result.description: Fires on " of" directly after "manipulation" (or manipulating/control-type noun phrases), as in "manipulation of the electron". Stays silent on " of" after other nouns like "form of", "speed of", "understanding of". Members include manip- detectors and generic " of" detectors.
result.label: " of" after "manipulation"

result.description: Fires on verb/noun word pieces like 'ate', 'ator', 'body', 'navigate' that follow "Leaders must..." style text. It depends on a leaders-subject context, since 'cultivate' is silent in other contexts. Members detect the 'aders' token.
result.label: Word endings after 'Leaders must'

result.description: Fires on word pieces continuing a word that began with "h" (hormone-, hinges, hanging gardens, honeybee dancers). Members detect " h" and h-word pieces like "orm" and "ed" (hedging). Silent on 'es' in unrelated words (cubes, gnomes).
result.label: Continuation of h-initial words

result.description: Fires on ' while' and on verb endings (-ates, -ing, -tes) in clauses following "while" (e.g. "while ... manipulates/maintaining"). Silent on ' while' after a verb phrase with "maximized/minimize". Evidence is mixed; members are generic topic features.
result.label: 'while' clauses and following verb endings

result.description: Fires on varied content words (control, precision, software, age, understand) shortly after the word "synergy" in text about what synergy allows or enables. Members detect "syn"/"synergy" pieces. Silent on "understand" without that synergy context.
result.label: Words following "synergy allows..." phrases

result.description: Fires on word pieces of grammatical terminology (conjunctions, relative clauses, adverbial, syntactic) in text about English grammar. Silent on 'verb' in hyphenated pairs like subject-verb or in "relative adverb" contexts.
result.label: Grammar terminology word pieces

result.description: Fires on the 'el' (or 'end') piece inside the name Mendel / Mendelian, in genetics text about Gregor Mendel. It stays silent on 'el' in other words or after other fragments like 'Mem' or 'chel'.
result.label: Mendel name pieces (el/end)

result.description: Fires on the word or function word right after a "treat-" word (treat, treatments, treatises, treaties), such as "treat it with", "treatments for", "treatise became". It stays silent on "for" after other nouns like "basis for".
result.label: Word following treat-/treatise/treaty

result.description: Fires on words inside the clause following "ensure(s)/ensuring" (e.g. "ensure that X are", "meet", "runs"), the verb or slot after the object. Predicts state words like remains/updated. Silent on "are" in ordinary clauses.
result.label: Clause after "ensure"

result.description: Fires on 'ive' in "intuitive" and on the word right after "intuitive" (and, layout, design, navigation). It stays silent on 'ive' in "responsive", so it needs the "intuit" context.
result.label: intuitive and the word after it

result.description: Fires on the 'ue' piece of "pursue" (also 'uing', and a following word like ' this' or ' their' right after "pursue"), where the next word is the thing pursued. Silent on 'ue' in other words like "dialogue".
result.label: 'ue' in "pursue"

result.description: Fires on the 'ust' piece (and 'ion') inside the word "combustion", in engine, fuel and chemistry text. It stays silent on 'ust' in "Sustainable", so it needs the comb-ust-ion word context.
result.label: 'ust' inside combustion

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after the word "standing" (as in "understanding the ..."), and more weakly after "determine". It stays silent on ' the' after other words or prepositions.
result.label: ' the' after "standing"

result.description: Fires on tokens right after or within the phrase "regardless of" (e.g. "of", "their", "any", "whether"), the slot where the phrase's complement begins. Silent on "their" elsewhere. Members include "regardless" and "of" detectors.
result.label: Complement slot after "regardless of"

result.description: Fires on the last token of a noun phrase (or the following "and") right after "integration of ..." at the start of a topic, e.g. "integration of real-time analytics". It is silent on "elligence" in "Artificial Intelligence" without that frame.
result.label: End of phrase after "integration of"

result.description: Fires on Shakespeare and the pieces right after it (the possessive apostrophe, "-an" in Shakespearean/Elizabethan, "Elizabeth"). Silent on apostrophes in contractions or after other words. Literary context members support it.
result.label: Shakespeare and his suffixes/possessive

result.description: Fires on ' there' as an existential/expletive subject, often right after a comma or "that" at the start of a clause (", there could be…", "that there's a…"). Silent on some other ' there' cases; the contrast gives no clear rule.
result.label: Existential " there" after comma

result.description: Fires on word-completion pieces after the prefix "stat" (stat-ute, stat-ement, stat-istic, stat-uettes, stat-ues), i.e. the suffix completing a word that begins with "stat". Members detect "Stat", "ute/utes", and "istic" pieces.
result.label: Suffix after 'stat' prefix

result.description: Fires on the last piece of a plural category noun in lists of types (muscles, instruments, sampling, microscopy), as in "main types include...". Silent on some "muscles" cases, so the condition is unclear. Evidence is mixed and low-consistency.
result.label: Category-list nouns (muscles, instruments)

result.description: Fires on the "ense/enses" piece of "tense(s)" in grammar text (present tense, past tense). It stays silent when "enses" starts the text with no "t" before it, and it is weaker on "licenses" or "lenses".
result.label: grammatical "tense" word ending

result.description: Fires on the first word piece (often a capital letter like B, N, A) right after the hyphen in "Anti-" compounds, such as Anti-Ballistic, Anti-Naturalism, Anti-Aliasing. A hyphen-after-Anti detector member drives it.
result.label: Word start after "Anti-"

result.description: Fires on the word piece right after "Net" (or "Elastic Net") in technical titles, such as Net Regularization, NetFlow, Net Present Value and Net Promoter Score. It marks the start of the next word in a "Net ..." term.
result.label: Word piece after "Net" in terms

result.description: Fires on the token right after a form of "create/creating" (e.g. " a", " an", " intr(icate)", word pieces), where the verb is about to take an object like "an intricate blend". Silent on " a" elsewhere.
result.label: Token after "create" verbs

result.description: Fires on the word right after "understanding of" (or "information about"), e.g. " intr", " decay", " the", " spatial", in academic-style text. It is quiet on " intr" in other constructions, such as "the intricate" or "intrinsic".
result.label: Word after "understanding of"

result.description: Fires on varied tokens (e.g. "od" in Thermodynamics, " of", commas, " Law") in academic or scientific text about laws and theories. Members detect law, science and math word pieces. Evidence is mixed with no clear single token.
result.label: Scientific law and theory text

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens, mostly the "iction" piece of "friction" and words right after "friction" or "framing" (water, thermal, differences, psych). Silent on "iction" in "metafiction". Peaks are inconsistent.
result.label: friction/framing word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' on' directly after a form of "capitalize/capitalise" (capitalizing on, capitalize on), i.e. the verb-particle phrase meaning to take advantage of. Silent on ' on' after other words like impact, guidance, or depending.
result.label: 'on' after capitalize

result.description: Fires on the token right after a sentence beginning with "-ists" (e.g. "activists", "Artists use..."), such as a following verb, adjective or "like/such". Members detect the "ists" suffix. Peak tokens are varied.
result.label: Words following "-ists" subject

result.description: Fires on " to" right after "don't be afraid" (infinitive after afraid). Stays silent on " to" after other words like "great", "how", "important", "simpler". Driven by detectors of " afraid".
result.label: " to" after "be afraid"

result.description: Fires on "lies" in "relies" (and "heavily" after "relies") at the start of a document, in the verb "rely on" after a subject noun phrase. It predicts "on/upon/heavily". Silent on other words like "refers".
result.label: "relies" verb, predicting "on"

result.description: Fires on "interface"/"design" and the closing ")" in "User Interface (UI) design" within UI/UX design-principles text. Silent on "interface" in unrelated phrases like "adapting interface designs" or "creative interface", so it needs the user-interface design context.
result.label: User interface design term

result.description: Fires on ' limit' and the next token (that, comma, parenthesis) in "Chandrasekhar limit" in astrophysics text. Members detect ' limit' and related astronomy/nuclear words. Silent on a bare ' limit' in math contexts.
result.label: Chandrasekhar limit in astrophysics

result.description: Fires on ' to' (also 'goal', 'is', 'aim') in statements of purpose like "The goal is to…", where an infinitive of purpose is expected. Silent on many other ' to' uses, such as after "not" in other contexts.
result.label: Goal-statement 'is to' infinitive

result.description: Fires on pieces of the name "Huygens" (mainly 'yg' inside Hu-yg-ens) and on the following hyphen or "F" in "Huygens-Fresnel". Stays silent on unrelated text. Driven by Huygens-piece detectors.
result.label: Huygens name pieces (Huygens-Fresnel)

result.description: Fires on the word right after "transparent" (a following noun, comma, or "and"), i.e. the slot after that adjective in governance or disclosure text. It stays quiet on "and" after other nouns like "honesty and".
result.label: Token following "transparent"

result.description: Fires in the phrase "X places great emphasis on", on ' places', ' emphas' and 'is' (and weakly 'significant' after 'places'). It appears in document-opening sentences about a field or subject placing emphasis on something.
result.label: "places emphasis on" phrase

result.description: Fires on the 'am' piece inside "Mesopotamian" (after "Mesopot"), especially when the word is split as opot-am-ian. It stays silent on 'am' in other words and on some Mesopotamian contexts.
result.label: 'am' in Mesopotamian

result.description: Fires on the word "verb" (and pieces like "verbs", "verb-") in grammar text about verb types, conjugation and verb forms. Silent on non-grammar text. Members detect "verb"/"ver" tokens and grammar or language terms.
result.label: Grammar term "verb" in linguistics text

result.description: Fires on the noun or word piece right after "Every" at the start of a document (e.g. "Every habitat", "Every note", "Every ingred-"). Peak tokens are mixed, so the pattern is the slot after a sentence-initial "Every" plus an adjective. Stays silent on " we" mid-sentence.
result.label: Noun after sentence-initial "Every"

result.description: Fires on the word pieces of "coincide" (coinc-, -ided, -ident), mainly the "ided" after "coinc". Also fires weakly on stray byte tokens. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: coincide word pieces

result.description: Fires on tokens following the opening phrase "The issue of" (the "of", the next word, or a comma), in text framing a topic or problem. Members detect issue/concern/problem/topic words. Silent on "of" after other nouns like fields or duration.
result.label: "The issue of" topic framing

result.description: Fires on ' and' (or the end of the first term) inside "between X and Y" constructions, after "interplay/interaction/relationship/correlation between X", where the second term is about to come. Silent on 'and' in other slots.
result.label: Second slot of "between X and Y"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' phr' (start of "phrases") in grammar and linguistics text, after words like noun, prepositional or gerund. Members include phr detectors and grammar-term members such as clause and nominal.
result.label: ' phr' in grammar "phrases"

result.description: Fires on the word right after "influences" (the "ences" piece itself, or the following " and", " that", " to", " alongside"), mostly in art/culture text. Members are detectors of "influ-ences" and similar words.
result.label: Token after "influences"

result.description: Fires on " in" right after a superlative noun phrase ("the most abundant metallic element in the Earth", "most energetic objects in the Universe"), where "in" introduces the scope of the superlative. Silent on "in" in other constructions.
result.label: "in" after superlative phrase

result.description: Fires on the verb "take" (takes, taking, took) and on the particle right after it (on, into, to, away), as in "take X on", "taking into consideration", "take cooking to". Members mostly detect forms of "take".
result.label: Take verb and its following particle

result.description: Fires on the final '8' in the year 1088 written in parentheses after Bologna (University of Bologna founding date). It stays silent on '8' in other numbers, such as 898, 1812 or 18th.
result.label: '8' of 1088 after Bologna

result.description: Fires on the "asing" piece of "releasing" and on the word "energy" or "and" right after "releasing" in physics/chemistry text. It stays silent on "asing" in other words such as "pleasing", so it needs the releasing context.
result.label: releasing (energy) in science text

result.description: Fires mainly on " weather" and the following word in weather-related phrases (weather systems, patterns, events, management) in meteorology and climate text. Upstream members detect weather, storm, climate and forecasting words.
result.label: Weather terms in meteorology text

result.description: Fires on tokens following or continuing the word "automatic" (e.g. "automatic voltage", repeated "automatic", "automatic garbage collection"). It is silent on "voltage" without a preceding "automatic". Members detect "automatic"/"autom" tokens.
result.label: Words following "automatic"

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ment' in "Enlightenment", when it is followed by thinkers/philosophers/ideals context. Members detect the pieces 'en', 'light', 'ened' that build up the word. It stays silent on some other 'ment' cases, such as "Enfoldement".
result.label: Enlightenment 'ment' suffix

result.description: Fires on varied word pieces (-ical, -ing, -ered, 'written', 'cultural', 'literature') in text about the Middle Ages, mostly near the document start. It stays silent on 'philosophical' later in the passage, so it seems to need early position in a Middle Ages passage.
result.label: Middle Ages text, early-document word pieces

result.description: Fires on the end of the verb "establish" (the 'he' piece of "establishe(s)") and the next tokens after it, such as ' an' or ' rules'. It seems to anticipate an object like standards, rules or boundaries.
result.label: Inflected 'establish' word pieces

result.description: Fires on connective words (" by", " as" in "as well as", " thus", " to", " establish") that follow a clause about something helping or enabling an outcome, in expository text. It stays silent on some " by" tokens in similar contexts.
result.label: Connectives after "helps with" clauses

result.description: Fires on the 'bert' piece of "Hilbert" (and on ' Hil' before 'bert'), mostly in mathematical text such as Hilbert spaces and lists of mathematicians. It stays silent on 'bert' in other names like d'Alembert.
result.label: Hilbert name piece in math

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the middle of rare or split words starting with "Co" (e.g. "Co|ordin|ating", "Coy|ol|xauh"). It is silent on "ordin" when the word is lowercase or at the start of a text, so it needs the capitalized "Co" before it.
result.label: Mid-word piece after "Co" prefix
' studies' after a field name
result.description: Fires on ' studies' (also ' study', ' changes') right after a academic field or topic noun, as in "Evolutionary biology studies the…" where it works as a verb or head noun. Silent on unrelated text.

Fires on continuation tokens right after the word "Capital" (e.g. " As" in "Capital Asset", " Bud", " and"), mostly in title-case finance headings. Silent on " As" when it is not preceded by "Capital".
result.label: Token following "Capital" in finance terms

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'od' right after 'erm' in "thermodynamics" (erm+od), with minor firing on 'iment' in "embodiment" and a few other pieces. It is silent on 'od' after the full "Therm" or "therm" piece, so it needs the split 'erm'+'od' tokenization.
result.label: 'od' after 'erm' (thermodynamics)
' Pr' word-start piece (Pronoun)
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' Pr' at the start of a line or title, mostly the start of "Pronoun" at document start. It predicts continuations like 'ran', 'ör', 'ocity'. It fires weakly on ' sw' in 'swath' and 'swelling'.
Fires on the word piece 'er' inside "anaerobic/anaerobes" (after 'ana'), where it continues a technical word. It stays silent on 'er' in other words such as foster, polymeric, synergy and Beer.
result.label: 'er' in anaerobic

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ly' or 'ed' completing compound modifiers like user-friendly, user-centered, human-centered, task-oriented. Silent on 'ed' in ordinary verbs or other words (tracked, encouraged, multifaceted).
result.label: -friendly / -centered compound suffix

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in longer words, mostly 'cr' in "bureaucratic/bureaucrats", also 'aph' in "metaphors" and 'iv'. It is a word-piece detector for the middle of a multi-piece word.
result.label: Mid-word piece 'cr' in bureaucrat

result.description: Fires on the piece 'put' completing the word "throughput" (also "through-put"), mostly in computing and performance-measurement text. Members detect 'put' and similar word-ending pieces.
result.label: 'put' in "throughput"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' explos' (explosion/explosive) and on 'le' in "Rayleigh", i.e. an early piece of a multi-piece word. Members are detectors of these specific pieces, with weaker firing on other mid-word pieces.
result.label: ' explos' and Ray-'le'-igh word pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ance' completing the word "relevance" (relev|ance). It stays silent on 'ance' in other words such as finance and acceptance.
result.label: 'ance' in "relevance"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word piece " ax" at the start of "axiom/axiomatic" (also weakly on " uncertainty" and a few other pieces). Silent on the "xiom" continuation piece. Members are mostly " ax" detectors.
result.label: " ax" start of axiom

result.description: Fires on the verb ' enable' (also enables, allow, allows) right after a plural or abstract subject such as platforms, algorithms or technology, where an object like "users to..." follows. Members detect enable/allow-type verbs.
result.label: enable/allow verb after tech subject

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ology' (also 'ological', 'ics') when completing "phon-" words, as in Phonology/phonological. It stays silent on 'ology' in other words like phylogenology, neurobiology or typology. Members detect phonetics and language-sound context.
result.label: Phonology suffix after phon-

result.description: Fires on the noun right after a protected-thing modifier in copyright and IP-protection text (original works, counterfeit goods, their work), where the next word would be about protecting or legal handling. Silent on 'literary works' in literary-criticism text.
result.label: Protected works/goods in copyright text
'gence' in divergence
result.description: Fires on the final piece 'gence' of "divergence" (also 'gent', 'ge' after "diver"), mostly in math or physics text. Weaker on a few other tokens like ' Land' in "Holy Land". Members detect diver-/-gence pieces.

Fires on 'period', 'era' or 'Age' when it follows a named historical or cultural epoch (Vedic period, Hellenistic era, Byzantine era). It stays quiet when 'period' has no preceding epoch name, such as at the start of a text or after 'significant'.
result.label: Named historical period/era word

result.description: Fires on the token " hub" (as in transportation hubs, cities becoming hubs, network hubs), including repeated "hubs or hub". Members are mostly hub detectors plus a few similar word-piece detectors. The contrast text with no "hub" is silent.
result.label: ' hub' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Ne' when it starts a split word like Neural, Neutron, Neumann, Neolith, Neuronal. It is silent on whole-word "neural" in running text. It also fires weakly on ' Min' in Minotaur and Minsky.
result.label: ' Ne' word-initial fragment

result.description: Fires on the token ' line' (geometry lines, tangent/secant line, text lines, "in line with"). Members are mostly detectors of ' line'/' lines'. The logits favor suffix-like continuations such as 'age'. The one contrast example ('tangent and a radius') has no ' line' token in it.
result.label: ' line' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verb " stand" (also "stands") in phrasal or idiomatic uses like "stand out", "stand alone", "stands as". It predicts continuations such as "alone", "out" and "up".
result.label: ' stand' verb token
Sentence-initial " Not"
result.description: Fires on " Not" (also " not", " no") at the start of a document or sentence, such as "Not quite" or "Not so much as". Weaker on "not" in "not only". Its output favours "alone", "only"-like continuations.

Fires on the word " classical" (occasionally " classic") as a modifier, e.g. classical music, classical Greek, classical vs. modern. Members are detectors of classical/traditional tokens plus music and art context. Weaker on "traditional".
result.label: ' classical' word detector
'apest' piece in tapestry
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'apest' in "tapestry" (T-apest-ry), literal or metaphorical ("rich tapestry of..."). Weakly fires on other mid-word pieces like 'opol' in geopolitics. Members mostly detect 'apest' in earlier layers.

result.label: 'ance' ending of "substance"
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ance' completing the word "substance" (e.g. "subst|ance"), mostly in philosophy or chemistry text. It stays silent on 'ance' in "accordance", so it needs the subst- word start.
Fires on ' or' right after a quantity word like "one" or "two" in phrases such as "two or more" and "one or both". It is quiet on ' or' after ordinary nouns and adjectives.
result.label: ' or' after one/two

result.description: Fires on the word " two" (almost always lowercase), mostly as a quantifier before a noun or hyphenated compound, such as "two-body", "two vanishing points" or "the two". Members detect " two" and nearby small number words.
result.label: the word " two"

result.description: Fires on the ordinal suffix 'th' after a century number (12th, 19th), especially in "the 18th and 19th centuries" or "11th to 15th" ranges. It stays silent on plain year forms like 1820's. Pushes toward 'century'.
result.label: Century ordinal 'th' suffix

result.description: Fires on the hyphen after "to" in "X-to-Y" patterns (one-to-many, Adenosine-to-Inosine, Speech-to-Text), and weakly on hyphens in some other compounds. Silent on hyphens in compounds like hands-on or self-improvement.
result.label: Hyphen after "to" in X-to-Y

result.description: Fires on the word piece " compos" (mostly in "composites", also composing/compositions) and on " planning" in compound terms like "city planning". Peaks in materials-science text, with weaker firing on a few other tokens.
result.label: compos- and planning word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on 'lace' in "Laplace" in math/engineering text, with weaker hits on digits inside long numbers and on ' rel' in "relays". Members detect Laplace, Fourier, and equation-like technical terms.
result.label: Laplace 'lace' in technical text

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' diag' (as in "diagrams") in technical or scientific text, predicting the continuation "rams". Members detect similar word-start fragments like Alg, sketch, Bol, cla, comb.
result.label: ' diag' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on words of necessity or importance, mostly the "cial" piece of "crucial" and "to" after "crucial/imperative" in "it becomes crucial to…" constructions. Weaker on "essential" and "-ative/-able" adjectives.
result.label: crucial/imperative "to" necessity phrases

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'erm' inside split words such as exoth-erm-ic, isoth-erm-al, Th-erm-odynamics and F-erm-i. It needs the preceding fragment (Th, oth, F) and thermodynamics-type text; it is silent on whole words like temperature.
result.label: 'erm' piece in thermo- words

result.description: Fires on the word " development" (also "Development"), mostly in software or process contexts such as the development stage, lifecycle, or development and operations. Weaker for plot or character development. Members detect "development" in earlier layers.
result.label: word "development"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'at' in the middle of a rare multi-piece word, especially 'onom-at-opoeia' and 'onom-at-ophobic'. Members detect mid-word pieces such as chrom-at-ography and Lands-at.
result.label: 'at' inside onomatopoeia-like words

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments 'le' (Nuc-le-ic, Ro-le) and 'ig' (en-ig-matic, p-ig-ment) inside longer words, not on 'le' as an ending of a standalone verb like "tackle". Predicts word continuation pieces.
result.label: Mid-word 'le'/'ig' fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' dry' in all its uses: drying techniques, 'wet and dry', 'dry points', 'sun dry'. Members are mostly detectors of ' dry' plus related words such as wet and hot.
result.label: ' dry' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " Marine" (also " marine") when it starts an item in a list of marine-science topics, such as Marine Ecology, Marine Geology or Marine Conservation. Weak activations appear on a few unrelated tokens.
result.label: Marine as list-item topic word

result.description: Fires on the word " but" (also as the start of "butter/butterflies"), mostly as a contrastive conjunction after a comma. Members are detectors of " but" and " yet". Silent on text without it.
result.label: Contrastive " but" token

result.description: Fires on the digit '5' (sometimes '4') as the third digit of a four-digit year in the 1900s, especially in decades like "the 1950s" or ranges like 1951–. It stays quiet on '5' in other number positions.
result.label: Digit 5 in 1950s years

result.description: Fires on the token ' them' when it is the first piece of the word "themes" or "thematic" (split as them+es), usually after a modifier like "complex", "main" or "these". It is silent when the word is at the start of a document or after "general".
result.label: ' them' as start of 'themes'

result.description: Fires on the word piece "aster" completing "disaster" (also "scal" in scale-like words), mostly in technical text on disaster recovery. Members are mostly "aster" detectors in the same word.
result.label: "aster" in "disaster"

result.description: Fires on 'mat' inside "grammatical" (gram+mat) and on ' much' after a comma or in "much like/more", plus a few stray tokens. Silent on 'mat' in "pragmatics", so it needs the gram- prefix.
result.label: 'mat' in grammatical; ' much'

result.description: Fires on the word " fixed" (e.g. fixed vs floating rates, fixed costs, fixed exchange rates), with minor activation on a few other word pieces like "domin". Members are mostly " fixed" token detectors across early layers.
result.label: ' fixed' token detector

result.description: Fires on abstract nouns in academic or technical prose, such as "application", "framework", "purposes", "solutions", "insights", "calculations", and "rise" in "giving rise". These are typically objects of a verb or adjective phrase. Peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Abstract academic nouns (application, framework)

result.description: Fires on the word ' solid' used as a physics/materials or math modifier (solid-state, solid mechanics, solid math, solid reactants). Silent on unrelated words like 'strongholds'. Members are mostly ' solid' token detectors plus a few word-start pieces.
result.label: ' solid' in science/technical use

result.description: Fires on the token ' gold', mostly in monetary or commodity contexts like the gold standard, gold reserves and gold convertibility. It fires weakly on ' salt' before a suffix. Members detect gold, silver and other materials.
result.label: ' gold' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' v' / ' V' (vivid, vibrant, vaccine, VPN) when it starts a new word and a continuation like -ivid, -ibr or -acc must follow. Silent when the word is already complete (e.g. 'vividly' as a whole token).
result.label: Word-initial ' v' fragment

result.description: Fires on mixed word pieces: 'ertain' in "Certain" (category labels), ' shorter' (focal lengths), and 'omed'. Predicts a following noun like lengths, forms, days. Peaks are heterogeneous, with some length/duration and certainty detectors upstream.
result.label: 'ertain' and ' shorter' mixed pieces

result.description: Fires on the word "technology" (and "Technology", "techn-" pieces) as a noun, at document start or after phrases like "philosophy of" or "advanced". Members are mostly detectors of the same word and its variants.
result.label: Word 'technology'

result.description: Fires on ' tend' (tend to / tends toward) after a plural or generic subject, and also on 'ification' in "clarification needed" and on ' Victor' in "Victorian". Members mostly detect 'tend'/'tendency' and 'ification'.
result.label: 'tend' verb plus 'ification' pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " algebra" (also "gebra" in "Algebra"), mostly in math text about algebra with geometry or groups. Weakly fires on related fields like analysis and calculus. Silent on the adjective "algebraic" in the contrast.
result.label: ' algebra' word detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cle' completing "muscle" (after 'mus'), in biology and medical text. It stays silent on "music", and the weaker cases are 'cular' and 'cles'.
result.label: 'cle' in muscle

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ret" in "Cretaceous" (after "C"), mostly in geology/dinosaur-era text. Members detect "C" followed by a word-piece start (Cul-, Cur-, Cyl-) and "ret" pieces in other words.
result.label: "ret" in Cretaceous

result.description: Fires on the verb "allow"/"enable" and its forms (enabling, allowing, allows, enabled, allowance), where they link a subject to what it makes possible for someone. Members detect allow/enable tokens individually.
result.label: allow/enable verb forms

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'hanced' in "enhanced" / "Enhanced", including at document start and after "en". Weaker on similar pieces like "cient". Supported by members for enhance/improve/increase words.
result.label: 'hanced' in enhanced

result.description: Fires on word-start or word-piece fragments that are incomplete, mainly "ved" in "curved" and " Dist" in "Distributed", plus occasional " Equ", "Ess", "ator". It sits mid-word, where the next piece completes the word.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: curved, Distributed

result.description: Fires on a bare 't' token that ends or sits inside a word split into pieces (Humboldt, revolt, debt, Rembrandt, storytelling) and on the variable t in math. Silent on the contraction "didn't".
result.label: Word-final 't' token piece

result.description: Fires on the piece "aming" right after "fr" in "framing" (framing effect, framing climate change). Members detect "fr" plus "aming" or related pieces like friction, fract-. Weak on other word-internal pieces.
result.label: "aming" in "framing"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' prob' (before 'abilities', 'ing', 'es') in math/statistics text, and weakly on other word-start fragments like 'fil', 'cur', 'ension'. Predicts word-completing suffixes.
result.label: ' prob' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on ellipsis "..." and runs of dashes or plus signs used as separators or placeholders, especially in early-document text. Members are mostly detectors of "..." and repeated punctuation. Weaker firing on odd word pieces.
result.label: Ellipsis and dash-run punctuation

result.description: Fires on ' fundamental' used as a predicate adjective after a copula ("X are fundamental to/for..."). It stays silent when 'fundamental' is an attributive modifier before a noun ("the fundamental principles").
result.label: Predicative 'fundamental' after copula

result.description: Fires on the word " speech" (occasionally " song") as a noun in text about speeches, speech styles, or speech analysis. Members are mostly detectors of speech/Spe-/spoken tokens. Predicts little clearly.
result.label: ' speech' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' a' (also ' sp', ' an') right after "The Renaissance," or "period," in an appositive, as in "The Renaissance, a pivotal period". It stays quiet on 'a' after verbs or prepositions like "there was a" or "contributed to a".
result.label: Appositive 'a' after Renaissance

result.description: Fires on adjectives meaning thorough or in-depth, mainly ' detailed', '-ensive' (comprehensive/extensive) and ' elaborate', typically before a noun like planning, descriptions or approach in formal descriptive prose.
result.label: Detailed / comprehensive adjectives

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' corpor' (corpora/corporation), ' trom' (trombone), and 'Vers' (Versailles), where the word is incomplete and a continuation like 'a', 'at', 'bone' follows. Mostly ' corpor'.
result.label: Word-initial fragment ' corpor' / ' trom'

result.description: Fires on the word piece " develop" when it is followed by "ments" (as in "significant developments"), after an adjective or determiner. It stays silent when " develop" begins the text with no preceding context.
result.label: " develop" before "-ments"

result.description: Fires on the word " performance" when it follows a modifier or verb in a business, evaluation or technical sense (individual, employee, model, system performance). It stays silent when " performance" is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' performance' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on 'use' and related forms (utilization, using, utilized, izing) when they mean employing a method or tool, especially in "Through the use of X". Quiet on other text about techniques without these words.
result.label: use / utilization of a method

result.description: Fires on the piece 're' when it is a word-internal fragment after a prefix or stem, most strongly in "Out-re-ach". It stays silent on the contraction "'re" (you're, we're, there're).
result.label: 're' inside split words
'os' in 'erosion'
result.description: Fires on the 'os' piece inside 'erosion' (er|os|ion), mostly in soil and land-erosion text. It stays silent on 'os' in other words such as 'geosphere'.

Fires on word-piece endings inside split words like Rom-antic(s), philos-opher, mostly in humanities/art-history text about movements and philosophy. Silent on 'antic' in lowercase 'romanticism', so it needs the specific split-word context.
result.label: Rom-antic / philos-opher word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after a sentence-initial preposition at the start of a sentence (With the advent, In the context, Through the). Stays silent on ' the' after mid-sentence prepositions or verbs.
result.label: ' the' after sentence-initial preposition

result.description: Fires on the 't' token of a negative contraction (don't, can't, isn't) at the start of a clause or before verbs like worry, stop, just. Silent on 't' inside other words or some mid-sentence contractions.
result.label: Contraction n't 't' token

result.description: Fires on the "well" piece at the end of the surname "Maxwell" (Clerk Maxwell, Maxwell's equations). It stays silent on a standalone "well" and is weaker on "Dirac".
result.label: Maxwell surname 'well' piece

result.description: Fires on ' Late' in "the Late Middle Ages" and on the piece 'ul' (e.g. in "Culinary", "hydraulic", "cellulose"). Weaker on ' evolution'. Members are 'ul' detectors and period words like Old, Middle, Babylonian.
result.label: Late (Middle Ages) and 'ul' pieces

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " open" (e.g. open source, open-source), and weakly on " home" or " rich" as modifiers before a noun. It stays silent on "closed sets" in the topology contrast. Predicts hyphens or compound continuations.
result.label: "open" as modifier before noun

result.description: Fires on ' as' directly after a noun or verb when it introduces a role or manner phrase ("X as a Service", "used as early as", "language as a tool"). It stays silent on "such as", "defined as", and "serves as".
result.label: ' as' after noun, role/manner

result.description: Fires on the word " particles" (and " particle"), mostly in physics text about groups of particles, and also in materials contexts like oil or soil particles. Upstream members are mostly detectors of "particles" in earlier layers.
result.label: particles token detector

result.description: Fires on 'rival' in "non-rival(rous/ry)" public-goods economics text, and on ' Par' in "Pareto"/"paradox" word starts. Both are word pieces inside economics terms; the rest is mixed.
result.label: non-rival and Pareto word pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'fo' inside "seafood", where it follows "sea" and precedes "od". It is silent on other food text such as caviar and cheese. Members are mostly 'fo' detectors from early layers.
result.label: 'fo' in "seafood"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 've' inside multi-piece words after "con" (conveying, conveys, convection, concave). Silent on contractions ('ve) and the suffix in "conducive". Weaker hits on ' closed' and 'ynamic'.
result.label: 've' in "con-ve-" words
'acc' piece in "vaccine"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'acc' inside "vaccine(s)" (v-acc-ine), all peaks in vaccine text. Weaker activation on other mid-word pieces such as "encaps-ul-ates" and "acc-um-ulate". Members detect 'acc' after 'v'.

Fires on the subject pronoun ' it' starting a new clause after a conjunction (while, because, and, but), where a verb like provides/allows/causes is expected. Also fires on the 'i' in 'Idioms'. Silent on object 'it' or sentence-initial "it's".
result.label: Clause-subject 'it' after conjunction

result.description: Fires mainly on ' Dies' in "Diesel Cycle" headings, and on word-piece 'le' inside words like staple, cradle, role. Mostly a mid-word fragment detector, with weaker hits on pieces like 'ism' and 'ig'.
result.label: Dies(el) and mid-word 'le' pieces

result.description: Fires on the token 'one' when it is a word-final piece inside a larger word (silicone, bone, hormone, tone, testosterone). It stays silent on standalone 'one' as a pronoun or number at the start of a text.
result.label: 'one' as word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on accuracy/precision words (accuracy, precision, precise, accurate, -acy), especially where they are discussed as measurement or communication qualities. Silent on one "ensure accuracy" case in a testing context.
result.label: accuracy / precision words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'istic' (also ' ren') inside words like Heur-istic, probabil-istic, Art-istic, mostly when it ends a word. It stays quiet in "determin-istic" and "soph-istic-ated", so it depends on the specific word.
result.label: 'istic' suffix in specific words

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'pos' inside the split word "Prepositions" (pre|pos|itions), mostly in grammar lesson headings. Silent on the ordinary word "place" and on the rest of the grammar discussion.
result.label: 'pos' piece in "prepositions"

result.description: Fires on the token ' rendering', mainly in computer graphics phrases like "real-time rendering", "foveated rendering" and "volumetric rendering". Supporting members detect graphics, animation and art words. It stays silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' rendering' in graphics contexts

result.description: Fires on the word ' not' (also n't and 'Not') in all its uses, especially the "not only / not just" pattern. Members are detectors of not/n't, many boosting ' just', ' only', ' merely' as next words.
result.label: ' not' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "ried" in "dried" (also "Dried"), mostly in text about dried herbs and food preservation. Silent on other herb or cooling text without that piece. Members detect "ried" and cooking vocabulary.
result.label: "ried" in "dried" (herbs)

result.description: Fires on the word " dense" in both mathematical (dense open sets, dense subset) and physical (dense plasma, dense ice) uses. Members are detectors of "dense" and similar density words such as urban, rich and dens-.
result.label: Token ' dense'

result.description: Fires on the piece "let" in the word "subtleties" (subt|let|ies), and weakly on neighbouring "le" or "ile" pieces of subt-words. Upstream members detect "subt" plus "le" and "let" pieces; "wavelet" also feeds in.
result.label: "let" in "subtleties"

result.description: Fires on the token ' framework' (and close variants) as a noun, e.g. 'robust framework', 'mathematical framework', 'this framework'. Members are mostly detectors of framework/frameworks and near-synonyms like foundation or basis.
result.label: ' framework' token detector
Hyphen after capital B (B-tree)
result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after a single capital letter, especially 'B' in 'B-tree' / 'B-Trees'. Stays silent on hyphens after ordinary words like 'self-' or 'data-'. Also fires weakly on other tokens after 'B'.

Fires on verbs of rejecting or championing, mainly " reject" (also " champion", "construct") when a philosophical or ideological movement or doctrine is the subject, as in "constructivism rejects the law". Silent on generic opposition text.
result.label: Philosophy movements rejecting/championing ideas

result.description: Fires on the word ' used' as a passive participle after is/are/was/be/been (e.g. "are used to", "can be used as"). Silent on the contrast text, which has no passive "used". Members are mostly ' used' detectors plus use/utilization words.
result.label: Passive 'used' after be-verb

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing the word "segmentation", as in image or customer segmentation. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words such as augmentation, evaluation, activation and documentation.
result.label: 'ation' in "segmentation"

result.description: Fires on the piece "certain" when it is the middle of the split word "Un|certain|ty" (Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle). Silent when "uncertainty" appears as a whole word. Weakly fires on mid-word pieces after "un-" or similar prefixes.
result.label: 'certain' inside 'Uncertainty' split

result.description: Fires on the token " capital", mostly in "human capital" (HR and strategy text), right after "human". It is silent in unrelated contexts such as rural communities text. Weak firing on "human factors".
result.label: "capital" after "human"
'omer' piece in conglomerate/isomer
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'omer' inside multi-piece words, most strongly in "conglomerate", and also in isomer, monomer and anomeric. Members are mostly detectors of 'omer' and similar mid-word pieces.

Fires on the word piece 'och' in the middle of a word, mostly in "geochemical"/"biogeochemistry", also in mitochondrial, thermochemistry and monochromatic. Members are 'och' detectors in early layers.
result.label: 'och' inside words (geochemical)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "oy" inside "buoyancy" (also "buoyant"), after "bu". Members detect "oy" and neighbouring pieces such as "ancy". Only faint activation on other mid-word fragments.
result.label: "oy" in buoyancy

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ocr' inside "democratic/democracy" (also "endocrine"), and on ' numer' at the start of "numeral". Mid-word fragment that predicts a continuation like 'atic'.
result.label: 'ocr' in democracy / 'numer' in numeral

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' equ' (as in equity, equities, equitable, equilibrium), where the next piece completes the word. Members are mostly ' equ' detectors plus a few economics-context features. Weaker on 'equatorial'.
result.label: ' equ' word-start piece
"educators" suffix in education text
result.description: Fires on the 'ators' piece completing "educators" (also 'agog' in pedagogy) in education and teaching text. It stays silent on 'ators' in other words such as "mediators" or "communicators".
Fires on the 'ul' piece inside the word "vocabulary" (vocab|ul|ary), mostly in language-learning text. Members are detectors of 'ul' and of word pieces in vocabulary/linguistics words.
result.label: 'ul' in vocabulary
'ocr' piece in endocrine
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ocr' inside split words, mainly 'endocrine' (also apocrine, democratic), in biology text. Weak activation on a few other fragments like 'ul' and 'ry'. Upstream members are 'ocr' detectors.

Fires on the token ' cell' in biology text, especially as the start of 'cellular' or 'cell' + noun (cell signaling, cell function), often after 'in' or a verb. Members detect cell/cells tokens in biology contexts.
result.label: ' cell' in biology text
'set' as word-piece in onset/Asset
result.description: Fires on the token 'set' when it is the ending piece of a longer word, such as 'on|set' and 'As|set', and weakly on similar pieces like 'ifer' or 'Rous|set'. Silent on ordinary text without it.
Fires on 'case'/'Case' at the start of a "Case Study" heading or in "case studies", plus 'RI' (MRI) and 'ine' in telemedicine. Silent on 'case' at the start of some sentences or in "this case".
result.label: Case study 'case' token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pe' (also ' Spe'), mostly in the repeated "peeler"/"peel" text, where it is the start of a word split into pieces. Members are mostly detectors of ' pe'.
result.label: ' pe' word-start piece (peeler)
Fission suffix 'ission' in nuclear text
