result.description: Fires on the piece 'ission' completing 'fission', mostly in nuclear physics text. It stays silent when 'ission' starts a document with no 'f' or nuclear context before it. Weak activity on 'dimensional' and a few other word endings.

Fires on the word piece ' post' when it begins "posture" in text about body language or nonverbal communication. It is weaker on "post-" prefixes like post-birth. It is silent when "posture" starts the document.
result.label: ' post' in "posture"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' di' beginning a word (diode, diagnostics, diary, diet, dibasic), mid-sentence after a preceding word. Members are mostly ' di'/' Di' detectors from early layers.
result.label: ' di' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on a comma separating items in a list of abstract nouns, especially after "interplay/interactions between X, Y, ..." and similar enumerations. Silent on commas after introductory phrases or in non-list positions.
result.label: Comma in noun-list enumeration

result.description: Fires on the agent-noun suffix 'ers' (also 'ors', 'ators', 'ivers') ending a plural person-role noun, especially in lists of occupations or groups like "researchers, journalists". Silent on some cases like "performers" and "organizers".
result.label: Plural agent-noun suffix -ers

result.description: Fires on the 'ing' piece of "striving" (and weakly "strive"), where the next word is likely "for" or "to". It stays silent on 'ing' in other verbs like flouting, scaling or responding.
result.label: 'ing' in "striving"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' flav' (flavor/flavors) in cooking and food text, mid-sentence after a modifier like natural, savory or unique. It is silent when ' flav' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' flav' in cooking text

result.description: Fires on the word " movements" (also " movement") when it follows a modifier like "social" or "feminist", meaning a social or cultural movement. It stays silent when "movements" starts the text or follows a comma or possessive.
result.label: social/political 'movements' after modifier

result.description: Fires mainly on the 'ci' piece inside "glaciers/glacial" after " gla", and weakly on a few other mid-word pieces (Goth, redund). It stays silent when 'ci' starts a text or follows a period without "gla".
result.label: 'ci' inside glacier words

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' activ' (start of activist, activism, activator, activation), and weakly on 'ru' in 'disruptions'. Predicts suffix pieces like 'ist' and 'istic'. Members are mostly ' activ' detectors.
result.label: ' activ' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ural' completing "cult-ural", especially in "cross-cultural". It stays silent on 'ural' in other words like "plural" or "structural".
result.label: 'ural' ending "cultural"

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'ating' (mostly in "subordinating"/"coordinating") and 'able' (e.g. "believable"). It is silent on 'ating' in other words like "integrating" or "alienating", so it needs the grammar-conjunction context.
result.label: subordinating / believable suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on the word " popular" as a standalone adjective (e.g. "was popular", "became popular"). It stays silent when the word is a stem inside "popularity", where logits favour suffixes like 'vity'.
result.label: ' popular' as standalone adjective

result.description: Fires on the piece 'iv' inside longer words, most strongly in "captivating"/"captivate", and also in herbivores, carnivores, pivotal. Weaker on similar mid-word pieces like 'in' in "fascinating".
result.label: 'iv' piece in captivating

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'as' in "pl-as-monic/plasmon", and also 'ora' in "moraine", i.e. a word-fragment inside a longer word that is still incomplete. Silent on 'as' in other words like "Eras" or "quasi".
result.label: 'as' inside plasmonic (word fragment)

result.description: Fires on the word piece after an initial "W"/"w" in words like "Wide" (World Wide Web) and "Welfare" (w-elf-are), i.e. the 'ide' or 'elf' fragment completing a W-word. Mostly 'ide' and 'elf' tokens.
result.label: 'ide'/'elf' piece after W-

result.description: Fires on the token ' B' (or 'B') used as a variable or label, most strongly as the second event in probability statements like "A and B" or "A given B". Also fires on B in B-Tree and similar names.
result.label: Letter B as variable

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compet' when it is the start of "competence" (e.g. pragmatic/cultural/communicative competence). It is quiet on "competitors" in the contrast, and the logits favour continuations like -ence, not -itor.
result.label: ' compet' in competence

result.description: Fires on the word " next", mostly when it begins a new sentence or phrase, as in "next time", "next step" or "next generation". Members are mostly detectors of " next" and similar sequence words like final and late.
result.label: ' next' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ens' when it starts "ensures/ensuring" in the middle of a sentence, after a subject or preposition. It stays silent when ' ens' is the very first token of the document.
result.label: ' ens' of ensure/ensuring

result.description: Fires on the piece "icate" completing "delicate" (del|icate), including "delicate balance". It stays silent on "icate" in "intricate". Logits favor "balance" and "equilibrium" next.
result.label: "icate" in "delicate"

result.description: Fires on the word " standard" (including standardized, standard deviation, standards) across contexts like financial reporting standards and statistics. Members are mostly detectors of "standard" and related tokens such as formal and common.
result.label: ' standard' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " fore" in "at the forefront", predicting "front". Members detect word-start pieces and "at the heart/fore" phrases.
result.label: "fore" in "at the forefront"

result.description: Fires on the "den"/"dens" piece completing "burden(s)", as in "reduce the burden on taxpayers" or "regulatory burdens". It also fires weakly on " easy" and similar. Members are detectors of "bur" + "den"/"geon".
result.label: "burden" word-piece 'den'

result.description: Fires on the token ' all' (including the start of 'allergies'/'allergens'), mostly after prepositions like 'at', 'across', 'for' as in 'at all levels'. Members are mostly ' all' detectors; weaker on 'every'/'any'.
result.label: ' all' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'iv' in "pivotal" (after "p"), e.g. "a pivotal role". It stays silent on 'iv' in other words like "Constructivism" and "captivating".
result.label: 'iv' in "pivotal"
' summar' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' summar' (summarization, summaries, summarized), at the start of the word. Members are mostly ' summar' token detectors, plus a few detectors of other split word beginnings like ' compreh' and ' Sud'.

Fires on the word piece 'unci' in "pronunciation" (after 'pron'), predicting the following 'ation'. Weakly fires on 'ab' in "vocabulary". Members are mostly detectors of 'unci' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'unci' in pronunciation

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of long technical words split into pieces, mainly ' erg' (ergonomics), ' aut' (autocorrelation), and ' lub' (lubrication). It predicts a continuation piece of the word.
result.label: Technical word-start fragments erg/aut/lub

result.description: Fires on the token ' so', both as a conjunction after a clause ("..., so it is important") and as a word-start piece in sovereignty, soil, soapy, social. Peaks on the clause-linking use in instructional or cleaning text.
result.label: ' so' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start token ' In' in title-like or heading text, especially when it begins a longer word such as Insurance, Innovation or Intricacy. It is weaker for sentence-initial 'In'. It promotes word continuations like 'cre', 'ade' and 'crement'.
result.label: ' In' as start of longer word
'bre' piece in groundbreaking
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'bre', mostly the middle of "ground-bre-aking" (also timbre, cross-breeding). Members are mainly 'bre' token detectors. It predicts continuations like 'aking'.

Fires on the token ' found' as the verb "found" (past participle, e.g. "have found solace/success"). Members mostly detect ' found' pieces, including in "foundations". The contrast "newfound" is silent.
result.label: verb 'found' (have found)

result.description: Fires on the 'SS' token ending an acronym, mainly GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems) and similar capitalized acronyms like GISS. Needs the preceding acronym letters, such as GN or GI. Weakly fires on 'IS' in ISIS.
result.label: Acronym-final 'SS' (GNSS)

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " sens" (sensors, sensory, sensations) when it begins a new word after a preceding word or slash. It is silent when "sens" follows "sensor" directly, as in "sensor sensors". Members detect the " sens" token.
result.label: ' sens' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " intens" (as in intensified/intensifying), a prefix awaiting a suffix. Weaker on similar mid-word pieces like "umin" and " prompt". Members detect word-start fragments such as intens, ampl, explos.
result.label: ' intens' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ormal" inside "renormalization" (strongest), with weak activation in "Formalism". Early-layer members detect "ormal" and related pieces like "formal" and "-ization".
result.label: "ormal" in renormalization

result.description: Fires on scattered tokens ('or' in Manor, ' to', ' teach', '5' in a Council of Trent date, ' in' before a year) in history/religion/social-science text. Peaks are mixed, and the members are broad topical word detectors.
result.label: Mixed tokens in historical text

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces in longer words, mostly 'duct' in intro-duct-ory, semicon-duct-or, con-duct-ive, also 'ial', 'ap' in sem-ap-hores. Needs the piece inside a multi-piece word.
result.label: Mid-word 'duct' piece detector

result.description: Fires on the final piece of a compound word, mainly 'point' in "counterpoint" (also 'ality' in "intersectionality"). Silent on other word-final pieces such as "Inquis…". Members detect "counter-" prefix pieces and music/art context.
result.label: counter-point / intersection-ality word endings
' enh' word-piece in enhance
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' enh' that begins "enhance/enhancement", mid-sentence after a noun, "the", or "that". It stays quiet when ' enh' opens the text. Members are mostly ' enh' detectors plus similar verb starts like ' fost'.
Fires on the piece 'use' (end-use, misuse, single-use, land use) and also 'folio' in portfolio, mostly as a word-ending or hyphenated piece. Members are detectors of 'use' and similar word pieces.
result.label: 'use' and 'folio' word pieces

result.description: Fires on the token ' concrete' (mostly the adjective sense, as in concrete facts, objects, examples, versus abstract). Members are mostly detectors of ' concrete' itself; it also weakly fires on the building material.
result.label: ' concrete' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'red' inside words like "ingredients" and "shreds" (also "shredding"), where it is a mid-word fragment. Silent on some "ingredients" cases and on a bare leading "red". Pushes toward suffix pieces like 'ients'.
result.label: 'red' inside ingredients/shred

result.description: Fires on the token ' growth', mostly after an adjective like rapid, industrial, explosive or economic. Members are mainly detectors of 'growth' and near synonyms such as expansion, development and success. The contrast text lacks the word.
result.label: ' growth' after modifiers

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece ' sh' (shave, sharpening, shifts), and less on ' fr' and similar pieces. It predicts continuations like 'ifts', 'aping', 'ave'. Most examples come from the barber paradox text.
result.label: ' sh' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' Im' when it begins "Impressionism/Impressionist" in mid-sentence, after words like "from", "against", "newer". It stays silent when ' Im' is at the start of a text or sentence.
result.label: Mid-sentence ' Im' of Impressionism

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces 'ty', 'ity', 'ities' (and ' inequality') completing social-inequality words like disparity, poverty, inequalities, in economic/social inequality text. Quiet in unrelated contexts.
result.label: Inequality/poverty word endings

result.description: Fires on ' and' (sometimes a comma) right after a positive evaluative adjective that starts a coordinated adjective pair, like "rich and engaging" or "powerful and memorable". Silent on ' and' joining nouns or numbers.
result.label: 'and' after evaluative adjective

result.description: Fires on the word " conservation" (physics conservation laws, also environmental conservation efforts) when it follows a preceding word in running text. It stays silent when the word starts a text. Members detect conservation, Conserv- and preservation pieces.
result.label: ' conservation' token detector

result.description: Fires on the letter 'W' (and following hyphens) in abbreviations or letter sequences like WWW, WWI, and W-W-H whole/half-step patterns. Weaker on W-initial name pieces such as Woolf.
result.label: Letter W in WWW/WWI/W-W patterns

result.description: Fires on the 's' piece completing the word "electrolysis" (also weaker on -ical/-ytic pieces in chemistry words). Silent on possessive 's, plural 's, or verb 's endings. Needs preceding "electroly" in a chemistry context.
result.label: 's' in electrolysis

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cut' (cross-cutting, woodcut, pointcut) and on ' norm'/'norms'. It looks like a detector for these tokens as word stems, often before suffixes like -ting or -s; silent on 'cross-hatching'.
result.label: 'cut' and 'norm' word stems

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ep' (start of "epic", also "epidemic", "epigenetics") when it follows a word like "the" or "an". Weaker on ' fant' of "fantasy". Members are mostly ' ep' token detectors.
result.label: ' ep' word-start piece (epic)

result.description: Fires on the token " Marx" in text about Marxism, class struggle and Engels, as in "Marxism", "Marxist", or "Marx and Friedrich Engels". It stays silent on "Marx'd", where the possessive-style form follows the name.
result.label: Marx in Marxist theory text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ant'/' Ant' when it starts the prefix "anti-" (antiparticles, antimatter, antitrust, antibody). Strongest in physics text; weaker in antitrust and policy text. It is silent on general particle-theory text without the prefix.
result.label: anti- prefix piece ' ant'

result.description: Fires on the word " what" when it works as a relative or free-relative pronoun in the middle of a sentence ("the opposite of what's meant", "is what makes", "never what it seems"). It is silent on text without this word.
result.label: Relative 'what' in mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on the second letter after a capital 'Q' that starts an acronym (QoS, QKD, QRNG, QA), mostly 'o', 'K', 'R'. Predicts acronym continuations like 'OS'. Members detect 'Q' and nearby '^' tokens.
result.label: Letter after Q in acronyms

result.description: Fires on the word " better" itself, both as an adjective before a noun (better focus, better wages) and as an adverb before a verb (to better understand). Members are mostly detectors of "better" and related comparatives like improved, stronger and closer.
result.label: " better" token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ine' in "undermine" (the verb ending after "underm"). It stays silent on 'ine' in "genuine", and it fires only weakly on other word-ending pieces like "escalating" and "elevate".
result.label: 'ine' in "undermine"

result.description: Fires on the token ' V' when it begins an acronym or word like VR, VLAN, VPN or Vedic, without a preceding space-separated word break. Silent on 'V-Model'. Predicts capital continuation letters such as R, UI, PN.
result.label: ' V' starting acronyms (VR, VPN)

result.description: Fires on the possessive ' our' (also 'Our'), mostly after a verb or preposition in abstract, reflective prose about minds, bodies and experience. Members are mostly detectors of 'our' and similar possessives like 'your' and 'their'.
result.label: possessive 'our' detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cular' completing "molecular" (e.g. "molecular level", "molecular orbital", "molecular formula"). Occasionally on ' atomic' in the same atomic/molecular context. Members detect 'cular' and 'mole'.
result.label: 'cular' in molecular

result.description: Fires on ' identity' (occasionally ' image') when it follows 'brand' in marketing/branding text, as in 'brand identity'. Members detect brand, branding, identity and marketing words. Silent on generic business text without that phrase.
result.label: brand identity / brand image

result.description: Fires on the piece "ular" completing "vernacular", mostly in text about medieval languages and Latin. It also fires weakly on "ampl" in "amplify". Members are "ular" detectors plus language and Renaissance topic latents.
result.label: vernac-ular word piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' rem' when it starts a longer word such as remediation, remedial, reminder, remodeling or remnants. Members are mostly detectors of ' rem' and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: ' rem' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Lor" at the start of Lorenz or Lorentz (Lorenz attractor, Lorentz force), before the "enz/entz" continuation. Members are mostly detectors of " Lor" and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: " Lor" in Lorenz/Lorentz

result.description: Fires on the digit '2' when it begins a new number, such as the start of a year (2012, 2006, 2000s) or a list number. It stays silent on '2' in the middle of a year like 1982 or 1823.
result.label: Digit 2 starting a number

result.description: Fires on the suffixes 'ic' and 'ism' completing "symbol-" (symbolic, symbolism) in literary-analysis text. Silent on 'ic' in unrelated words like mosaic, stylistic, attic. Members detect symbol-stems and literature/narrative context.
result.label: symbol-ic / symbol-ism suffix

result.description: Fires on causative/light verbs like "making", "make", "keeping", and "ens(ure)", mostly after "for", "to", "and" or "about", where a verb phrase with an object or result comes next. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: make/keep causative verbs

result.description: Fires on the auxiliary/main verbs " have" and " has" right after a subject noun or pronoun (e.g. "every word has", "humans have"). Members detect have/has tokens and boost perfect-tense continuations like "been", "never", "always".
result.label: have/has after subject

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'ate' (donate), 'ions' (hydroxide ions), and 'accept' in acid-base chemistry about donating/accepting protons. Silent on 'ate' in non-chemistry words like accelerate or dictate. Predicts chemistry terms such as ide, charge, bond.
result.label: Acid-base chemistry donate/accept/ions

result.description: Fires on word-piece endings inside specific words, mainly "loyment" in "unemployment" and "rain" in "drainage". Members are detectors of those pieces plus job/economy context.
result.label: unemp-loyment / d-rain-age word pieces

result.description: Fires on the '0' digit right after a leading '2' in 21st-century years (2006, 2010, 2003). Silent on '0' in 1950s, 1980, or 19-0 decade forms.
result.label: Zero in 2000s year

result.description: Fires on the split-off token ' p' in the middle of a word, mainly the "p" of "pH" after a modifier like "high", "low" or "regulate". It is silent when "pH" starts the document, and it is weaker on "pump" and "pancakes".
result.label: ' p' piece before H (pH)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'abol' inside "metabolic/metabolism" (met-abol-ic). Weakly also on 'ine' in "delineation". Members are detectors of 'abol' and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: 'abol' in metabolic/metabolism

result.description: Fires on the opening parenthesis ' (' after a term, name or abbreviation, where an acronym, citation, example or gloss follows. Silent on the contrast text, where the parenthesis likely belongs to a date range. Members are mostly ' (' detectors.
result.label: Opening parenthesis after a term
Prefix ' super' before word continuation
result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' super' (occasionally ' semi' or ' avant') when it is a prefix awaiting its stem, as in superposition, supervised, superconduct. Silent on ordinary words without such a prefix.

Fires on the word piece ' ge' (or ' Ge') starting geo- words such as geographic, geodesic, geology, mostly in mapping and earth-science text. It predicts continuations like 'ographical' and 'ological'.
result.label: ' ge' start of geo- words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ility' completing the word "mobility" (e.g. "geographic mob-ility"). It also fires weakly on ' magnetic' in physics contexts. Members mostly detect 'ility' or the mob- prefix.
result.label: 'ility' in mobility

result.description: Fires on the word " accessible" (and weakly on similar endings like -ible), in phrases about accessible design, technology or facilities. Members detect "accessible", "accessibility", "available" and related words.
result.label: ' accessible' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'osc' in "chiaroscuro", the art technique of light and shadow. It is silent on other art text without this word piece. Members detect the earlier pieces ('iar') and similar word-piece fragments.
result.label: 'osc' in chiaroscuro

result.description: Fires on the piece 'it' inside the word "Antitrust" (Ant|it|rust), and weakly on other 'it'/'ing' word pieces. It stays silent on 'it' in words like "prioritize" or "competitiveness", so it needs the specific word context.
result.label: 'it' inside Antitrust

result.description: Fires on the word " approach" (rarely " strategy") when it follows an adjective or modifier, as in "a proactive approach" or "a holistic approach". It stays silent when " approach" starts the text with nothing before it.
result.label: ' approach' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on words meaning to make an effort, mainly " trying" and " attempting" (also "try", "attempt"), typically before "to" + verb. Upstream members are detectors of trying/attempt tokens.
result.label: trying / attempting to

result.description: Fires on the adjective ' diverse' when it modifies a following plural noun, such as perspectives, populations or students, mostly in inclusion and culture text. It was silent in one example where 'diverse' started the text.
result.label: ' diverse' before a noun

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-start piece " pl" (plural, plasma, plates, plastic), with weaker hits on " Arts" and "ental". Members are mostly detectors of " pl" tokens at the start of a word.
result.label: word-initial " pl" piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'opol' inside "monopol-" words (monopolistic, monopoly, oligopoly), after the "mon" piece. Members detect 'opol' and related mon- word pieces.
result.label: 'opol' in monopoly words

result.description: Fires on a digit (mostly 6, 7, 8, 5) in the middle or end of a multi-digit year or number in historical text, such as 144[6] or 16[7]8. It stays quiet on ordinal or fragment uses like "6th" and "1600".
result.label: Digit inside historical year

result.description: Fires on the word " coffee" (rarely " tea"), in phrases like "coffee bean", "between coffee or tea", "ritual coffee recipes" and "coffee-making". The contrast text contains no coffee word, so no further condition is evident.
result.label: coffee token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' sea' as a word or word-start, mostly in 'seafood' and also in 'sea level' or 'sea floor'. It is weak on related words like 'Marine'. Upstream members are mostly ' sea' detectors plus ocean and cooking features.
result.label: ' sea' token (seafood, sea level)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' inter' when it begins a longer word, mainly "interference", also "interplay" and "intervention". It stays silent on "interconnectedness", so it seems to need the continuation to be one of these words.
result.label: ' inter' prefix before ference/play

result.description: Fires on the word ' true' in logic text about propositions and truth conditions (e.g. "P is true whenever Q is true", "both propositions are true"). Silent on other logic-related text lacking this word.
result.label: ' true' in propositional logic

result.description: Fires on " reflected" (occasionally "captured", "represented") as a verb meaning that something mirrors or expresses another thing, e.g. "is reflected in", "reflected the spirit of". Members detect reflect/mirror words and passive-participle verbs.
result.label: ' reflected' verb token

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ining' completing the word "dining" (e.g. "fine dining", "casual dining"), in restaurant and food contexts. Members detect 'd' plus 'ining' pieces and cooking/food context.
result.label: "ining" in "dining"

result.description: Fires on mid-word subword pieces (Cyrillic or Arabic fragments like 'дова', 'ма', 'му') inside garbled or scrambled multilingual text. Members are mostly Arabic and Cyrillic character detectors. Peaks are scattered and weakly consistent.
result.label: Mid-word fragments in garbled Cyrillic text

result.description: Fires on the token ' typing' in programming-language type-system discussion, usually after a modifier such as static, dynamic, strong or weak. Members are mostly detectors of ' typing' itself, with programming-context members.
result.label: ' typing' in type-system terms

result.description: Fires on the piece 'c' inside "recon-c-iliation" (also 'cil'), and on the word " possibility" in abstract prose. Mostly silent on 'c' in other words like "transcends". Members detect 'c' in various prefixed words.
result.label: 'c' in reconciliation; possibility

result.description: Fires on the "iffs"/"iff" piece completing "tariff(s)" in trade and economics text. It is silent when "iffs" starts the document with no "tar" before it. Weak activation on a few other word pieces.
result.label: tariff word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' exper' when it is split off as the start of "experts", typically after a field or domain word (domain experts, language experts, HCI experts). Predicts a continuation like "ts".
result.label: ' exper' piece before "ts"

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'ant' inside the word "mercantilism"/"mercantilist" in lowercase form. It stays silent on the uppercase "MERCant" and on the quoted "merc-ant-ilism" example. Weak activation on 'phen' in phenomena.
result.label: 'ant' inside mercantilism

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ile' in capitalized "Agile" (e.g. "Agile frameworks/techniques") at the start of a document or title. It stays silent on lowercase "ag|ile" mid-sentence, so it needs the capitalized, document-initial form.
result.label: Capitalized 'Ag-ile' at text start

result.description: Fires on the single letter 'h' when it is a mid-word piece after a prefix like "Aest", "super", "Ab" or "Compre", mainly in "Aesthetic". It is silent on 'h' in other splits such as "shifting" and "cross-hatching".
result.label: 'h' piece inside Aesthetic

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' emphas' (start of emphasis/emphasize), in all of its uses. Upstream members are mostly detectors of ' emphas' itself, plus related words like focus and highlight.
result.label: ' emphas' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on ' May' as the first piece of a word like Maya/Mayan (Ancient May-ans), where the token is a word fragment rather than the month. Members detect ' May' and similar name or word beginnings.
result.label: ' May' as start of Maya

result.description: Fires on the token ' products' in business and marketing text, such as competitors offering similar products or services, or new products. Members detect product/products and marketing words like brand and campaign. It stays silent in a sustainability list.
result.label: ' products' in business context

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sust' (start of sustain/sustainable/sustainability), mostly after a verb or preposition like ensure, support, promote. Quieter when it begins a sentence or follows a comma or "more". Predicts "ain".
result.label: ' sust' word-piece start

result.description: Fires on "collection" and "acquisition" (the "quisition" piece) in data-gathering contexts, such as "data collection" or "data acquisition". It stays quiet on "collection" at document start with no data context.
result.label: data collection / acquisition

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' att' at the start of a word, as in "attentive", "attitudes", "attributable", "attained". It predicts word continuations such as 'raction', 'ribution', 'itudes'.
result.label: ' att' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the digit '1' when it starts a multi-digit number, such as a year (1907, 1960) or a leading number at document start. The next token is likely another digit. It stays silent on non-numeric text.
result.label: Leading digit '1' of numbers

result.description: Fires mostly on the 'o' in geological era names like Paleozoic, Mesozoic and Cenozoic. It also fires more weakly on 'ity' in equity, and on ' fair' in fairness or fair wages. It stays silent on 'o' in other words such as 'undoing'.
result.label: Paleozoic 'o'; equity/fair pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' inside a longer word, most strongly in "colloquialism" and "colloquial". Also fires in earthquake, antiquity and Iroquoian. It stays quiet on 'qu' in "Acquiring".
result.label: 'qu' inside colloquial-type words

result.description: Fires on ' and' directly after a verb (or verb list) joining two verbs, as in "detecting and detonating", "capture and transmit". It stays silent on ' and' after a comma joining clauses or list items of nouns.
result.label: ' and' joining verbs

result.description: Fires on the token ' hypothesis' after "null"/"alternative" in statistics text, and on the plural suffix 'ors' in "sensors". It stays silent on 'ors' in other words such as "motors" and "detectors".
result.label: 'hypothesis' and sensors 'ors'
"ous" in sentence-initial "Various"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ous" in "Vari|ous", especially when "Various" starts a sentence or document. It is silent on "ous" in other words such as "hazardous". Members detect "Vari-" and "variety/many" contexts.
Fires on ' and' right after an ordinal century or number like "15th" or "8th", in century-range phrases ("the 15th and 16th"). Silent on ' and' joining ordinary nouns or names.
result.label: ' and' after ordinal century

result.description: Fires on the word ' tool' (also 'tools', 'vehicle', 'instrument' pieces), mostly after an adjective like "grammatical" or "powerful" as a noun for a means or instrument. Promotes continuations like "kit" (toolkit).
result.label: ' tool' noun, toolkit predictor

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining two nouns or gerunds in technical or scientific text (e.g. "soil and rock", "stability and durability"). It stays quiet on some ' and' joining physics pairs like "stars and black holes" or "electricity and magnetism".
result.label: ' and' joining technical terms

result.description: Fires on ' to' that follows a noun object of providing/giving (support, assistance, subsidies, funds) and introduces a purpose infinitive ("to promote", "to buffer"). Silent on ' to' after verbs like "led to", "aim was to", "sought to".
result.label: Purpose 'to' after provided resources

result.description: Fires on the word piece " eth" at the start of words like ethnic, ethical, ethics, ethos, predicting a continuation such as "ical", "nic" or "os". Members are mostly detectors of " eth" and "Eth".
result.label: ' eth' word-start piece
'ers' in "designers"
result.description: Fires on the plural agent suffix 'ers' completing "designers" (weaker on researchers, builders). Silent on 'ers' in words like "stakeholders" or "fosters", so it needs the word-piece after "design".

Fires on the word-start piece ' introdu' (introduces) and sometimes ' contrib' (contributing), where a subject verb is split into pieces and the next piece is a suffix like -ces/-cing/-uting. Members detect ' introdu' and similar verb stems.
result.label: introdu- / contrib- verb stem

result.description: Fires on the final piece "is" of "emphasis" (also " attention", " focus") in phrases like "a greater emphasis on", where the next words name the thing being prioritized. Members detect emphas-/focus pieces.
result.label: emphasis-on noun completion

result.description: Fires on the word piece "rest"/"Rest" when it begins "restoration" (e.g. audio restoration, ecosystem restoration), predicting the suffix "oration/oring". Members are "rest" detectors. It stays silent on one "rest" at the start of a text.
result.label: rest- piece in restoration

result.description: Fires on plural nouns (isms, styles, movements, markers, models) ending an abstract academic noun phrase, e.g. "communication styles", "social movements". Silent on "isms" inside "organisms"/"mechanisms", so it needs a standalone plural noun, not a word piece.
result.label: Plural noun ending academic phrase

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ities' completing the word "opportunities" (e.g. job or educational opportunities). It stays quiet on 'ities' in other words such as priorities, identities and disparities.
result.label: 'ities' ending "opportunities"
'og' piece in "pathogen"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'og' right after 'path' in "pathogen(s)" and "pathogue". It is silent on other text, including the contrast passage. Members detect 'og' pieces in other words (orthogonal, phonograms, Moog), plus pathogen-related context.

Fires on the word ' electronic' (e.g. "electronic band theory", "electronic properties", "electronic states"), mostly as a modifier before a noun. Weakly fires on related pieces like 'spintronic'. Members are mostly 'electronic' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: ' electronic' word detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' Cal' when it starts a longer word (Caloric, Calvinism, calorimetry), seen mostly at the start of a document or title. Silent on other word-initial pieces in the contrast.
result.label: ' Cal' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' gr' when it begins "grill/grilling" (and weakly on ' urban'). Members are mostly ' gr' detectors from early layers. Predicts a word continuation after the piece.
result.label: ' gr' start of grill words

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' p' when it is a standalone symbol or prefix in technical text (p-norm, pH, pOH, pKa, p-1/2), and stays quiet when ' p' starts an ordinary word like punchline. Members are mostly ' p' detectors.
result.label: Standalone ' p' in math/chemistry

result.description: Fires on the 'ation' suffix in "penetration" (also "communication") and on 'asm' in "plasmids". It stays silent on 'ation' in words like innovation, escalation and automation, so it needs the specific word.
result.label: 'ation' in penetration, 'asm' in plasmid

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'et' (in -etric, genetics, phonetics) and 'ary' in "Literary" at the start of a heading. Members detect 'et'/'etic' pieces inside words like genetic, parametric.
result.label: Word-piece 'et'/'ary' in words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'iding' (also 'ides', ' guide', 'ering') inside "guiding"/"guide"/"steering" words, mostly in "guiding principle/guideposts". Members detect gu- plus guide-like endings.
result.label: guiding / guide word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' broad' (also ' wide') as an adjective after "a" or "have", right before nouns like "range" or "spectrum" ("a broad range of"). Members detect broad/wide/vast/diverse and similar scope adjectives.
result.label: broad/wide before range or spectrum

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments in the middle of longer multi-piece words, mostly 'mo' in "turmoil" and 'aph' in "metaphors", also 'ot' in "Mesopotamia". Members detect other word-piece starts like tur-b, bul, ibr, bo, cel.
result.label: Mid-word fragment in turmoil/metaphors

result.description: Fires on the first word-piece of a multi-token word (en-, trans-, b-, ad-, ste-) that starts right after "and" or "of" in a coordinated abstract noun phrase, e.g. "accountability and trans|parency". It is silent on ordinary text.
result.label: Word-start piece after "and"

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces of technical science words like ' cosm' (cosmology), ' nan' (nanostructure), and 'ost' within them, mostly in physics/cosmology text. Expects a continuation like -ological or -ostructure.
result.label: cosm-/nan- scientific word starts

result.description: Fires on the newline/document-separator token (¶) that ends a short line in a list of topic or course titles, such as "Political Geography Methods.¶". Silent when it is the very first token of the document.
result.label: Line break after list-item headings

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' after the stems "view" and "design" (also "decommission"), where the -ing word is followed by a noun or object. It stays quiet on 'ing' after stems like invest, cook and analyz.
result.label: 'ing' after view/design stems

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' ambigu' (start of "ambiguity"), and weakly on similar mid-word pieces like 'ar' in "molarity". Members are mostly ' ambigu' detectors. It stays silent when "ambiguity" is split differently or as a trailing "ity".
result.label: ' ambigu' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the verb ' explore' (occasionally ' examine') when used as a verb of study or inquiry, usually after a subject or "to/can". Members detect explore/expl- pieces and similar verbs like examine, describe, create.
result.label: verb "explore"

result.description: Fires on the token " rendering", mainly in computer graphics contexts such as "real-time rendering" and "volumetric rendering". Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token plus graphics and art words. It is silent on a graphics passage that lacks the word.
result.label: ' rendering' in graphics text

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' completing the word "organic" (organ|ic), as in organic matter, compounds or agriculture. It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as inorganic, metallic or penicillin.
result.label: 'ic' in "organic"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pers' when it begins "perspectives", after an adjective like new, global, fresh, or different. It stays silent when "pers" starts the document with no preceding word.
result.label: ' pers' in "perspectives"

result.description: Fires on ' community' used as a modifier or noun in phrases like "sense of community", "community spirit", "community events", "community engagement". Silent when it begins a possessive ("community's focus") at the start of a text.
result.label: ' community' in phrases

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces ' entertain', ' emphas' and 'agon' (as in entertainment, emphasis, antagonist), where the word is still incomplete and a suffix follows. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: entertain/emphas/agon word stems

result.description: Fires on the last piece of nouns naming measured quantities or results (assessments, outcomes, indices, targets, measures, data) in evaluation, metrics and statistics text, often where an "of" phrase follows.
result.label: Evaluation and metrics nouns

result.description: Fires on the word " protection" as a noun, mostly in technical lists of protection types or methods (overcurrent protection, forms of protection, corrosion protection). It stays silent in a general security-of-information context.
result.label: ' protection' noun token

result.description: Fires on the verb ' create' (rarely 'creating') in the middle of a clause, usually after 'to' or a modal, in writing and craft text. It is silent when 'create' begins the text with nothing before it.
result.label: verb 'create' after to/modal

result.description: Fires on word-start tokens like " super", " beautiful", " elaborate" (also elegant, abstract), often where the word is a prefix or intensifier that continues into a longer word (supernovae, beautifully). Members are mostly detectors of these tokens.
result.label: super/beautiful/elaborate word starts

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ial" inside words like confidentiality, factorial, inertial, and on " filled" (filled with). Also weakly on "accompanied" and "associated". Mostly a suffix-piece detector with a second, separate token.
result.label: "ial" suffix and " filled"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' break' when it begins a compound such as "breakthrough" (also "breakwaters"), predicting a continuation like "through". Members are detectors of ' break', 'breaking' and similar split/break words.
result.label: ' break' start of breakthrough

result.description: Fires on the token ' knowledge' as a noun, e.g. "the knowledge and skills", "apply new knowledge". Members are mostly early-layer detectors of ' knowledge' (and 'ledge', ' information'). No clear extra condition.
result.label: ' knowledge' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'ch' piece inside "crochet" / "crocheting" (after "cro"). It stays silent on 'ch' in other words such as "Etching" or "changing".
result.label: 'ch' in crochet
'ci' piece in "speciation"
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ci' inside "speciation" and related "speci-" words (speciatory, specid). Members mostly detect 'ci' itself. The contrast shows it silent on the ordinary word "specific".

Fires on manner/sequence adverbs such as "efficiently", "effectively", "safely", "eventually", "seamlessly" and the "-ently/-lessly" endings, usually before "and" or a verb. It also fires on the piece " rest" inside words like "restoration" and "restraint".
result.label: Manner adverbs and ' rest' fragment

result.description: Fires on plural abstract or technical nouns (values, coefficients, beliefs, effects, equations, species) ending a noun phrase in scientific or academic text. Logits weakly favour ' enough' and ' the', and suppress verbs like ' can' and ' may'.
result.label: Plural technical nouns in academic text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ain' in "att|ain" (attain, attainment, attainability). Members detect 'att' plus pieces like 'ent', 'rib', and 'ain' in other words such as "chain". It predicts suffix pieces.
result.label: 'ain' in "attain" words

result.description: Fires on an opening quotation mark (' " ' or " ' ") that starts a quoted word or title, especially in lists of example words or terms (e.g. "such as 'I',", "Animal sounds: 'roar'"). Silent on plain title text without quotes.
result.label: Opening quote before listed examples

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' cre' (creep, creatures, creativity), where the word continues in the next token. Members are mostly ' cre' detectors, plus an ' innov' detector. Silent on unrelated text.
result.label: ' cre' word-start piece

result.description: Fires mainly on the word-piece 'otic' ending words like "exotic" and "abiotic". It also fires weakly on 'ness' in "fairness" and 'be' in "globe". Upstream members detect 'otic' and similar mid-word fragments such as 'op' in "exoplanet".
result.label: 'otic' word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece " prevent" (also weakly " avoid"), mostly as the stem of prevention/preventive/preventing, in risk, safety and maintenance text. Members detect prevent/avoid/minimize stems.
result.label: ' prevent' stem token

result.description: Fires on the piece "actions" completing the word "reactions" (split as re + actions), in chemistry text such as redox, displacement or complexation reactions. It stays silent on "actions" in non-chemical contexts.
result.label: "actions" in chemical "reactions"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'l' ending the word "carbonyl" (chemistry text). Members detect 'l' in many other words (ml, coulometry, bottlenecks), but the target mainly needs the 'l' following "carbony".
result.label: 'l' in "carbonyl"

result.description: Fires on the piece 'osc' in 'nanoscale' (nan|osc|ale), after 'nan'. It stays silent on other nano- words like nanophysics. Members detect word-piece fragments in technical, materials-science words.
result.label: 'osc' in nanoscale
Non- prefix at word start
result.description: Fires on the prefix " Non" (and weakly " non") at the start of a word or title, such as Nonlinear or Nonverbal, often at the start of a document or heading. Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same prefix.
Fires on the word piece 'oth' in the middle of a word, e.g. end-oth-ermic, is-oth-ermal, hyp-oth-esis, bo-oth-s. It stays silent when 'oth' begins the text or word.
result.label: 'oth' word-piece inside words

result.description: Fires on the piece "ve" completing the word "evolve" (evol|ve). It stays silent on "ve" in "delve", so it needs the "evol" stem before it.
result.label: 've' ending of "evolve"

result.description: Fires mainly on " momentum", especially after "gained" (gained momentum) and in physics uses, with weaker firing on " of" after quantity nouns (abundance of, layers of) and "ance". Members mostly detect " momentum" itself.
result.label: momentum, esp. "gained momentum"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' inter' as a prefix starting words like interpersonal, interdisciplinary, interference, intersections. It is quiet on some ' inter' cases, such as 'interrelated' after 'how' and sentence-initial 'interplay'. Members are mostly ' inter' detectors.
result.label: ' inter' prefix token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (also 'izing') ending a gerund like "Uncovering" or "Discovering", mostly at the start of a title or heading. It stays quiet on 'ing' in mid-sentence words such as "drawing" or "investing".
result.label: Gerund -ing in uncover/discover titles

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces "wards" (re|wards) and "ments" (pay|ments), plus "reward"/"benefits", in economics, finance and incentive contexts. Silent on other text in the contrast.
result.label: reward/payment suffix pieces

result.description: Fires on plural noun endings 'ants'/'ors' completing technical words (react-ors, impl-ants, thyrist-ors) in science and engineering text. Silent on 'ants' in transplants, pollutants, assistants, so it depends on the specific word.
result.label: Plural suffix ors/ants in technical words

result.description: Fires on the token 'i' as a standalone variable index (player i, S_i) and as a mid-word piece in names and words (Gaugiugi, Bội, physiology, antibiotic). Quiet on whole-word name lists.
result.label: Letter 'i' token

result.description: Fires on the word " convergence" in mathematical analysis and topology text (pointwise, weak, uniform convergence of sequences). Upstream members mostly detect the same token plus math-context features. Only weak activation elsewhere.
result.label: ' convergence' token in math

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' when it completes the word "target" (targeting), mostly in marketing text. It stays silent on 'ing' in other words like marketing, positioning or responding.
result.label: 'ing' in "targeting"

result.description: Fires on the document-start/newline token (shown as ¶) that begins a new line or segment after a sentence or list item, such as lists of names or subjects. Silent on some document-start contexts, so it needs a specific position.
result.label: Line-break/document-start token after list items

result.description: Fires on the token ' datasets' (occasionally 'work' in 'groundwork' or 'it' in 'necessitates'), mostly after adjectives like large, vast or complex in machine-learning and data text. Members detect dataset, database and data tokens.
result.label: ' datasets' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "od" inside "flo|od" (floodplain, flood activity, floods), and also in "Ge|od|etic". It needs the split-token form of the word. Weaker firing on " equ" pieces.
result.label: "od" piece in flood/Geodetic

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'emes' completing "morphemes" (and similar linguistic terms like lexemes) in linguistics text. Silent on 'emes' inside the unrelated "meth-emes" in the contrast.
result.label: 'emes' ending of morphemes

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' cul' when it starts "culinary" mid-sentence, usually after "the", "and" or an adjective. It stays silent when ' cul' is the first token of the document.
result.label: ' cul' in culinary, mid-text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ist' or 'ide' right after 'ep' inside words like epistemology, epistemic and epidemiology. It stays silent on '-ist' suffixes after other stems (foundationalist, contextualist).
result.label: ist/ide piece after 'ep-'

result.description: Fires on the 'ch' piece in "etching" (et|ch|ing), including plasma and art etching. It stays silent on 'ch' in other words such as "epoch". Members detect 'ch' and 'et' pieces.
result.label: 'ch' in "etching"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' pot' when it begins a longer word like potassium, potatoes or potentiometry. It is silent on a document-initial 'potentiometric', so it needs a preceding context word.
result.label: ' pot' as start of longer word

result.description: Fires on varied tokens in technical text about classifying things (organisms, animals, forms) and on closing parentheses of function notation like F(n). Members detect classification, species, math and statistics terms. Silent on many ')' tokens.
result.label: Classification nouns and function-notation parenthesis

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'onom' in "ergonomic/ergonomics", after "erg". Weakly fires on similar mid-word pieces like 'oust' in "acoustics". Members are detectors of 'onom' and of similar technical word fragments.
result.label: 'onom' in ergonomics

result.description: Fires on the word piece " expect" when it begins "expectations" (e.g. "societal expectations"), mostly after an adjective or noun modifier. Members are mostly detectors of "expect" and related stems like expected and depend.
result.label: "expect" in expectations

result.description: Fires on the suffix "ing" completing the word "accounting" (after "account"), including in accounting standards or principles. It stays silent on "ing" in other words such as ensuing, keeping, or encouraging.
result.label: "ing" in "accounting"

result.description: Fires on the word "zero" (and "Zero"), in math contexts such as "zero-sum", "non-zero", and "times zero results in zero". Members are mostly detectors of the token itself. Silent on nearby text that doesn't contain it.
result.label: the word "zero"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' po' (poets, poetic) in literary-writing text about poetry and Romantic writers, and weakly on other incomplete word starts like ' Bla', ' cont', ' inher'. Predicts word continuations.
result.label: ' po' word-start in literary text

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' compet' (competitive, competitors, competencies) mid-sentence, predicting suffixes like 'itive' or 'itors'. It is silent when ' compet' begins the text, as in a heading.
result.label: ' compet' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the noun ' understanding' (also ' grasp') when it follows an adjective like deep, basic, intuitive or thorough and is the head noun of "understanding of X". It is silent when "understanding" is a verb-like gerund, as in "to understanding the nature".
result.label: noun 'understanding' after adjective

result.description: Fires on the digit '2' when it starts a number: at the start of a document, as the leading digit of a year (2000s, 2001, 21st), or in a section number. It stays silent when '2' is a later digit inside a number, as in 1820, 1927 or 1235.
result.label: Digit '2' starting a number

result.description: Fires on the single-letter token 'y' as a word-final or split piece, most strongly in linguistic terms like hyponymy, antonymy, meronymy. It stays silent on 'y' in other words such as Cauchy, mastery, controversy.
result.label: Word-piece 'y' in -onymy terms

result.description: Fires on ' for' directly after a noun or gerund head, as in a title or heading ("Preparing for", "Design for", "Respect for"), where it introduces a purpose or object. It stays quiet on ' for' after "allows" or "crucial".
result.label: ' for' after a noun/gerund head

result.description: Fires on the word ' other' used as a determiner before a plural noun, after a preposition or conjunction ("with other", "and other", "for other"). It stays silent on the reciprocal "each other".
result.label: ' other' as determiner, not reciprocal

result.description: Fires on ' On' (and sometimes ' At') as a capitalized word-initial piece at the start of a document or heading, e.g. "On June 1" or the start of "Onboarding"/"Atmospheric". Weakly fires on a document-initial ' In'.
result.label: Document-initial ' On' / ' At'

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ator'/'ators' (also 'ation') right after the word piece 'pred', as in predator/predators/predation. Members detect 'ator' and the 'pred' prefix. Weakly fires on ' drive'.
result.label: 'ator' in "predator"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'qu' inside multi-piece words, mostly 'earth|qu|ake' and also 'anti|qu|ity' and 'Iro|qu|oian'. Weaker on a few other word fragments (osp, proxim). Members are mostly 'qu' detectors.
result.label: 'qu' piece in earthquake

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ed'/'ized' completing participial adjectives like "underrepresented", "marginalized", "endangered", mostly before a noun about groups or data. It stays silent on 'ed' in other words like "aimed", "witnessed", "renewed".
result.label: -ed ending of underrepresented/marginalized

result.description: Fires on the token " combinations" (and weakly " combination"), mainly in mathematical or counting contexts such as permutations and combinations. Members include detectors of combinations, selection, arrangement and pairs.
result.label: ' combinations' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " govern" (as in governance, governments, govern) when it is the start of a longer word, mostly in corporate or IT governance text. Members are mostly detectors of "govern" itself.
result.label: ' govern' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on a full stop that ends a sentence or heading-like phrase, often in abstract expository text, where a new sentence or section is about to start. It stays silent on periods inside abbreviations like "e.g." and "etc.".
result.label: Sentence-ending period, not abbreviations

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ough' in "tough-" words, mainly fracture toughness/toughity in materials engineering text. Members detect 'ough' (also in dough). Weaker on other mid-word fragments like 'ult' or 'ien'.
result.label: 'ough' in toughness

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' expl' at the start of explore/exploration/exploring, especially when the model must continue it as "-oration" or "-oring". Members are mostly ' expl' detectors, with a few for similar pieces (purs, elev, exam).
result.label: ' expl' piece of explore/exploration

result.description: Fires on ' tone' and ' voice' as nouns for a writer's or speaker's style or manner (narrative voice, formal tone). Silent on 'tone' in a list of nonverbal cues like gestures and tone variations.
result.label: tone / voice as style noun

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' c' (space plus lowercase c) as a split-off fragment, mostly in technical or scientific text such as 'c' before 'athodes' or 'ement', and also in variables like c1, c2, cn. It pushes toward completions like 'ater' or 'rav'.
result.label: Standalone ' c' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'win' (in "Twin", "Darwin") and 'ry' (in "embryonic", "Dry", "Symmetry"), mid-word in a split word. Weak on other fragments like 'son' and 'les'.
result.label: Word-piece 'win' / 'ry' mid-word

result.description: Fires on abstract idea nouns (idea, assumption, notion, concept) right after "the", where a clause or "of/that" complement follows, mostly in academic or philosophical text. Silent when "idea" is used as a modified noun in a compound.
result.label: Abstract idea nouns after "the"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " organ" as the start of organic/organism/organic chemistry words (also a few "ational" in "Rational"). Members are mostly " organ" token detectors; the contrast text has no such piece.
result.label: " organ" word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' pr' when it begins a split word, mainly "pricing" after a pricing-strategy modifier (penetration, cost-plus, competitive, value-based). Predicts "icing" next. Weakly on other split pr-/opt- pieces.
result.label: ' pr' piece in "pricing"

result.description: Fires on the word ' view' (verb or noun, including 'viewing' and 'viewpoint') in academic discussion of differing opinions or perspectives, e.g. 'some view', 'another view'. Silent on text lacking the word.
result.label: ' view' as opinion/perspective
Word-piece 'eb' in eyebrow, ' Lap'lace
result.description: Fires on the mid-word pieces 'eb' (in eyebrow, eyeball) and ' Lap' (in Laplace), plus occasionally ' anom' in anomalies. It needs the piece to sit inside those particular words, where the word continues after it.

Fires on the word-final piece "ology" in academic field names such as musicology, ethnomusicology, sociology, microbiology and homology. Weakly fires on similar endings like "-istry". Silent on list headings without such a suffix.
result.label: "-ology" suffix in field names

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments ' particip' (participate/participation) and 'val' in 'prevalence', where the word is incomplete and a suffix is expected. Silent on ' particip' at document start, so it needs preceding context.
result.label: particip- / preval- word fragments

result.description: Fires on the token ' maintain' (including the stem in 'maintaining' and 'maintainability'), wherever it appears. Members are mostly detectors of the same token and its pieces, and the output boosts words like 'ing'.
result.label: ' maintain' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " changes" (also "modifications", "-ations") when it follows a preceding word or adjective such as "subtle", "important" or "structural" and is followed by "in/to". It is silent when "changes" starts the text.
result.label: ' changes' after a modifier

result.description: Fires on the word piece "function" when it is a prefix inside "non-functional" or "bi-functional", right before the suffix "-al". It also weakly fires on other word-start pieces such as "rot" or "irre". It stays silent on other text.
result.label: "function" before -al (non-functional)

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments like ' et' (as in etching), ' fib' (fibers) and ' particle' that begin a longer word split into pieces, mostly in art or materials text. Silent on unrelated physics text.
result.label: Word-start fragments: et(ching), fib(ers)

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ent' in "prevalent" (e.g. "became more prevalent"). It stays silent on 'ent' in other words such as inherent, underwent, incumbent. Members detect the preceding "preval" piece and the 'ence'/'ent' endings.
result.label: 'ent' ending of "prevalent"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'inter' when it is a prefix inside a longer word, most strongly in "slope-intercept" and "y-intercept". It is silent on 'inter' in "interfaces". It predicts continuations like 'pret' and 'ferences'.
result.label: 'inter' in slope-intercept

result.description: Fires on the 'ff' piece in "graffiti" (also 'gra'+'in'/'pp' pieces) and on the word " both". Two distinct triggers; the 'ff' case needs the "gra" prefix.
result.label: 'ff' in graffiti, and ' both'
' of' after "form"/"mode"
result.description: Fires on ' of' directly after the noun "form" (or "mode"), as in "form of", "a form of communication". It stays silent on ' of' after other nouns like evolution, merging, example, advent.

Fires on a hyphen or en dash separating items in a sequence of numbers or codes (e.g. 45-45-90, 4.5-1.4-2.5, chord letters). It stays quiet on hyphens inside prefixed compound words like semi-, half-, avant-.
result.label: Hyphen between numeric sequence items

result.description: Fires on the word " sampling" in statistics and research-methods text (probability, random, stratified, cluster sampling). Members detect sampling, sample, population and random tokens.
result.label: ' sampling' in statistics methods

result.description: Fires on the piece 'it' completing the verb "elicit" (elic|it), as in "capacity to elicit emotions". It is silent on 'it' in other words like "prioritize". Members detect the "el-/elic-" prefix pieces.
result.label: 'it' in "elicit"

result.description: Fires on adjective-forming suffix pieces like -able, -ous, -ual at the end of a word, especially in economics or abstract terms such as "non-excludable" and "non-rivalrous". Silent on "nebulous", so it depends on the word.
result.label: Adjective suffixes -able/-ous/-ual

result.description: Fires on the piece 'itation' completing the word "meditation", mostly in spiritual or yoga practice text. Weak activation on a few other word-final pieces like 'asing' and ' language'. Upstream members detect 'itation' and meditation-related pieces.
result.label: 'itation' in meditation

result.description: Fires on the word " population" (also "populations"), most strongly in statistics and sampling text such as "sample representative of the population". Members mostly detect the token itself, plus statistics and sample context.
result.label: ' population' token, statistics context

result.description: Fires on the prefix ' super' (also 'tele', 'Super') when it is a word-start piece that continues into a longer word like superposition, supernova, supervised or superconductor. Members are mostly detectors of this token.
result.label: 'super' prefix piece

result.description: Fires on the comparative adjective ' larger' (size comparisons, e.g. larger apertures, atoms, samples), mostly in technical or scientific text. Members detect size and comparative words like larger, smaller, more, greater, vast.
result.label: ' larger' size comparative

result.description: Fires on the word " success" (also "successes", occasionally "implementation(s)"), mostly in business or case-study text about achievements. Members are mostly detectors of success/successful and related words such as efficiency and fail.
result.label: ' success' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " approach" (also " approaches"), both as a noun for a method and as a verb meaning to get near, as in functions approaching a value. Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: ' approach' token detector
Algebra/math words like simpler, expressed
result.description: Fires on varied words in algebra and equation-solving text, such as "simpler", "expressed", "variable", "-able" endings and "expressions". Members are mostly math-topic detectors (algebraic, equation, solutions). Logits are unclear.
Fires on the suffix 'ing' in "trad|ing" (trading solutions, algorithmic trading, currency trading). It stays silent on 'ing' ending other verbs such as streamlining, spreading or disrupting.
result.label: 'ing' completing "trading"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'it' in "Lim|it" of "Central Limit Theorem". It stays silent on 'it' inside other words such as facilitating, necessitating, or Fit, so it needs that specific word.
result.label: 'it' in Central Limit Theorem

result.description: Fires on the word "leadership" (and the "-ership" piece in "Leadership"), mostly in management or organizational text about leadership styles. Members are detectors of leadership/leader tokens.
result.label: Leadership word detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' part' when it follows a form of "be/become/as" and starts "part of" (e.g. "is part of", "as part of"). Members are mostly ' part' detectors plus similar words like subset and sort.
result.label: ' part' in "part of" after be

result.description: Fires on ' root' (also ' node', ' child', ' branch') as a part of a tree data structure, e.g. "the root node" or "smaller than the root". Weak on other tree-like terms. Silent in generic text about trees without these structure words.
result.label: Tree data structure root/node

result.description: Fires on adverb/adjective suffix pieces (-fully, -ly, -ively, -ed, -ful, -anned) ending a descriptive participle or adverb in marketing-style text, e.g. "thoughtfully organized", "powerfully executed", "well-planned".
result.label: Adverb/participle suffix in descriptive phrases

result.description: Fires on a hyphen (or en dash) joining the first part of a compound, especially after "decision" or "cap" (decision-making, cap-and-trade), plus occasionally " desired". Stays quiet on hyphens in other compounds like data-driven, well-received, long-term.
result.label: Hyphen after decision/cap compounds

result.description: Fires on the word piece "con" in "misconceptions" (after "mis"), mainly in education or explanatory text. It stays silent on "con" at the start of a document or after "pre" in "preconceived".
result.label: "con" in "misconceptions"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "inary" completing "imaginary", mostly in math contexts where imaginary parts are paired with real parts. Weaker on other "-inary" or "-ic" endings such as "interdisciplinary" and "mosaic".
result.label: "inary" in "imaginary"

result.description: Fires on the 's' token of a possessive after a noun or name (Shakespeare's, Theme's, Orwell's), mostly in title-like text. It stays silent on plural 's' as in 1960s or depths.
result.label: Possessive 's after noun

result.description: Fires on past-participle or adjective-like words (controlled, guaranteed, possible, -ured) that follow a noun or "made/under" and can take a "by" agent next. Members detect passive participles like identified and viewed.
result.label: Passive participles like controlled, guaranteed

result.description: Fires on the negating prefix " un" / " Un" as a separate token starting a word like unproven, unsupervised, unpredictable. Members are mostly " un" detectors. Silent on text without such a prefix.
result.label: Word-initial "un" prefix token

result.description: Fires on the word "market"/"Market" (any case), in business and economics text such as marketing strategy lists, "market share", "labor market". Members are mostly market-token detectors plus brand/competition context.
result.label: Word "market" in business text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'omed' in "Biomedical" when the word is capitalized after "Bi" (e.g. document-start titles like "Biomedical Optics"). Silent when 'omed' starts a fragment without the "Bi" prefix.
result.label: 'omed' in Biomedical

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' s' when it begins a split word, mostly the 's' of "sophisticated" after "more" or "highly". It predicts continuations like 'oph'. It stays silent after verbs such as "explored".
result.label: ' s' starting "sophisticated" after more

result.description: Fires on the end of plural "challenges"/"obstacles"/"issues" (e.g. 'es', 'acles') after quantifiers like "numerous", "various", "several" in formal expository text about facing difficulties. Silent when "challenges" is the sentence subject without such a lead-in.
result.label: plural challenges/obstacles after "numerous"

result.description: Fires on nouns meaning scenarios or cases (' scenarios', ' cases', ' scenario'), especially after modifiers like best/worst/average/hypothetical, in analytical or algorithm-analysis text. Weaker on 'situations'.
result.label: scenarios/cases noun after modifier

result.description: Fires on quality adjectives after "more" (sophisticated, precise, accurate, robust), especially the "ated" of "sophisticated". Stays silent on "ated" in words like automated, calibrated, elevated.
result.label: Sophisticated/precise comparative adjectives

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'om' in "monomers" (also 'anch', 'ed') in technical chemistry words split into pieces. Silent on 'om' in "elastomers" or "omny", so it depends on the specific word, especially "mon-om-ers".
result.label: 'om' piece in monomers

result.description: Fires on the token ' here', including when it is quoted or discussed as a word (e.g. "alone here", "here's"). It is also built from detectors of 'there' and 'again'. It stays silent on other deictic words like 'these' and 'those'.
result.label: Token ' here'

result.description: Fires on the token " hash" (or " Hash") in computer-science text about hash functions, tables and maps. Members are mostly hash-token detectors plus data-structure context latents. The contrast is a different topic with no hash token.
result.label: ' hash' in hash tables

result.description: Fires on "sensitive" (and "sensitivity" pieces), mostly in "highly sensitive" instruments/detectors in scientific or technical text. It also fires more weakly on "sensitive data". It is silent on unrelated cryptography text.
result.label: "sensitive" / sensitivity token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "acc" in "vaccine/vaccination" (v-acc-ine), right after "v". Members are mostly "acc" detectors in the same vaccine contexts. The contrast, where the target is silent, has no "acc" token.
result.label: "acc" piece in vaccine

result.description: Fires on the word piece "onym" inside words like synonym, antonym and homonym, after a prefix such as syn-. It stays silent when "onym" starts the text with no preceding prefix.
result.label: 'onym' in synonym-type words

result.description: Fires on the hyphen right after a single-letter "p" (p-norm, p-value, p-n junction), where a letter or variable is followed by a hyphen. It stays silent on hyphens after words like non-, double-, cross-.
result.label: Hyphen after letter "p"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ep" (Ep) as a prefix inside words like epic, epics, epitheses, epidemic, epistemic. It is silent on one "epistemic" example at the start of the text, so it may need a preceding word.
result.label: " ep" word-start piece (epic)

result.description: Fires on the token " existence" (and weakly on pieces like "istence"), mostly in philosophical or logical text about being, existence theorems or God's existence. Members are mainly detectors of existence and related abstract nouns (presence, possibility, death).
result.label: ' existence' token detector

result.description: Fires on frequency/generality adverbs such as "typically", "generally", "frequently" and "usually" placed before a verb in expository, academic-style prose. These often come right after a plural subject, as in "systems typically include".
result.label: Frequency adverbs like typically

result.description: Fires on the token ' p' (a word-initial p piece with a space) when it follows a word like "the" or "as" and begins a longer word or a symbol, e.g. p-norm, pragmatism, pinnacle, pivotal, pH. It stays silent on ' p' at the start of a document.
result.label: ' p' word-start piece mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ization' (also 'ized') when it completes "democratization". It stays silent on 'ization' after other stems such as commercial-, digit-, ideal- and personal-. Members detect the democrat- stem and the suffix.
result.label: -ization in "democratization"

result.description: Fires on the word " job" (rarely " jobs") used as a modifier before a noun, as in "job creation", "job search", "job market". The silent contrast text has no "job".
result.label: ' job' as noun modifier
'or' inside "rhetoric"
result.description: Fires on the piece 'or' in "rhet-or-ic" (rhetoric), in text about persuasion and writing. It stays silent on 'or' in other words like rigorously, theorems or moreover.
Fires on mid-word pieces like 'ced' in "unprecedented" (also 'par' in "transparency", 'pre'), where the word is unfinished and the next piece is a suffix such as -ented, -ency, -ity.
result.label: Mid-word 'ced' in unprecedented

result.description: Fires on the word "hash"/"Hash" in computer-science text about hash functions, hash maps and hash keys. Members include hash-token detectors plus data-structure and algorithm context such as tree, table, complexity and database.
result.label: "Hash" in data-structure text

result.description: Fires on "force" completing the word "workforce" (work + force), in business and planning text. Members detect "work" followed by a word piece, and "force" itself. Weak on a few unrelated word pieces.
result.label: 'force' in 'workforce'

result.description: Fires on word endings of "perception" forms: the plural 's' in "perceptions", and "ived" in "perceived" (also "ception"). Silent on plural 's' in other nouns like "norms" or "contexts".
result.label: Perception/perceived word endings

result.description: Fires on word pieces after "qu" or "At" in split words: "ark"/"arks" in quark(s) and "mos" in Atmospheric. Silent on whole words like "neutral currents". Members are detectors of "ark" and similar mid-word pieces.
result.label: ark/mos mid-word pieces (quark, Atmospheric)

result.description: Fires on the word " patterns" (also " behavior"/"iors") as a head noun after a scientific or technical modifier, such as flow patterns, behavioral patterns, wave behavior. Silent on unrelated science text without such a noun.
result.label: ' patterns' after technical modifier

result.description: Fires on "reduced"/"reducing" and related reduction words (decreasing, minimize), mostly as a modifier or verb in technical or environmental text about cutting emissions, waste or costs. Predicts words like waste, greenhouse.
result.label: reduced / reducing words

result.description: Fires on the word piece "avel" inside "wavelength(s)", after "w". Upstream members are mostly detectors of this same piece. It predicts the continuation "ength".
result.label: "avel" in wavelength

result.description: Fires on assorted rare word fragments and foreign-language pieces (e.g. 'ampa', ' Germania', ' dah', 'cito', ' où', 'std'), mostly early-layer token-piece detectors. No single token or meaning dominates; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Miscellaneous rare token fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ch' when it begins the word "chord" (geometry or music), e.g. "least ch|ord", "longest ch|ord". Weak elsewhere on other ch- starts like chase or chains. Silent on circle text without the piece.
result.label: ' ch' start of "chord"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " prefix" (and prefix-like pieces such as "refix", "ix" in suffix/infix) in text about affixes and word formation; weaker on " challeng" stems. Predicts suffix endings like -es, -ed, -ix.
result.label: prefix word piece (affix talk)

result.description: Fires on the word " attention", mostly in "pay (close) attention" and similar phrases about focus or listening. Members are mainly early-layer detectors of the " attention" token. Weak firing on " regard" and " distinction".
result.label: ' attention' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " attack" (also " threat", " attacks") in cybersecurity and threat-modeling text, e.g. "attack vectors", "attack scenarios", "threat modeling". Predicts plural/related noun continuations like " attacks".
result.label: attack/threat in security text

result.description: Fires on the word " effective" as a modifier, especially after "for" or "in" before a noun like communication or negotiation. It predicts communication-related nouns next. The one contrast text lacks the token.
result.label: " effective" before communication nouns

result.description: Fires mainly on the token " red" (also "Red") in many contexts such as red-black trees, red flag and redshift, and on "break" in "outbreak". Two tokens dominate, with weak edge cases.
result.label: ' red' and outbreak 'break'

result.description: Fires on the suffix of review/examine/scrutinize-type verbs (review-ed, review-ing, scrutin-ize, investig-ating) and on "Study" or "review" in analysis-focused text. It stays silent on 'ed' in other verbs like "directed" or "aimed".
result.label: Review/examine verb endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' ret' when it begins a word, especially after "memory" in "memory retention". Also fires weakly on other word-start pieces such as ' res' in "resilience". Mostly in cognition and brain-health text.
result.label: ' ret' word-start piece (memory retention)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments of multi-piece words, such as 'emp' in unemployment, 'chni' in Techniques, ' Num', ' circum', and a backslash before a Greek letter in trig formulas. Mixed and weak; mostly word-start pieces needing a continuation.
result.label: Incomplete word-piece fragments (emp, chni)
'ment' in pigment
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ment' when it ends a split-up science word, mainly 'pigment' (also 'fermentation'), so it's the 'ment' piece in these words. It is silent on other text, including the contrast passage about algae.

Fires on word-start fragments ' din' (diners) and ' ing' (ingredients) split into pieces, in food and cooking text. Silent on the whole word "dining". Members include cooking-topic and ' ing' detectors.
result.label: din-/ing- fragments in food text

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'es' completing a plural noun, mostly 'themes' in literary or mythological discussion. It stays silent on verb 's' endings like 'encompasses' or 'focuses' and on plural 'challenges'.
result.label: 'es' ending of 'themes' plurals
Digit 7 in 1700s year
result.description: Fires on the digit '7' as the hundreds or tens digit of a year or date range, mostly 17xx or 197x, as in "1727 to" or "1973-1". It stays silent on a final '7' in years like 1870, 1987 or 1847.
Fires on the suffix piece 'ives' completing the word "perspectives" (after "perspect"). Also fires weakly on similar endings like "directives". Members are mostly 'ives' detectors.
result.label: 'ives' ending of perspectives
