result.description: Fires on adjectives meaning "main/central" (' main', ' core', ' primary') placed after "the" or a number before a noun like idea, verb, or parts. It anticipates a head noun such as concept or notion.
result.label: "main/core" modifier before noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ance'/'ances' completing a noun like dissonance, consonance, sibilance, balance. It stays silent on 'ance' in the verb 'enhance'.
result.label: -ance noun suffix (dissonance)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ided' in "coincided" (as in "coincided with"), after "coinc". Members mostly detect 'ided' or ' coinc' tokens.
result.label: 'ided' in "coincided"

result.description: Fires on the token ' conscious' when it is the first piece of 'consciousness' (e.g. "nature of conscious|ness"), in philosophical or mind-related text. Members mostly detect ' conscious' itself in earlier layers.
result.label: ' conscious' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on a function word (' in', ' of', ' to', ' that') right after "way(s)" or "means", introducing how/what something does ("ways in which", "way to", "means that"). Silent on ' in' after other words like "found" or "essential".
result.label: Preposition after "ways"/"means"

result.description: Fires on the word "two" (also "two-" compounds) as a count modifier in technical or math text, e.g. "any two points", "two-dimensional". Predicts pair-like nouns such as points, ends, identical, consecutive.
result.label: "two" before paired things

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ody' completing "melody" (also weakly on "melod-ies"). Also fires on 'ody' in "prosody", so it mostly depends on the preceding word piece. Members are 'ody' detectors plus music-word members.
result.label: 'ody' in melody

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ually" in "mutually", mainly in "mutually exclusive" in probability text. Members detect "mut" plus "ual/ually/ation" pieces. It is silent on other contexts without this word.
result.label: "ually" in "mutually"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mainly ' ferm', ' Id' (Idioms), ' Reyn', ' therm'. Predicts continuations like 'od', 'os', 'ison'. Mixed tokens, with weak and varied members.
result.label: Word-start fragments (Id, ferm, therm)

result.description: Fires on word-start fragments that are incomplete and likely continue into a longer word, mainly ' Disc' (before overy), 'ought' in "drought", and ' Jacques'. Peaks on varied pieces, with drought-in-title contexts strongest.
result.label: Word-start fragments: Disc, drought, Jacques

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'active' when it completes a prefixed word such as Inter-active, re-active, pro-active, radio-active or in-active. Members are mostly 'active' token detectors.
result.label: -active suffix after prefix

result.description: Fires on the prefix token ' un' beginning an un- word (unparalleled, unforeseen, uncovering, unsupervised), especially after verbs like uncover/unlock/unveil or "previously". Quieter on unrelated tokens.
result.label: ' un' prefix token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' emp' (empowers, employs, empire), and weakly on ' consist' and ' accur', after a noun or conjunction in abstract or technical text. It predicts continuations like 'ower' and 'ately'.
result.label: ' emp' word-start fragment

result.description: Fires on adjective suffixes, mostly 'ous' (strongest in "simultaneous"), also 'ive' and 'al', ending a word. Members detect 'ous' and concurrency-related pieces. It stays quiet on 'ous' in other words such as "advantageous" and "equidistanous".
result.label: Adjective suffix 'ous', esp. simultaneous

result.description: Fires on the word "Media" / "media", most strongly when it starts a line or heading in a list of media-planning steps (Media Measurement, Media Scheduling, Media Buying). Weaker on "media" in running text about PR or marketing.
result.label: Media as heading word

result.description: Fires on the token ' Monte', mainly in "Monte Carlo" (methods, simulation, casino). Members include detectors of Monte and Carlo plus assorted word-start pieces. Predicts name continuations such as Carlo.
result.label: ' Monte' in Monte Carlo

result.description: Fires on the word piece "eth" (also " eth") as a fragment inside words like bioethics, ethical, ethers, ethnic, methylation, polyethylene. It is silent on unrelated text, and predicts continuations like "nic", "yl" and "ical".
result.label: "eth" word-piece fragment
' addresses' after IP
result.description: Fires on the token ' addresses' (rarely ' handles'), mostly as the plural noun in networking contexts like "IP addresses". Members detect address/addresses tokens. Silent in the contrast, which has no such token.

Fires on ' the' after a preposition or "that" (e.g. "along the", "of the", "states that the") mostly in mathematical or physics-style text. Members are mostly ' the' detectors; it favours nouns like same, latter, first next.
result.label: ' the' after preposition, technical text

result.description: Fires on the word "area" (area/Area/areas), most strongly in geometry contexts like surface area or area of a segment, and more weakly for "areas" meaning regions. Members are mostly detectors of "area" tokens.
result.label: Word "area" token detector

result.description: Fires on the standalone letter ' L' used as a symbol or variable, such as the Lucas number L(n), L1/L2 Lagrange points, or L_n in math formulas. It stays silent on the word "Lucas" in prose.
result.label: Letter L as math symbol

result.description: Fires mainly on the contrastive conjunction "while"/"whilst", especially after a semicolon introducing a contrasting clause. It also fires weakly on some Arabic word endings and separators. It pushes toward "also", "still" and "others".
result.label: Contrastive 'while' conjunction

result.description: Fires on 'ized' in "characterized" (as in "characterized by"), mainly in academic or scientific text. It stays silent on 'ized' in other words such as specialized, decentralized and urbanized.
result.label: 'ized' in "characterized"
'person' in first-person narration
result.description: Fires on ' person' when it completes "first-person", "second-person" or "third-person" in talk of narrative point of view. Members are mostly detectors of 'person' after a hyphenated ordinal, plus narrative and writing context.

Fires on the word piece ' intent' (as in "intentional", "intention") and occasionally 'craft' in "Spacecraft". It predicts the continuation 'ional'/'ions'. Members are mostly detectors of intent/intention tokens.
result.label: ' intent' word-start before -ional

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ruit' in "recruitment" (rec|ruit|ment), after 'rec'. Members are mostly 'ruit' detectors plus recruitment/job-related context. It stays silent on talent-management text without that split word.
result.label: 'ruit' in recruitment

result.description: Fires on the word right after a "more/greater/larger/smaller than" comparison, where a quantity, unit or noun is expected (e.g. "greater than 180 degrees", "smaller than the vast bulk"). Silent on "degrees" outside comparisons.
result.label: Word completing "than" comparison

result.description: Fires on the piece 'sh' completing the word "harsh" (e.g. "harsh environments"). It stays silent on 'sh' in other words like "workshops", so it needs the 'har' prefix before it.
result.label: 'sh' in "harsh"

result.description: Fires on the adverb ending of continuity-type manner adverbs, mostly "continuously" (continu|ously), also "continually", "constantly", "quickly", before a verb like monitoring or evolving. Quiet on text without such adverbs.
result.label: Continuously/constantly adverb endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece " dec" when it starts a word that continues as "isions" (decisions), mostly after "managerial", "those", "economic" in business text. It predicts "isions".
result.label: " dec" start of "decisions"

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens: 'gs' in Higgs, ' blue' (blue dwarfs, blue collar, blueberry), and 'ues' (as in blues). Mostly a mix of 'blue'/'Higgs' piece detectors; the evidence is mixed.
result.label: Higgs 'gs' and 'blue' tokens

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces like 'itory' in "auditory", 'cient' in "Ancient", and 'od' in "commodities". Members mostly detect 'itory'/auditory and hearing-related pieces. It is silent when 'itory' starts a text fragment without the preceding "aud".
result.label: 'itory' in auditory; word pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on " LED" (also " mechanical", "rical") in technical/facilities text about lighting, energy and equipment, where the next word is likely a facility or system noun like "lighting". Members detect LED and light tokens.
result.label: LED lighting term

result.description: Fires on the token " II" as a Roman numeral label after a name or term, such as "Type II" errors or "Prophase II". Many members are detectors of " II" and similar numerals. Silent on contrast text with no such numeral.
result.label: Roman numeral II after term

result.description: Fires on nouns or word pieces such as "structure", "approaches", "techniques" and "-atives" that follow narrative or storytelling terms (frame story, narrative). Quiet on "structure" in a film-editing context. Members mostly detect story, narrator and character words.
result.label: Narrative-structure nouns in storytelling text

result.description: Fires on the word "health"/"Health" (including as the start of "Healthcare"), often at a document or list-item start or after words like "public" or "economic". Pushes the next token toward "care". Silent on other list-heading words like "Media".
result.label: health token, predicts "care"

result.description: Fires on US state and city names (Colorado, Florida, Philadelphia, York), mostly inside comma-separated lists of states or places. Some weaker firing on Arabic word pieces and nationality words. The contrast shows it silent on 'Erie' in a railway context.
result.label: US state names in lists

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ity' completing "cardinality" in set-theory text. It stays silent on 'ity' in other words like continuity, uniformity or modernity. It pushes towards set/space-related continuations.
result.label: 'ity' in cardinality

result.description: Fires on the 'ps' piece that completes "DevOps" (after Dev-O), in software and IT-process text. Supporting members detect Dev/O/ps pieces and related terms like code commits, release and continuous improvement.
result.label: 'ps' ending DevOps

result.description: Fires on the head noun after "the" in operating-system text, mainly " kernel", " OS" and "ernel", and sometimes other nouns like "vehicle" or "hole". It stays silent on general system-call text that doesn't name the kernel or OS.
result.label: OS kernel noun after "the"

result.description: Fires on scope-type adjectives like " native", " global", " local" and " International" that modify a following noun (native speakers, global datums, international trade). Members detect native/local/speak and language words. Silent on marketing headings.
result.label: Scope adjectives: native, global, international

result.description: Fires on the word right after "as much" (mostly the second " as", also " a", " of", " detail") in equative "as much X as" comparisons. Silent on other uses of "as" like "as easy as" or "as well as".
result.label: Token after "as much" comparison

result.description: Fires on ' with' right after "deal/dealing" (dealing with X), and also on word pieces like ' ancest' (ancestry/ancestors) and ' jour'. Silent on ' with' after nouns like "problems with".
result.label: "dealing with" and ancest- pieces

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'zym' inside "enzyme"/"enzymes" (en-zym-e), mostly in biochemistry text on enzyme kinetics. Members include 'zym' detectors and biology-term members. Predicts the ending 'e'/'es'.
result.label: 'zym' piece in enzyme

result.description: Fires on the word piece " comp" when it is a mid-text prefix following a modifier (e.g. "IT comp", "phenolic comp", "hyphenated comp"), predicting a continuation like "ounds" or "liance". Silent when " comp" starts the document.
result.label: ' comp' prefix after modifier

result.description: Fires on word pieces of humor and laughter words, mostly ' laugh' (laughter), also ' jo' (joke) and 'edic' (comedic), where the word is incomplete and a suffix follows. Members detect laugh/humor/comedy tokens.
result.label: Laugh/joke word beginnings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ur' inside "entrepreneur(ial/ship)", right after "entreprene". Silent on 'ur' in other words such as "heuristics". Predicts suffix continuations like 'ship' and 'ial'.
result.label: 'ur' in entrepreneur

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " mit" (as in mitochondria, mitosis, mitral, mitigation), when it begins a longer word. Members are mostly " mit" detectors. Weak activation on a few other word-start pieces like "aph".
result.label: word-initial " mit" piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ological" completing a word like biological, physiological, geological or technological, mostly in science text. It also fires weakly on " micro". Many members detect "ological" itself.
result.label: "ological" suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the word "zone" or "zones", especially plural, in climate or geography text such as "polar zones" or "these zones". It is silent on the contrast text, which has no zone token.
result.label: zone / zones token

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'zym' inside "enzyme/enzymes/enzymatic", after "en". It is silent when 'zym' starts the text with no "en" before it. It predicts suffix pieces like 'ans', 'atic'.
result.label: 'zym' in enzyme

result.description: Fires on the word piece " ens" in "ensured/ensures" (also " ensure", " requires", "must") when it begins the word after a space. It stays silent when "ens" follows a noun directly with no space, as in "principles ensures".
result.label: " ens" of ensure(s)/ensured

result.description: Fires on adjectives like physical, mental, functional, semantic that name a position in philosophy of mind or language (e.g. before -ism), predicting 'theory', 'school' or 'philosophy'. Silent on 'physical' in ordinary non-philosophical text.
result.label: Philosophy-of-mind adjective before -ism/theory

result.description: Fires on the word "both" (also "Both"), mainly when it introduces a pair of coordinated items or properties, e.g. "are both prominent examples". It stays silent in "function as both a…". Members are mostly "both" detectors.
result.label: the word "both"

result.description: Fires on word pieces that start or sit mid-word in a longer word or name, such as ' Norman' (before Conquest/French), ' comb' (combustion), ' Cort' (Cortés) and 'ich' (clichés). It seems to predict a word continuation.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (Norman, comb, Cort)

result.description: Fires on the separate word-piece ' un' used as a negating prefix split from the following word (e.g. "unturned", "unannounced", "unattended"). Members are mostly ' un' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: Split ' un' prefix token

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ete" in "Detection" (split as D-ete-ction), especially in "Intrusion Detection Systems". Members are detectors of the same "ete" piece plus other mid-word fragments.
result.label: "ete" in "D-ete-ction"

result.description: Fires on ' factors' and ' variables' (also ' parameters') when they follow a modifying adjective such as external, environmental, independent or controlling. It tends to predict "such"/"like" next, which introduces examples.
result.label: Factors/variables after modifier adjective

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'istic' in "linguistic", in texts about language, heritage and communities. Members include 'istic' detectors and language-word detectors (lingu, language). It stays silent on the words "language" and "languages" themselves.
result.label: 'istic' in "linguistic"
'ition' in pract-ition-ers
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ition' in "pract|ition|ers" (also 'itime' in "maritime"), where the word continues into a suffix like -ers. It stays silent on 'ition' in "intuition". Predicts 'ers'.

Fires on " responsibility" (occasionally " duty") in ethics and philosophy text, especially after "moral" or "ethics and". Members include responsibility/duty token detectors plus philosophy and ethics topic members. It pushes toward duties, obligations and similar words.
result.label: responsibility/duty in moral philosophy

result.description: Fires on the token ' board' in corporate governance text (board members, board meetings, board effectiveness). Silent on a governance passage that doesn't contain the word. Members are mostly ' board' detectors.
result.label: ' board' in corporate governance

result.description: Fires on the third digit ('4' or '6') of a year starting with 1, as in 1450, 1603 or the 14th century, in early modern or Renaissance history text. It stays quiet on digits in other positions or in other years, such as 1860, 1726 or 476 CE.
result.label: Third digit of 1400s/1600s years

result.description: Fires on the token " fabric" (literal textile or figurative "fabric of society"), with minor firing on " elev" in "elevated" and similar word pieces. Members are detectors of fabric, thread, material and related textile words.
result.label: " fabric" token detector

result.description: Fires on the prefix ' hyper' when it begins a word, especially before pieces like -bole, -box, -bolic or -parameter. Weakly fires on other word-start pieces such as 'ron' in macronutrients.
result.label: ' hyper' word-start prefix

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " Protest" (as in Protestant/Protestantism), with a few hits on " Communic" and similar word-start fragments. Silent on related religious text without that piece.
result.label: Protest- word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word " machine" in technical and academic text, mostly as the start of "machine learning" after prepositions like "of", "in", "for". Weakly fires on " computer" in "field of computer science". Members are detectors of machine and ML terms.
result.label: ' machine' in machine learning

result.description: Fires on a hyphen inside a compound term, mainly after "Wi" (Wi-Fi) and "Cross" (Cross-Validation), predicting a capitalized continuation like "Fi". Silent on hyphens in other compounds such as higher-order or device-to-device.
result.label: Hyphen in Wi-Fi / Cross-Validation

result.description: Fires on the final piece "ence" in "adherence" (also "adhering"), in compliance text where "to" follows. It stays silent on "ence" in other words like "resilience".
result.label: adherence (adher-ence) before "to"

result.description: Fires on connectors (" and", ",", " or") joining items in a pair or list, especially after bare nouns like titles or "X vs." lists in literary conflict types. Silent on many ordinary " and" tokens in running prose.
result.label: Coordinating and/comma between list items

result.description: Fires on word pieces like 'ber' (as in cy-ber-security), 'мо', 'мен' inside words, often in garbled or Cyrillic text. Members detect security/attack terms and 'ber'. Output pushes toward 'security'.
result.label: 'ber' in cyber- word pieces
' una' before 'uthorized'
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' una' (start of "unauthorized") in security text, usually after "against", "prevent", "from". It predicts the continuation 'ut' (uthorized). Members are mostly ' una' detectors plus security-topic features.
Fires on the word piece 'du' inside split words, mainly in "trans-du-ction", "trans-du-cers" and "-du-ality". Members are detectors of 'du' and similar mid-word pieces (bul, val, ra, cript).
result.label: 'du' piece in transduction

result.description: Fires on the word piece after "imm" (mostly 'ers' in immersive/immersed, also 'ort' in immortality), where the word is being built from "imm-". It stays silent on 'ers' in other words like fosters, listeners, philosophers.
result.label: 'imm' + ers/ort word piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' b', mostly as a variable name in math expressions (b0, b̂, a^3 - b^3, f(a, b)). Weaker on ' b' starting words like bite or bogs. Predicts word continuations like 'ating'.
result.label: ' b' variable token

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " Rec" at the start of a capitalized title or heading word, such as Recovery or Recognition. It predicts a continuation like "overy" or "ogn". Silent on ordinary lowercase text.
result.label: ' Rec' word-start in titles

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' dess' at the start of "dessert(s)", when it is split into pieces. Members include dessert-piece detectors and food/cooking context. The next-token logits are not informative.
result.label: ' dess' piece of dessert

result.description: Fires on word pieces in the protect/shield/respect family (' shield', ' protect', 'pect' in "Respect"), often mid-word before a suffix. Members detect protect/shield tokens; silent on related ethics text without these words.
result.label: protect/shield/respect word pieces
'ance' ending in consonance-type words
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ance' when it completes a noun like consonance, assonance, sibilance, resonance or transmittance. It stays quiet on 'ance' in 'enhance' and 'relevance'.

Fires mostly on the token " equipment" (also "ep" in "creep"), especially as a noun after modifiers like kitchen, protective or high-level. Members include several " equipment" detectors. Silent on unrelated food-hygiene text.
result.label: ' equipment' noun detector

result.description: Fires on the 'th' (or 'TH') ordinal suffix after a numeral, mainly in century expressions like "16th–17th century". It is silent on one "20th century" example, so what separates the cases is unclear.
result.label: Ordinal 'th' before century

result.description: Fires on the token piece "active" as a word ending, especially in "proactive", "reactive", "interactive" and "radioactive". It is weaker on standalone "active". Most members are detectors of "active" in earlier layers.
result.label: "active" word-ending piece

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'il' inside words such as mercantilism, libilist, vigilance, resilient, quilters, and the start of "Soil". Members are mostly 'il' token detectors in early layers.
result.label: 'il' word piece

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments ' cy' (cytochrome, cycling, cyber) and ' gu' (guild, guidelines) when the word is split into pieces and more of the word must follow. Members are detectors of ' cy', ' Cy' and ' gu' tokens.
result.label: Word-start fragments ' cy' / ' gu'

result.description: Fires on "physical" and word-ending pieces like -ical/-ible (non-physical, tangible, Physical-ism) in philosophy-of-mind talk about physical versus mental. Silent on "-ical" in "philosophical". Predicts abstract nouns like existence, reality.
result.label: physical / tangible in mind-matter contexts

result.description: Fires on abstract noun endings like ' duration', ' intensity', and 'ation' (e.g. exclam-ation, punctu-ation) in grammar and language-usage text, especially in lists of properties such as duration, frequency, intensity.
result.label: duration/intensity/-ation nouns in grammar text

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' split off as a separate token after a verb stem (overflow-ing, sunbath-ing, bow-ing), often in gerund lists or noun-like uses. It stays quiet on 'ing' in some other words like recurring, mastering, posing.
result.label: Split-off 'ing' suffix after stem

result.description: Fires on the word right after "since" (mostly " the", also " its", " then", or a space before a year), where a time reference like a century or year is expected. Silent on " the" after other words.
result.label: Word after "since" (since the…)

result.description: Fires on the abstract-noun slot in flowery openers like "Within the intricate and multifaceted realm/canvas/landscape/world of...", at the start of a document. It is silent on "realm" later in a text.
result.label: Ornate "realm of" opener noun
'ce' inside pharmaceutical
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ce' in "pharma|ce|utical(s)", where the next piece is likely 'ut'. It also fires weakly on 'ce' in similar splits like sauce and Oceania, and on 'hr' in unusual names.

Fires on word-initial fragments in technical science text: 'bo' in carbohydrate, ' disp' in displacement/dispersion, ' cond'. Predicts continuations like 'lacement', 'ersion', 'ensed'. Needs the piece to be an incomplete word start.
result.label: Word-start fragments: bo, disp, cond

result.description: Fires on the piece after "Fin" in "finance"/"financial" ('an', 'ance'), mostly in finance text. It stays silent on 'ance' in other words such as "enhance" and "undance".
result.label: Fin- word piece in finance

result.description: Fires on the token ' tender', especially when repeated or in lists of cooking descriptors (tender meat, tender vegetables). Members include cooking/food detectors and ' tender' token detectors. Weakly fires on ' colon' before 'ization'.
result.label: ' tender' in cooking text

result.description: Fires on the noun ' impact' when it is the head noun at the start of a phrase like "impact of X", and it predicts "on" or "upon". It stays silent when 'impact' is a verb or a plural form ("impacts").
result.label: noun ' impact' (impact of/on)

result.description: Fires on the word "motion" (also "Mot|ion") in physics and mechanics text, such as laws of motion, planetary motion and equations of motion. Members are mostly detectors of "motion", "velocity" and "Newton".
result.label: "motion" in physics contexts

result.description: Fires on the token " pressure" in physical or technical text (atmospheric, differential, hydrostatic pressure). Members are mostly detectors of " pressure"/"press" itself. Weakly fires on " equilibrium" in chemistry.
result.label: ' pressure' token detector
'cis' in 'exercises'
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'cis' in 'exer|cis|es', and less on 'ations' in 'Equations'. Members detect 'cis' and the following 'es' of 'exercises'. Weakly active on 'impre|cis|ible'.
Fires on ' to' right after "continue/continues/continued" (continue to + verb). It stays silent on ' to' after other words such as "leading to", "used to", "responding to".
result.label: 'to' after continue

result.description: Fires on the word-initial piece ' h' when it starts a split word, mostly 'hormone/hormonal' after words like thyroid, steroid or producing. It also fires weakly on ' h' in 'hinges' and 'hug'. It is silent when the whole word 'hormone' is not split.
result.label: split ' h' starting hormone

result.description: Fires on the piece 'igen' inside "epigenetic/epigenetics/epigenome" after "ep". Silent on 'igen' in "tumorigenesis", so it needs the ep+igen word start.
result.label: 'igen' in epigenetic

result.description: Fires on the token ' vocal' in texts about singing and voice anatomy or technique (vocal cords, vocal technique, vocal instrument). Weakly on other music words like 'musical'. Silent on non-vocal music text.
result.label: ' vocal' in singing/voice text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ound' inside "surroundings" (system and its surroundings), with weak activation on 'ly' in "subtly". Members are detectors of 'ound' and related word pieces.
result.label: 'ound' in surroundings

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ending" (also "end", "ends") completing "bending" of light or sound waves in physics text. Mostly the "-ending" piece after "b"; silent on other physics contexts without this word.
result.label: "b-ending" word piece (bending)

result.description: Fires on the word right after a form of "made" (made it, made possible, made significant strides, made from/up of). Silent on "it" after other verbs like "making it" or "applied it".
result.label: Word following "made"

result.description: Fires on the word piece "atch" in "hatch/hatching" (art shading technique, e.g. cross-hatching), after "h". Members are mostly "atch" detectors plus art-related context.
result.label: "atch" in hatching

result.description: Fires on the word " new" (also " New") as an adjective before an abstract noun like perspectives, developments, opportunities or era, mostly in technology and progress text. It stays silent on a " new" at the start of a text fragment before a technical term.
result.label: ' new' before abstract nouns

result.description: Fires on the token '2' that begins a year or century (2000, 2010, 20th) right after "late", "mid", "early" or "following the". It stays silent on '2' inside multi-digit numbers like 1823 or 1982.
result.label: Leading '2' of a year after late/mid/early

result.description: Fires on the last word piece of a noun phrase after "period(s) of" plus an adjective (e.g. "periods of cultural prosper-ity", "economic transformation", "global history"). Weak elsewhere; silent on "-ity" in words like diversity or clarity.
result.label: Noun ending after "periods of ..."

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ul' (also 'ur') right after "ins" in words like insulators, insulin, insurers. Silent when 'ul' starts a text without the "ins" before it.
result.label: 'ul' after 'ins' (insulator)

result.description: Fires on ' on' in "depending on" / "depends on" (varies depending on X). Weaker on "dependent on". Silent on ' on' after nouns like reliance, impact, or in other prepositional uses.
result.label: 'on' in "depending on"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " sym" (and rarely " nov") when it begins a longer word, mostly "symplectic" after "of" or "the realm of". Members are mostly " sym" detectors and similar word-start pieces.
result.label: " sym" word-start fragment (symplectic)

result.description: Fires on words expressing sameness or standardization (consistent, uniform, uniformity, standardized, -ity/-ized endings), mostly in text about standardization of language or orthography. Members detect "standard", "consist-ency" and "-ization" pieces.
result.label: Consistency/uniformity/standardization words

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'th' (at the start of these/those) and 'bit'/'bits' (as in qubits, orbitals), i.e. short fragments mid-word or at word starts. It stays silent on 'th' in 'back-and-forth'.
result.label: 'th' and 'bit' word fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' correct' as the stem of correct/correcting/corrective/correctness, as in fixing errors. Members are detectors of 'correct' and of error or mistake words. Silent on a nearby passage about fixing missing values that lacks the token.
result.label: ' correct' word stem

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ism' (also 'ian', 'ist') completing movement or doctrine names such as Naturalism, Humanism, Victorian, Modernist, in literary and art-history text. Silent on some other -ism words like individualism and materialism.
result.label: -ism suffix of movement names

result.description: Fires on function words (mostly ' in', also ' can', ' to', 'the') right after "change/changes/changing", where the next word names what is changing (e.g. "changes in society"). Silent on ' in' after other words.
result.label: function word after "change"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' con' at the start of a longer word (consonance, congestion, converse, connotation), when it is a prefix that will be completed by a following piece. Predicts continuations like 've', 'cludes', 'ferences'.
result.label: ' con' prefix word-start

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' completing "pedagogical" (after "pedagog"/"agog"), in education and teaching text. It stays silent on 'ical' in other words such as "ethical" and "lexical".
result.label: 'ical' in pedagogical

result.description: Fires on ' left' (also ' leave') as a verb after "have/has", as in "civilizations have left a lasting impact". Silent on the contrast text, which has no such verb. Members mostly detect 'left'/'leave' tokens.
result.label: ' left' as verb after have/has

result.description: Fires on word pieces right after the prefix "ex" (ex+op, ert, oth, ch, clam, cret), mid-word in words like exoplanets, exerted, exothermic, exchanging. Silent on other text without this ex- prefix split.
result.label: Word pieces after "ex" prefix

result.description: Fires on ' query' (mostly in database "query processing/execution/optimizer" text) and on 'urr' in words like concurrency/hurricane. Members are mostly detectors of query/queries/Query and 'urr'. The logits are mixed.
result.label: ' query' and 'urr' token detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ulate' completing a verb, most strongly in 'articulate' (also regulate, stimulate, emulate). Members detect 'ulate'/'ulation' pieces and the 'artic' prefix. Silent on the earlier 'art of speech' text.
result.label: 'ulate' ending in articulate

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' hon' when it begins a word like "honesty", predicting a continuation such as 'esty'. Weaker on similar word-start fragments like 'cru'. Silent on ordinary text without such a fragment.
result.label: ' hon' word-start fragment (honesty)

result.description: Fires on the word " noise" in technical text about acoustics, signal processing and noise reduction or filtering. Weaker on " stress" in materials contexts. Members detect noise, sound and reduction words.
result.label: ' noise' in acoustics/signal text

result.description: Fires on thoroughness adjectives before a noun, mainly the "ensive" piece of "comprehensive" and also " thorough", " detailed", " extensive". It appears in descriptions of analysis, documentation or understanding.
result.label: Comprehensive/thorough/detailed adjectives

result.description: Fires on the token " over" when it is used as a prefix piece starting a word (overlays, overstating, overly, overturn), often after a comma or word boundary. The logits favour word-continuation pieces like 'atch', 'laps', 'vest'.
result.label: ' over' as word-initial prefix

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " consum" when it begins "consumers" (also "consumables") in marketing and business text, mainly after words like "to" or "helped". Weaker on a few other word-start pieces such as "tail" and "medi".
result.label: " consum" word-start in consumers

result.description: Fires on mixed tokens: 'est' inside words like interest/uninteresting/Aesthetic, sentence-initial ' After', and 'adows'. Silent on 'est' in superlatives or 'modest'. Members detect 'self', 'est' and 'After'. Logits are unclear.
result.label: 'est' word-piece and initial After

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ism' (also 'ink', 'ion') mid-word in 'charismatic', where a suffix is followed by a continuation like '-atic'. Stays silent on 'ism' ending words like Romanticism or authoritarianism.
result.label: 'ism' inside 'charismatic'
'ber' in reverberation
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ber' inside "reverberation" in acoustics text. It also fires weakly on ' audience' after "engage with". Members are mostly detectors of 'ber' after "rever".

Fires on varied tokens (project, for, allocated, equipment, on, against) in cost accounting and budgeting text, after cost/expense words. It seems to predict budget or finance terms next, such as budget, allocated, overhead and dollars.
result.label: Cost accounting and budgeting context

result.description: Fires on the word " logic" or " logical" (also "ical"/"ic" pieces) in discussions of formal logic, such as propositional, predicate, or first-order logic and logical connectives. Silent in unrelated analytic text.
result.label: logic / logical in formal logic

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ement" completing "refinement", in text about iterative improvement and development. Weaker on "improvement" and "evolution". Members detect "refin-" stems and "ement" pieces.
result.label: "refinement" suffix 'ement'
' celebr' word-piece detector
result.description: Fires on the word piece ' celebr' (start of celebrate, celebration, celebratory, celebrating), in text about diversity and community. It predicts suffix continuations like 'ation' or 'ity'. Members are mostly detectors of this piece and similar word-start fragments.

Fires on a colon after a title, heading, name or label that introduces a following subtitle or description (e.g. "Book Cover Design:", "Political Ideologies:"). Also fires on colons inside times. Silent on a colon at the very start of a text.
result.label: Colon after title or heading

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ac' inside "saccharides" (polysaccharides, disaccharides, monosaccharides), where the next piece is 'char'. Only weakly on 'ac' in other words.
result.label: 'ac' in saccharide words

result.description: Fires on the piece 'omen' inside the word Phenomenon/Phenomenology/Phenomenal, after 'Phen'. It predicts suffixes like 'ological' and 'ology'. It is weaker on ' phenomen' as a whole token.
result.label: 'omen' in Phenomen- words

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ives" in "adject|ives", mostly in grammar-lesson text about adjective types. Weakly on "as" in "persu|as|ive". Members include "ives" detectors and grammar-term latents such as clause, verb and subject.
result.label: "ives" in "adjectives"

result.description: Fires on the token " board"/" Board" in the sense of a governing body of directors (board members, Board of Directors, board independence). Weakly fires on " group". Silent in a nearby committee text lacking the word.
result.label: board (governing body) token
Crop 'ps' in agriculture text
result.description: Fires on the 'ps' piece ending "crops" (also ' agricult', 'farming') in agricultural writing about planting and cover crops. Members detect 'ps' and agriculture word pieces; it stays silent on general land-use text.
Fires on the word piece 'vent' in "inter-vent-ions" (also 'Mat' in Matisse). It stays silent on 'vent' in "unconventional", so it needs the inter- prefix context.
result.label: 'vent' in interventions

result.description: Fires on ' Nash' (and 'Equ' in Nash Equilibrium) in game-theory text, supported by members detecting players/games and Nash tokens. Weak activation on a few unrelated tokens.
result.label: Nash equilibrium in game theory

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'iveness' completing the word "responsiveness" (after "respons"). It stays silent on "effectiveness", where the same suffix follows "effect". Members detect the "respons-" stem and -ive/-ance suffix pieces.
result.label: responsiveness suffix 'iveness'

result.description: Fires on the token right after the word piece "red" (mostly the hyphen in "red-black tree", also "red" + "ist/es" pieces), predicting color words. Silent on hyphens after other prefixes such as re-, self-, or decision-.
result.label: hyphen after "red" (red-black)

result.description: Fires on the token ' set', most strongly as a noun in mathematical set-theory text (power set, empty set, universal set). Weaker on the verb use ('have set records', 'rates set by'). Upstream members are mostly ' set' token detectors.
result.label: ' set' token, set theory

result.description: Fires mainly on " lean" as in lean manufacturing/lean software, and also on " circular" (circular economy), in efficiency, waste and sustainability-management text. Silent on generic AI text.
result.label: lean / circular management adjectives

result.description: Fires on measurement nouns such as distance, diameter, intervals, ratio and angle, mostly in math or geometry text about metrics and measurement. It is quiet on a materials-science passage about volume and temperature.
result.label: Geometric measurement nouns (distance, diameter)

result.description: Fires on the mid-word piece 'ess' (also 'clusion', 'oul') inside longer words, most strongly in names like Hessian, plus chess, politeness, quintessence. Members mostly detect 'ess' itself. Predicts word continuations like 'ential'.
result.label: 'ess' word-piece mid-word

result.description: Fires on the word " rates" (also " rate") as a noun after a modifier such as exchange, floating, fixed or reaction, mostly in finance and economics text. Members detect rate, currency, exchange and derivatives words before it.
result.label: " rates" after finance modifiers

result.description: Fires on " carefully" (and the "cur" in "carefully curated", "scr" in "scrutinizing") when it comes before a participle or verb of selecting or choosing. Members detect "careful/carefully" and selection words. It predicts words like "planned" and "selects".
result.label: carefully before selection verbs

result.description: Fires on the word ' radius', mostly as a noun after "the" in geometry text about circles and diameter. Weakly fires on ' density' in physics text. Silent on atomic-size text without the word.
result.label: ' radius' noun in geometry

result.description: Fires on ' of' after a percentage or quantity/portion word (80%, 90%, much, half), as in "90% of mass". Stays silent on ' of' after abstract nouns like day, advent, combination, fluidity.
result.label: ' of' after percentages/quantities

result.description: Fires on the word-piece ' curv' (as in curvature) in math/geometry text, mostly as the first piece of a split word. Weak activation on other word-initial fragments like 'cc', 'fin', 'Few'. Predicts word-continuation pieces.
result.label: ' curv' prefix of curvature

result.description: Fires on the word " presentation" when it refers to how food or things are visually presented, in culinary or aesthetic text. Members include presentation-token detectors plus cooking and food topic latents. Predicts design and typography words.
result.label: ' presentation' in food/visual context

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'cret' in "discrete/discretization", also ' strat' (stratigraphy) and 'rig'. These are incomplete word pieces that predict a suffix like 'ous', 'ation' or 'ified'.
result.label: 'cret' word-piece in discrete

result.description: Fires on ' desert' after climate/biome adjectives (hot, cold, frigid, subtropical) in geography text, and on 'rial' in 'terrestrial'. Silent on the contrast text about regions and vegetation. Members include desert, climate-zone and habitat detectors.
result.label: desert after climate adjective; terrestrial

result.description: Fires on function words (' of', ' with', ' in', ' that') in formal, time-focused text, especially after time expressions like "mid-decade" or after "adoption". It stays silent on ' of' after nouns like "history", "integration" or "trajectory". Evidence is mixed.
result.label: Function words after time or adoption phrases

result.description: Fires on the word ' new' as an adjective introducing novel things (new era, new technologies, new approach), often after 'of' or 'a'. Silent in 'setting new standards'. Many members are ' new' detectors.
result.label: ' new' before novel nouns

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ist"/"ists" inside the word "linguist(s)" (also "linguistically"), supported by members detecting language/linguistics words and "-ist" pieces. Weak on other -ist words like "structuralist".
result.label: "ist" in linguist

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece ('a', 's', 'es') ending a plural word, most strongly the 'a' in "corpora" after "corpor". Silent on contraction 's (it's, what's). Members detect corpor- pieces and plural endings.
result.label: Plural suffix, esp. corpor-a

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ce' completing a word, mostly in "scarce" (also sauce, Oceania, terrace). Weaker on word-ending pieces like 'ology' in homology and on ' gives'.
result.label: 'ce' ending in scarce

result.description: Fires on word-unit nouns like "phrases" (phr-ases), "words", and "pronunci-" in text about grammar, syntax and language. Language/linguistics members support it; it stays silent on general grammar text without such tokens.
result.label: Linguistics units: phrases, words

result.description: Fires on past-tense auxiliary verbs (' been', ' was', ' were', ' had') after a subject, in historical or expository prose. It predicts adverbs like 'previously', 'originally', 'once', 'formerly' next.
result.label: Past auxiliary before adverb

result.description: Fires on the word "atom" / "atoms" in chemistry and physics text, mostly the plural. Members detect atom, atomic, molecular and chemistry words. Silent on a passage about atomic structure that lacks the word itself.
result.label: atom / atoms word detector

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'utes' (in "constitutes"), ' ont' (ontological) and ' determin' (determinant), mostly in abstract philosophical text about what constitutes reality. Also weakly on 'ont' in "consonant".
result.label: constit-utes / ont / determin pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ator"/"ators" at the end of agent nouns, most strongly in "mediator", also in negotiators, facilitator, estimators, numerator. Members are mostly detectors of this suffix token.
result.label: -ator suffix in mediator

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ot' completing "knot" (kn|ot), mostly in knot-theory text. Silent on 'ot' inside "homotopy". Members are mostly 'ot' detectors, also firing on Rob|ot.
result.label: 'ot' in "knot"
'eg' in electronegativity
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'eg' in "electronegativity" (and related forms like electronegative). It weakly fires on ' Bor' in "Borel" and a few other word pieces. Members mostly detect 'eg' after 'electron'.

Fires on the word piece "meas" and related words such as measure, measurement, measuring and metrics, where quantifying or assessing something is meant. Members are mostly generic token detectors with little specificity.
result.label: measure / metrics word family

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'eth' right after 'm' in words like methane, methylation, methalates (also 'st' in cry-st-allization). Silent when 'eth' starts a fresh word after a period, so it needs the preceding 'm'.
result.label: 'eth' after 'm' (meth- words)

result.description: Fires on the token " process" (and " processes") as a noun, mostly in business, organizational or technical contexts like "onboarding process" or "process improvement". Members are mainly detectors of the token "process" in early layers.
result.label: ' process' token detector

result.description: Fires on plural data-collection nouns like "databases", "datasets", "documents", "volumes", especially in technical text about data storage and analysis, e.g. after "relational" or "document". Silent on unrelated technical text.
result.label: Databases/datasets plural nouns

result.description: Fires on the word "mathematical" and on the "ical" piece completing "Mathematical", especially in lists of math-topic titles. Members detect "Mathemat", "ical" and "mathematical" tokens. Silent on abstract philosophical text without the word.
result.label: Mathematical / Mathemat-ical word

result.description: Fires on ' Num' in math-topic list headings where a name precedes it (Stirling Num|bers, Lucas Num|bers), predicting the continuation "bers". Also weakly on 'hole' and mid-word pieces in mathematical terms.
result.label: Num in "[Name] Numbers" headings

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'est' in the middle of a longer word, mostly 'mil|est|ones' (also 'liv|est|ock', 'bright|est'). Members detect 'est' and 'estone' pieces; it stays quiet elsewhere.
result.label: 'est' piece inside milestones

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'asc' in 'vascular' (including cardiovascular), where 'v' precedes it. Members are detectors of 'asc' and similar word-start fragments like 'acc' in vaccines.
result.label: 'asc' in vascular

result.description: Fires on the token ' Hall' in quantum Hall effect physics text (quantum Hall effect, Hall resistance, Hall conductance). Members are mostly ' Hall' detectors plus physics/electron-related context features.
result.label: Hall in quantum Hall physics

result.description: Fires on a few specific words, mainly ' moral', ' budget' and ' Block'/' block', especially when they are modifiers before a noun, as in "moral arguments" or "zero-based budget". Peak words are mixed, and the logits are unclear.
result.label: moral / budget / block word

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a heading-like title that begins a new line: 'oge' in "Biogeographic" and ' St' in "Stellar", both at the start of a title. It needs a word-initial fragment that continues into a longer word.
result.label: Word-start fragments in headings (Bi-oge, St-ellar)

result.description: Fires on the word-piece 'ise' completing words like merchandise (also tortoise, premise, concise), and weakly on 'ands' in brands. Many members are 'ise' detectors, plus marketing and brand context features.
result.label: 'ise' suffix in merchandise

result.description: Fires on the digit completing a mid-20th-century year or decade (19[5]0s, 19[0]0s, 199[0]s) and on "computer"/"computational" in computing-history text. Silent on 2000s-era years like 2005 or 2015.
result.label: Mid-20th-century decade digits, computer

result.description: Fires on the word " fiction", especially after a genre word (science, fantasy, historical, mystery, speculative) in text about literary genres. Members detect fiction/fantasy/mystery tokens and narrative words.
result.label: ' fiction' after genre words

result.description: Fires on the last piece of machine-learning technical terms, mostly ' Forest' after "Random", and also 'ression' and suffixes like 'ization' or 'ging' (regularization, bagging). It needs a machine-learning or statistics context.
result.label: Random Forest / ML term endings

result.description: Fires on " towards" (and " toward"), mostly after nouns or verbs of movement or direction such as "move towards" or "march towards". Predicts goal-like continuations such as "achieve". Members are mostly detectors of the same token.
result.label: towards / toward directional preposition

result.description: Fires on "Health" and "care" in "Healthcare" at the start of a document or heading-like topic lists (e.g. "Healthcare Policy/Access/Quality"). Weakly on other title-case list words. Silent on non-health headings like trade or economics lists.
result.label: Healthcare heading term

result.description: Fires on ' allowing' (also ' enables', ' allow') after a comma introducing a result clause, and on the 'its' in 'permits'. Members include allow-word detectors and 'permits' detectors, so it is a permit/allow meaning family.
result.label: allowing / permits (its) enabling words

result.description: Fires on file-system and database-related nouns such as " directories", " metadata", " File", and " JOIN" in technical computing text about file systems and data storage. It is silent in general operating-system prose.
result.label: File system and data storage nouns

result.description: Fires on the piece 'are' when it completes the word "welfare" (also in "Pareto"), in economics text. Weak firing on 'are' before ' further'. Members mostly detect 'are' tokens.
result.label: 'are' ending "welfare"

result.description: Fires on ' yet' (also ' even', ' as', 'ly') when it appears as an item in a list of conjunctions or coordinated items ("for, and, nor, but, or, yet"). It stays silent on 'yet' used as an adjective-linking or sentence-initial word.
result.label: ' yet' as listed conjunction item

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a surname (Ber-, Bo-, Ram-, Schw-) split into word pieces, mostly in lists of scientists or philosophers. It predicts name continuations such as -keley, -yer, -enberg.
result.label: Surname-initial pieces Ber/Bo/Ram

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing the word "saturation" (water saturation, color saturation). It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like propagation, gradation, scintillation, pigmentation. Weak on 'ity' and 'ence' endings.
result.label: 'ation' in "saturation"

result.description: Fires on the word " more" (also "More") used as a comparative marker, e.g. "more than", "more and more", "more accurately". Members are mostly detectors of "more" and similar comparatives (closer, smaller). Predicts " than" and adjectives.
result.label: Comparative "more"

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' ante' (in antecedent) and ' es' (espresso, esophagus) that begin a longer word split into pieces; the next piece completes the word. Weaker on prec-, Techn-.
result.label: Word-start fragment 'ante'/'es'

result.description: Fires on a few specific word pieces: " equality", " consist" (consistency/consisting), " firm", " eg". Seems to be a small set of separate tokens, mostly in abstract or academic text. Weak evidence for any further condition.
result.label: equality / consist / firm tokens

result.description: Fires on the token 'y' when it is a word-ending piece, as in "-logy" or "-ology" ("of language", "of science", "psychoanalysis"). It stays silent when 'y' starts a new word, such as "ylistic", or ends words like "empathy" or "mastery".
result.label: 'y' as suffix piece after 'olog'

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ical' completing "empirical", where the preceding "empir" piece is needed. It stays silent on 'ical' in other words such as "philosophical". It predicts nouns like evidence, observations and validation.
result.label: 'ical' in "empirical"

result.description: Fires on the token " tap", both in tap dance and in taproot botany. Members mostly detect "tap" itself or related word pieces. The contrast is unrelated text, so no extra condition is clear.
result.label: ' tap' token detector

result.description: Fires on the 'h' token inside the word "aesthetic" (aest|h|etic), also weakly on 'est' in "aest". Members are mostly 'h'-after-"aest" detectors. Silent in text lacking this word.
result.label: 'h' in "aesthetic"

result.description: Fires on 'logic' and related pieces ('Log-ic', 'logical' followed by reasoning/programming/connectives) in text about formal logic and logical systems. Members are detectors of logic/logical tokens; silent on generic abstract algebra text.
result.label: Logic term in formal logic

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ent' in "inherent" (after "inher"), where the next word is a noun like difficulties, limitations or properties. Silent on 'ent' in other words such as "eccentric".
result.label: 'ent' in "inherent"

result.description: Fires on a word piece (mostly 'atur', also 'yl', 'igh', 'ine', 'way') that directly follows a word-initial 's' fragment, i.e. the second piece of s-words like saturation, syllogisms, sigh, sway. Mostly in the middle of a split word.
result.label: Second piece after split 's' (atur, yl)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'rac' in "Terracotta", also 'k', 'aj', 'oph', where the piece is part of a longer word being spelled out. Silent on 'rac' in "embracing". Peak is mostly the 'rac' piece after "Ter".
result.label: 'rac' piece in Terracotta

result.description: Fires on the word " receiver" in communication-model text (sender and receiver, message transmission, feedback). Members include detectors for " sender", " message" and " feedback". The contrast was a different topic.
result.label: ' receiver' in communication models

result.description: Fires on the 'ard'/'ards' piece completing "hazard(s)" or "hazardous", mostly in safety and chemical-risk text. It stays silent on 'ard' when it starts a document with no preceding "haz" piece.
result.label: 'ard' in hazard(s)

result.description: Fires on the token " real" (also "Real") as a word or prefix, mostly in "real-time", "real-world", "realism" and "real eigenvalues". It is silent when " real" opens the text, so it needs a preceding context word.
result.label: ' real' token detector

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces ' coal' (mostly), ' susp' (suspension/suspense) and ' cer' (ceramic), typically after "of" or a verb, in science/materials text. Members are mostly detectors of coal, susp and similar word-start tokens.
result.label: coal / susp / cer word starts

result.description: Fires on the "action" piece completing "dissatisfaction" (dis-satisf-action). Silent on "action" as a standalone word, such as in "call-to-action". Weaker on "satisfaction" in phrases like "employee satisfaction".
result.label: -action in dissatisfaction

result.description: Fires on ' War' right after "World" (World War I/II) and other named wars like Boer or Korean. It stays silent on ' War' in "Cold War" or at the start of a text.
result.label: ' War' in World War

result.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that is split into several tokens, such as Fr(ida), Fr(ideric), Mat(rices), André, Support (Vector), where the next piece completes a name or term. Mostly names and technical terms.
result.label: Word-initial fragments: Fr, Mat, André

result.description: Fires on word-start pieces like ' diag' (diagrams) and ' Num' (Numbers) in math/technical text, where the word continues into a suffix such as 'rams' or 'bers'. Also fires weakly on ' k' in formulas.
result.label: Incomplete word starts: diag-, Num-

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mostly ' sur' (surge, surpass), also ' facil', ' thr', ' es'. It needs the piece to be an incomplete word start. It predicts continuation pieces.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (sur-, facil-)

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'val' inside "prevalence" (pre|val|ence), after the 'pre' prefix, predicting 'ence'. It stays silent when 'val' starts the word or text without a preceding 'pre'.
result.label: 'val' in pre-val-ence

result.description: Fires on the word " understanding" itself, most strongly as a noun after modifiers like mutual, contextual, intercultural, deeper or current. Many members are detectors of the same token. Weaker on "comprehension".
result.label: ' understanding' token detector

result.description: Fires on ' and' joining two coordinated nouns or adjectives (x and y, negative and positive, Music and Technology), especially in technical or title-like pairs. Silent on 'and' in other uses such as 'not only ... and'. Nudges toward words like 'thus' and 'hence'.
result.label: ' and' joining paired nouns

result.description: Fires on the verb " ensure" (also "ures" in "ensures"), mostly after "to" or "must" and before a "that" clause. Silent when it opens the text at document start.
result.label: verb "ensure" mid-sentence

result.description: Fires on transitive verbs of improving or reducing (improve, reduce, support, adjust, build up) that take an upcoming object like a quality or harm, mostly in health, training or practical-advice text. Next-token logits are mixed.
result.label: Improve/reduce-type change verbs

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces completing particular words: 'ra' in ult-ra / spect-ra, 'uses' in cla-uses, 'land' in g-land. Peaks are different tokens that each need a specific preceding word piece.
result.label: Word-final pieces: ultra, clauses, gland

result.description: Fires mainly on " along" after a noun, in the sense of moving or varying along a curve, path or line, mostly in mathematical text. It also fires weakly on a few odd pieces such as "icon" in "semiconductor".
result.label: " along" in path/curve phrases

result.description: Fires on word pieces inside physiology/psychology-type scientific words, such as the 'i' in "physiology", 'ological' in "physiological", and 'olog' in "psychologists". It stays silent on 'ological' in other words like "technological" and "epistemological".
result.label: phys-/psych- word-internal pieces

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "ates" completing "carbohydrates" in nutrition text. It is weaker on similar endings like "ated" in "contaminated" or "saturated". Members detect the "carbohydr" pieces and nutrition context.
result.label: carbohydr-ates suffix in nutrition

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ated' (or 'ate') when it completes the word "dominated"/"dominate", after the stem "domin". Silent on 'ated' in other words like incorporated or assimilated. Weakly fires on 'aber-r'.
result.label: 'ated' in "dominated"

result.description: Fires on the word " project" when it modifies a following noun, as in "project managers", "project tracking" or "project plan". Occasionally fires on "aster" in "disaster". Members are mostly detectors of " project".
result.label: " project" as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces like 'ades', 'ading', 'ues' after 'sh'/'h' in visual-art text about shading, hatching, shades and hues. Members include art/color detectors and 'ades' detectors.
result.label: Shades/hues suffix in art text

result.description: Fires on word pieces that are often followed by suffixes like -ly, -ness (' firm', ' liquid', 'ight', 'ens', 'heav'), mostly as the stem of a longer word. Logits favor suffixes such as 'ly' and 'ness'. Evidence is mixed, as ' firm' also appears as a noun.
result.label: Stem tokens before suffixes (firm, liquid)

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " your" when it follows a verb or preposition and is followed by a noun the reader owns (confidence, followers, section). Also weakly on " sessions" and " detailed". Silent on text without second-person address.
result.label: Second-person " your" after a verb

result.description: Fires on ' graph' and on the word piece after it ('ing', ' patterns', ' types', ' theory') in text about graph theory and data structures. It stays silent on 'ing' after other stems like stretch, transform or design.
result.label: graph + following word piece

result.description: Fires on the capital letter 'B' as a standalone token, e.g. in "Role-Based", RBAC, P(A|B), dB, GRB. It is mostly a letter detector, with the strongest peaks inside acronyms and formulas.
result.label: Capital letter B token

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " pre"/" Pre" when it begins "prepositions" (also "prepositional"), especially in grammar text. It stays silent on "pre" in "preconditions".
result.label: pre- in "prepositions"

result.description: Fires on the uppercase token 'AT' appearing inside acronyms, all-caps words and names (NAT, SATUR, BATNA, MATLAB, ATP). The circuit is mostly detectors of 'AT' pieces at earlier layers.
result.label: Uppercase 'AT' token piece

result.description: Fires on the token " operations" (business, process or mathematical operations) in all examples. Members are mostly detectors of " operations" in earlier layers. The contrast has no instance of the token, so no extra condition is evident.
result.label: ' operations' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' exer' (of "exercises"), and weakly on similar fragments like ' dol' (dolphin) and 'era'. It needs the token to be an incomplete word piece, mostly in educational or practice contexts.
result.label: ' exer' fragment of "exercises"

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ow' inside "vowel(s)" (after "v"), and less on 'le' in "Role". Silent when "ow" begins a document-initial "owels" without the preceding "v".
result.label: 'ow' in vowel

result.description: Fires on the token " instruction" (also "instructions", "instructional") in both education contexts (differentiated instruction) and computing contexts (CPU instruction). Members are detectors of instruction plus teaching and CPU topic words.
result.label: ' instruction' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " temperature" (and the "atures" piece of "temperatures"), mostly in physics and thermodynamics text. Members detect temperature, thermal and heat words. It predicts threshold and change words next.
result.label: temperature word detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " top" when it begins "topology/topologies/topographic", as in network or hybrid topologies. It stays quiet on other text, including a math passage about covering spaces. Weak on "top-down".
result.label: top- in topology words

result.description: Fires on past-participle verbs (founded, created, launched, held, presented) right after a comma, opening a reduced participial clause that is followed by "in <year>" or "by". It is silent on "was founded" in passive constructions.
result.label: Participle after comma (founded, created)

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces ('n', 'ler', 'on', 'sel') inside surname-like names of scientists and philosophers (Leibniz, Doppler, Huygens, Fibonacci), where a word continues. It stays silent on similar pieces in other names.
result.label: Mid-word pieces of scientist surnames

result.description: Fires on word pieces opening linguistics terms, such as ' lex' in lexical/lexicon and 'em'/'phon' in phonemic/phoneme, in text about language and linguistics. It predicts completions like 'eme', 'icon' and 'ix'.
result.label: Linguistics word pieces lex/phon-

result.description: Fires mostly on " fan" as a modifier before a noun (fan communities, fan clubs, fan interest), and on a few word-start pieces like "ried", "hard", "hon" that begin compounds. Logits favor suffix continuations such as "ness" and "back".
result.label: " fan" as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on ' it' as the subject right after the contrastive conjunction "but" (", but it's..."). It stays silent on ' it' after semicolons, "while", or as an object.
result.label: ' it' right after "but"

result.description: Fires on abstract technical nouns such as "phase", "entities", "entity" and "relationships" in scientific or mathematical text, often as the head of a technical term. Peaks are mixed, and the members mostly give math and science context.
result.label: Technical abstract nouns (phase, entity)

result.description: Fires on the word piece "atin" completing "chromatin" (after "chrom"), in molecular biology text. Members detect the "chrom" prefix, "atin" itself, and DNA/histone context.
result.label: "atin" in chromatin

result.description: Fires on "taking" (also "adopt", "Integr", "taken") when used as a verb of taking or adopting, as in "taking into account" or "taking charge". Members are mostly detectors of take/taking forms.
result.label: "taking" and adopt verbs

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ard' when it is a suffix inside a longer word or name (Lennard, Maynard, Leopard, Barnard, hazard). Weaker on 'jeopardizing'. Members are mostly 'ard' token detectors.
result.label: 'ard' word-piece suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' acknowled' (start of acknowledge/acknowledging/acknowledgment), mostly mid-word before a suffix like -ging or -gment. Members are mostly detectors of this token and related pieces like 'acknow' and 'recogn'.
result.label: ' acknowled' word piece

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments that begin a longer word, mostly ' ach' (before "ieving"), also ' une' (unease), ' inten' (intense), ' comprom' (compromise). Appears in negotiation and balance-themed text.
result.label: Word-start fragments: ach(ieving), comprom(ise)

result.description: Fires on the word " scientific" (and the " Scient" piece of "Scientific"), strongest in "Scientific Revolution" and "scientific method" contexts. Members are mostly detectors of " scientific" and science-related tokens.
result.label: " scientific" word detector

result.description: Fires on the word "history"/"History" as a noun naming the subject or past of something, especially in "the history of X" and titles. Silent in a verb-object use like "views history as a series".
result.label: noun "history" in "the history of"

result.description: Fires on the word-piece " sub" (or " Sub") used as a prefix at the start of a compound, as in subduction, subsurface, subatomic, subtree, subproblems. It predicts the continuation of the word.
result.label: ' sub' prefix token

result.description: Fires on varied function and content words (of, the, -ments, geometric) in text about prehistoric or ancient human origins, early tools, art and civilizations. Logits favour primitive/ancient-themed continuations (proto, foss, rud, gods, Pale).
result.label: Prehistoric and ancient-origins context

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ction' completing "reprodu-ction", mostly in biology text about sexual or asexual reproduction. Members detect 'ction' after "reprodu" plus biology word pieces such as speciation.
result.label: 'ction' in reproduction

result.description: Fires on the suffix or ending token (-s, -ed, -ing, or following 'to') right after the verb stem "respond". It anticipates "to", "responses", or "quickly". It stays silent on -ing after other verb stems.
result.label: Inflection after 'respond'

result.description: Fires on the verb ending "-s" in "pertain(s)" and on "refer/refers", i.e. verbs meaning "relates to", in definitional academic text, where "to" follows next. Silent on plural or verb "s" in other words.
result.label: pertains/refers "to" verbs

result.description: Fires on word pieces 'arr' in "Narrative/narration" and 'cial' in "facial/glacial", mid-word fragments. Weaker on 'rom-' of romance. Members are detectors of these specific pieces.
result.label: Word pieces 'arr' and 'cial'

result.description: Fires on the token " expert" (including as the start of "expertise" and in "expert system"), wherever it appears. Upstream members are mostly " expert" detectors. Next-token logits are mixed and unclear.
result.label: ' expert' token detector

result.description: Fires on a space or hyphen token right before a year or century number (e.g. "late[ ]15th", "mid[-]19"), in art, music and Renaissance-history text. It stays silent on some similar year-preceding spaces, so the extra requirement is unclear.
result.label: Space/hyphen before century or year

result.description: Fires on the word " nature" (also "Nature") in all its uses, whether the natural world or the essence of something. Most members are detectors of the same token in earlier layers. The contrast text has no such token.
result.label: ' nature' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece "itional" in "Conditional" (e.g. Zero Cond|itional) and on " conditional", mostly in grammar text about conditional sentences. It is weaker on "Conditions" and "conditionals".
result.label: Conditional (grammar term) word
Suffix completing "continuity"
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece (-ity, -ation, -um) that completes the word "continu-" (continuity, continuation, continuum). It stays silent on 'ity' in other words such as proximity or diversity.

Fires mainly on "chain" completing "Blockchain" (as in "Blockchain Technology"), with weaker firing on " basis" in math or reasoning contexts. Pushes toward words like "transactions". Upstream members detect blockchain/crypto "chain" tokens.
result.label: Blockchain 'chain' token

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' mix' when it starts a longer word (mixologist, mixers, mixology), and weakly on related pieces like 'cock-' in cocktail or 'bl-' in blend. It is silent on ordinary dough or baking text.
result.label: ' mix' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the noun right after "smart" (grid, home(s), gr-ids), as in "smart grid" or "smart home". It stays silent on "grid" after "electrical" or "in". Predicts words like smart, Things, and grid.
result.label: noun after "smart" (grid, home)

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ation' completing the word "appreciation" (appreci|ation), as in "appreciation for/of". It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like reconciliation, incorporation, revelation, orchestration.
result.label: 'ation' in "appreciation"
'it' in facil-it-ate
result.description: Fires on the piece 'it' inside "facilitate/facilitating/facilitator", and weakly on 'yst' in "catalyst". Stays silent on 'it' in other words like conduit, geopolitical, competitiveness.

Fires on the suffix 'ation' when it completes the word "innovation" (Innov+ation), especially in business headings. It stays silent on 'ation' in other words like penetration, integration, hibernation.
result.label: 'ation' in "innovation"

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece " persu" (persuasion, persuasive, persuade), mostly in rhetoric and writing text. It predicts continuations like "asion" or "asive". Weak firing on other split word starts like "util" and "resol".
result.label: ' persu' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start fragment ' ar' when it begins a longer word split into pieces, such as arrows, arteries, arteriole, arousal, arbitrage. It is a token detector for ' ar' as a prefix.
result.label: ' ar' word-initial fragment
vegetarian/vegan suffix 'arian'
result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'arian' (occasionally 'an') completing the word "vegetarian" (or "vegan"), mostly in food and cooking text. It is driven by detectors of the 'veget' word-start and 'arian' pieces.
Fires on the 'a' piece inside the split word "Versailles" (Treaty of Vers-a-illes), predicting the continuation 'illes'. Stays silent on standalone 'a' or 'a' in other words like "entailed".
result.label: 'a' in Versailles

result.description: Fires on word-final pieces 'er' (in las-er, Polym-er) and 'ray' (X-ray), plus ' hands', in physics/materials technical text. Silent on 'er' in unrelated words like 'foster'.
result.label: laser / X-ray word endings

result.description: Fires on " since" meaning "from then until now", after a present-perfect or ongoing predicate (has been fundamental since, has since underpinned). Silent in a similar sentence that uses a different time phrasing without "since".
result.label: temporal ' since' after perfect

result.description: Fires on the verbs " exceed" (including exceeding/exceeded) and " contradict", words about going beyond or conflicting with a limit or claim. Weaker on "doubt" and "beyond". Members detect exceed, conflic-, reject and similar pieces.
result.label: exceed / contradict verbs

result.description: Fires on the 'ics' ending of "demographics" (also 'ographic' in "demographic"), in marketing and audience-analysis text. It stays silent on 'ics' in other words such as analytics, tactics and aesthetics.
result.label: 'ics' in "demographics"
Hyphen after "X-to" construction
result.description: Fires on the hyphen in "X-to-Y" patterns, especially the second hyphen after "to" (one-to-one, Many-to-many, Adenosine-to-Inosine). Stays silent on hyphens in compounds such as real-world, high-level, pre-emptively and all-out.

Fires on the verb " allows" (occasionally " enable") when it is followed by an agent such as writers or authors ("allows writers to…"). It is silent on some " allows" tokens, mostly ones right after a noun or after a sentence break. Members are mostly generic.
result.label: ' allows' verb before beneficiary

result.description: Fires on the agent-noun plural suffix 'ers'/'ces' ending a person-category word (learners, listeners, producers), sometimes 'students'/'users'. Silent on some 'ers' cases like speakers, teachers, and 'immers' in lowercase.
result.label: Plural person-noun suffix 'ers'

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ient' in "experiential" (exper|ient|ial), predicting the suffix 'ial'/'ally'. It is weakly active on 'ts' in "experts". Members detect 'ient' and the preceding 'exper' piece.
result.label: 'ient' in exper-ient-ial

result.description: Fires on the word "system"/"systems" (any case or plural), in computing and engineering text such as file systems, system calls, power systems, and operating systems. Weakly pushes toward words like security and administration. Silent on unrelated middleware text.
result.label: "system" word detector

result.description: Fires on ' tower' (also ' jump', ' swing') mostly when the same word was just repeated or appears in a repeated "tower tower" pattern. Predicts word-continuation suffixes like 'ing' and 'away'. Evidence is mixed, with a few weak odd peaks.
result.label: Repeated 'tower' / 'jump' token

result.description: Fires on the word " requirements" in systems and software engineering text, such as functional, interface or performance requirements. Members are mostly detectors of "requirements" and related tokens like needs and specification.
result.label: " requirements" in system engineering
'ism' piece in "seismic" words
result.description: Fires on the piece 'ism' inside "seism-" words (seismic, seismology, seismotectonic) in earthquake and tectonics text. It fires more weakly on 'ism' in other words like organism, and on other suffixes.

Fires on the word piece 'orth' inside words such as North, noteworthy and Wordsworth. Upstream members detect 'orth'/'worth' pieces and other word-fragment tokens. The next-token logits favour suffixes such as 'odox' and 'y'.
result.label: 'orth' word piece

result.description: Fires on the token ' Europe' itself, mostly after prepositions like "in" or "throughout" in historical or geographic text. Members are Europe/European detectors plus other place-name detectors (America, Portugal, Indonesia).
result.label: ' Europe' token detector

result.description: Fires on " preferred" (occasionally "option" or "recommended") when describing a favored choice, as in "the new preferred option" or "often preferred over". Members detect prefer/preferences and choice/selection words.
result.label: "preferred" as favored choice

result.description: Fires on the word " Japanese" (mostly as a modifier before nouns like writing, literature, form), in text about languages and scripts. Members are detectors of Japan/Japanese and other nationality or language words.
result.label: Japanese as modifier word

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ro' (occasionally 'ra'/'rom') in "spectroscopy" after "spect", in spectroscopy/spectrometry text. It stays silent on 'ro' in other words like astrophysics or synchrotron.
result.label: 'ro' inside spectroscopy

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments, mostly 'ur' in "heuristics" (he-ur-istic), also 'alleng' in "Challenges" and 'bit'. It needs the piece to sit inside the word after a preceding fragment; word-initial 'ur' stays silent.
result.label: 'ur' in heuristics; word-piece fragments

result.description: Fires on the word piece "spect" (or "Spect") when it begins "spectra", "spectroscopy" or "spectroscopic", mostly in physics and chemistry text. It predicts continuations such as "ro" and "rics".
result.label: spect- start of spectroscopy words

result.description: Fires on a transitive verb (shape, fosters, facilitate, introduce, encourages) that begins a new item in a comma-separated list of verb phrases describing effects or functions. Silent on 'ers' in 'consumers' and on some 'fosters'.
result.label: Verb starting item in effects list

result.description: Fires mainly on the first name " George" (also "Herbert" in "George Herbert Mead") in lists of famous scholars and thinkers. It stays silent on other names in such lists. Members detect George and other given names.
result.label: George in lists of thinkers
