result.description: Fires on the word piece ' bar' when it starts a split word like 'barriers' or 'barrier' (e.g. 'physical bar|riers'). It is silent when ' bar' begins the text, and it pushes toward 'rier' / 'riers'.
result.label: ' bar' as start of 'barriers'

result.description: Fires on plural nouns like " levels" (also " degrees", " kinds", " types") right after "various/varying/different", marking a graded or varied set. Silent on "levels" after a specific noun like "emotion levels".
result.label: levels/degrees after varying/different

result.description: Fires mostly on the word piece "tere" in "stereo" (stereo, stereoisomers, stereochemistry). It also fires weakly on hyphens and a few mid-word pieces. Most members are detectors of "tere" at early layers.
result.label: "tere" in stereo- words

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' tri' when it begins a longer word such as triangle, triangular, triangulation, or trials, mostly in math text. It predicts word continuations such as 'als' and 'ang'.
result.label: ' tri' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on predicate adjectives meaning "important" — "cru|cial", " essential", "indispens|able" — after "is/are" in technical or scientific text ("X is crucial/essential for..."). Silent on the same pieces in unrelated, non-evaluative contexts.
result.label: crucial/essential predicate adjective

result.description: Fires on the word piece " Rob" at the start of robot/robotics words, such as "Robot Programming" or "in Robotics". It predicts continuations like "ot" and "ots". Weakly fires on lowercase " rob" in "robots".
result.label: Rob- start of robot words

result.description: Fires on 'foundation' and 'foundational' (found+ational), and weakly 'groundwork', mostly in the figurative "laid the foundation for" sense in scientific or academic text. It is silent on unrelated text.
result.label: foundation / foundational in "laid the foundation"

result.description: Fires mainly on the word " responsibility" (also "-ity" in "intentionality" and similar abstract-noun endings) in abstract philosophical or ethical prose. Members are mostly detectors of the token " responsibility". It is silent on related words like "accountability".
result.label: Abstract noun 'responsibility'

result.description: Fires mainly on " amid" (also "amidst"), and sometimes " overcome" or similar words, in academic-style prose where it introduces a surrounding condition or challenge. Members detect amid/midst, facing/faced, and without/under.
result.label: "amid" / "overcome" in abstract prose

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece 'ic' in "strategic" (after Strateg/strateg), with weak firing on 'ential' in "sequential". Silent on 'ic' in chronic, microeconomic, ergonomic and catastrophic.
result.label: 'ic' ending of "strategic"

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sub' used as a prefix split off from the following word (subtree, subproblems, subglacial, subatomic), predicting a continuation of the compound. Members are mostly ' sub' token detectors.
result.label: ' sub' prefix before compound

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ap' inside the word "metaphor" (met-ap-hor, metaphoric, metaphorical). Weaker in other words with 'ap' plus 'hor' (semaphores, paraphrasing). Silent when 'ap' starts a text without the 'met' before it.
result.label: 'ap' inside "metaphor"

result.description: Fires on the word-ending piece 'ary' in "Hungary" (also 'ic' in "Slavic"), in European history and geopolitics text. It stays silent on 'ary' in other words like parliamentary, revolutionary, vocabulary and wary.
result.label: Hungary / Slavic suffix piece

result.description: Fires on ' with' as a preposition following a verb or adjective that takes it as a complement (communicate with, resonates with, enhanced with, evolve with). Stays silent on sentence-initial or contrastive 'with' after conjunctions like 'and' or 'but'.
result.label: ' with' after verb/adjective complement

result.description: Fires on 'ving' in "carving" (also ' sculpt', 'ved') in art and craft text about carving and sculpting techniques. Silent on 'ving' in other words like "evolving" or "engraving".
result.label: carving in sculpture/craft text

result.description: Fires on ' the' directly after "laid/laying/set/lay" in the idiom "laid the groundwork/foundation" (also "set the stage"). Silent on ' the' after other prepositions or verbs. Predicts words like ground, foundation.
result.label: 'the' after laid (groundwork idiom)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments of split words (' grat' in gratings, ' bla' in blade, ' sie' in sieve) where the word continues with a suffix. Predicts continuation pieces like 'ble', 'itude'. Silent on whole word 'Gratification'.
result.label: Incomplete word-start fragments (grat, bla, sie)

result.description: Fires on the word ' sales' used as a modifier before another noun (sales staff, sales strategy, sales objectives), in business and marketing text. Members mostly detect ' sales' itself, plus marketing words like campaign, brand and customers.
result.label: ' sales' as noun modifier

result.description: Fires on the token ' press' / ' Press' (printing presses, also the start of 'pressure'), especially in printmaking text. It predicts suffix continuations like 'es', 'ures', 'ure'. Weaker on other word pieces like 'bomb'.
result.label: ' press' word piece (printing press)

result.description: Fires on the 'manage' stem: 'aging' in "managing", ' manage', ' managed', and 'manage' in "manageable". It stays silent on 'aging' in other words such as "engaging" and "disengaging". Predicts 'able' or 'aging' continuations.
result.label: manage / managing word stem

result.description: Fires on the standalone token ' K' (also ' k'), such as the Five Ks list (Kesh, Kara, Kanga), variable k in formulas, and K starting a name like Kho. It is a detector of the letter K as its own token, with members mostly K detectors.
result.label: Standalone ' K' token detector

result.description: Fires on the verbs "losing"/"lose" and "gain" (gaining, gain) when they name a loss or gain of something, such as electrons, money or tradition. Predicts continuations about quantities, like more, money or pay.
result.label: lose/gain verbs

result.description: Fires on " of" right after a quantity word like "much", "most", "some" or "half" (partitive "much of the…"). It stays silent on " of" after ordinary nouns such as "consequences of" or "world of", and after "one of".
result.label: partitive "of" after much/most/some

result.description: Fires on the word-start pieces " Quant" (before "um") and " Cal" (before "oric"), plus " cal" in "calibrating", mostly at the start of a title or document. Members are mainly " Quant" detectors.
result.label: Quant/Cal word-start fragments

result.description: Fires on word pieces of weaving/knitting words (w-'oven', we-'aving', kn-'itted', 'aved') in textile contexts, predicting 'together', 'threads', 'pieces'. Silent on unrelated text; Beethoven's 'oven' is handled by other members.
result.label: Weave/woven word-piece in textiles

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ry' in the name "Aryabhata" / "Aryabhatiya", right after the capital "A" at the start of the word. It stays silent when 'ry' begins the token sequence without the preceding "A".
result.label: 'ry' in Aryabhata

result.description: Fires on pieces of "aesthetics" (aest-het-ics, Aesth-etic) and on the word "beauty" in philosophy-of-art text. Members detect the 'het'/'etic' pieces plus art and philosophy context. It is weaker on 'rhet' in "rhetorical".
result.label: aesthetics word pieces and beauty

result.description: Fires on the 'bs' piece completing "verbs" in grammar text about verbs. It stays silent on 'bs' in "adverbs", so it needs the word "verbs" specifically, not just any 'bs' ending.
result.label: 'bs' in "verbs"

result.description: Fires on commas inside a list of parallel adjectives or nouns, especially lists of desirable qualities (efficient, sustainable, reliable, ...), where another list item is expected next. Silent on commas in ordinary clauses or phrases.
result.label: Comma in adjective/quality lists

result.description: Fires on mid-word pieces, mostly 'oid' in steroid/solenoid/toroid, also 'pect' in the heading "Respect for" and 'ol' in cortisol. Members are detectors of 'oid' and 'ster'. Weaker firing occurs on pieces like 'ad' and 'orm'.
result.label: 'oid' word-piece (steroid, solenoid)

result.description: Fires on nouns meaning causal effect, mainly " impact", also " influence" and " effects", typically after "significant" or "profound" in scientific text, where "on" usually follows. Members detect impact/influence/affect words plus environmental and science context.
result.label: impact/influence noun in science text

result.description: Fires on the word "festival" (Festival, festival, festiv-) as a noun for an event, strongest in "Music Festival" headings. Members are festival, event and concert detectors. Weaker on related event words like "concert".
result.label: festival word detector

result.description: Fires on the word "Power"/"power" itself, strongest on capitalized "Power" starting a line or title (e.g. "Power System Protection"), and more weakly on lowercase "power" in compounds like solar power or power series.
result.label: Token "Power"/"power"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " macro" as a prefix before a continuation like -state, -scopic or -economic, especially in statistical-mechanics text. Supported by members detecting macro/micro tokens and -scopic pieces.
result.label: ' macro' prefix token

result.description: Fires on digit tokens (mostly '0', also '1', '9') and spaces before numbers, in numeric strings like years, large numbers and section numbers. It stays silent on '0' in decade/year forms like '60s or 199 0-19.
result.label: Digit zero in numbers

result.description: Fires on the token right after the conjunction "as" when it starts a clause (as it, as they, as we, as it can, as evidenced), i.e. the subject slot of an "as"-clause. Silent on " it" in other positions, such as object of a verb.
result.label: Subject word after clause-initial "as"
'end' piece inside longer words
result.description: Fires on the token 'end' when it is a word piece inside a longer word (comprehend, contend, dendrite, Amendment, expenditure). It stays silent on 'end' in 'blend'. Members are mostly 'end' detectors.

Fires mainly on " easy" in comparisons and "easy to" phrases like "as easy as", with weaker hits on painting words such as "stroke" and "brushes". Members are detectors of easy, easier, hard and difficult.
result.label: "easy" in "as easy as"

result.description: Fires on the word piece " compet" at the start of competitor, competitive or competencies, mostly in business text. It predicts continuations like "itive" or "ence". Members are mostly " compet" detectors from earlier layers.
result.label: ' compet' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the word-start piece ' cer' when it begins "ceramic(s)", in materials-science text. Weaker on other word-initial fragments like 'imper' in "imperative". Members include cer detectors and material-word detectors.
result.label: ' cer' start of ceramic

result.description: Fires on the suffix pieces 'itted'/'itting' after 'transm' (transmitted, transmitting), and weakly on other word-ending pieces in telecom words. Predicts transmission-related continuations such as transm, transmission, voltage.
result.label: transm-itted suffix piece

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' (occasionally 'ed') when it completes the word "borrow" (borrowing, borrowed). Other '-ing' endings, like underscoring or highlighting, stay silent. Promotes tokens such as ' from', ' borrow' and ' loan'.
result.label: -ing suffix after "borrow"

result.description: Fires on the word 'eigenvalues' and the pieces 'value'/'values' ending eigenvalue-type words, in linear algebra and math text. Members detect eigen-, vector, and math-term tokens. Weak activation on 'flow' in 'gene flow'.
result.label: Eigenvalue word endings

result.description: Fires on the word " cannot", mostly after a plural or mass noun subject (light, energy, waves, students, markets) in a general statement of impossibility. Many members are detectors of " cannot" at earlier layers.
result.label: " cannot" after noun subject

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ah' inside words like dodecahedron, hexahedral and octahedron (also cheetah, Sufiyyah). Members are mostly 'ah' detectors. It is silent on ordinary text without this piece.
result.label: 'ah' in -hedron words

result.description: Fires on the word " text" (also " Text"/" texts") as a noun, mainly in text mining and NLP passages ("the text", "text preprocessing"). Upstream members are mostly detectors of the same token. Predicts continuations like "ual", "book", " analysis".
result.label: ' text' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'it' when it is a mid-word fragment, mainly in "Gravitational" (v|it|ational), and in other words like "ilitator" or "Antitrust". It stays silent when 'it' ends a word, as in "inhabit" or "fictitious".
result.label: 'it' fragment inside words

result.description: Fires on word-piece fragments after an initial "c" (mostly "ult" in c-ult-ural, also "if" in cruc-if-ix, "row" in c-row-d), mid-word within words beginning with "c". Weaker on "rop" in cash-crop.
result.label: "ult" piece in c-ult-ural

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' allo' at the start of "alloys" (metal alloys), before the "ys" piece. Silent on the complete word "alloying", so it needs the split-word form.
result.label: ' allo' piece of "alloys"

result.description: Fires on word pieces completing "ecology"-related words: "-ical" in "ecological" and "-ystem" in "ecosystem". It needs the preceding ecolog-/ecos- piece and ecological context; it predicts words like conservation or diversity.
result.label: ecolog-ical / ecos-ystem word endings

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' intr' when it begins a word like intricate, intriguing or intrinsic, mid-sentence after a word such as "an" or "their". It is silent when ' intr' opens the document.
result.label: ' intr' word-start (intricate/intriguing)

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments like 'sm' (cataclysmic, craftsmanship), 'al' in anomalies, and 'yp' in polyploidy. These are word pieces inside longer, multi-token words; the peaks are mostly 'sm'.
result.label: Mid-word fragments: sm, al, yp

result.description: Fires on the 'ing' suffix when it completes the word "striving" (also "thriving", "driving"), after the piece "striv"/"stri". Silent on 'ing' in other words like tempting, scaling, gaining.
result.label: 'ing' in striving

result.description: Fires on suffix pieces (-ated, -ating, -ization, -ation) completing "autom-" or "mechan-" words in industrial automation/mechanization text. Silent on -ated in unrelated words like "originated", "initiated", "sophisticated". Predicts "autom".
result.label: autom-/mechan- word suffixes

result.description: Fires on word-fragment tokens in the middle of a word or garbled text (e.g. 'ку', 'weak' in Electroweak, 'lower', 'hard'), where the word likely continues with a suffix like 'ness' or 'able'. Mixed peaks; evidence is thin.
result.label: Mid-word fragment before suffix

result.description: Fires on past participles like "established" and "defined" (also "predefined", "well-defined") used as modifiers before a noun such as standard, guidelines, roles or scope, mostly in process, standards and management text.
result.label: established / defined participle modifiers

result.description: Fires on word-ending pieces (s, ives, inal, en) completing grammar terms like nouns, adjectives, nomen/nomenclature, in text about linguistic grammar. Silent on plural 's' in parenthesized or non-grammar-term contexts.
result.label: Grammar term word endings

result.description: Fires on the apostrophe token right after a noun (e.g. "chef'", "diner'", "amine'") where a possessive 's or similar suffix is expected. It stays quiet on contraction apostrophes such as "what's" or a bare "'s" at the start of a text.
result.label: Possessive apostrophe after noun

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ing' completing "neighbor-ing" (neighboring countries/nations), with weaker firing on a few other suffixes like -istic. It stays silent on verb -ing endings such as adhering or preventing. Predicts nouns like countries.
result.label: 'neighboring' suffix before plural noun

result.description: Fires on the word "group"/"Group" (including plural and capitalized forms), both as a social group in communication text and as a mathematical group. Members are mostly group-token detectors from early layers.
result.label: Token "group" detector

result.description: Fires on the piece 'ic' inside the word "telemedicine" (Telemed|ic|ine). It stays silent on 'ic' in other words such as cosmetic, chronic, therapeutic and systemic.
result.label: 'ic' in telemedicine
'erg' in allergy/allergen
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'erg' inside 'allergies' and 'allergens' in food-safety text. Members detect 'erg' and the preceding 'all' piece. It is silent on other food-service text without this word.

Fires on ' was' and ' were' as the auxiliary/copula after a noun subject (e.g. "measures were", "jurors were"), predicting adverbs like originally, already, initially. Silent after the pronoun "This was".
result.label: was/were after noun subject

result.description: Fires on the token " contract" (contract, contracts, contractual), mostly in legal or economic text about contract law and agreements. Members are mainly " contract" token detectors in early layers.
result.label: ' contract' word detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix piece "lessly", almost always in "seamlessly" (seam + lessly), especially before a verb like integrate or merge. Members are detectors of "-lessly" and "seam-less" word pieces.
result.label: "lessly" in seamlessly

result.description: Fires on the word "universal" and its pieces (univers+ally, univers+als, universal), especially in linguistic or abstract text about universals. Members are detectors of universal/univers tokens and the suffixes 'als' and 'ally'.
result.label: universal / universally word pieces

result.description: Fires on ' enough' after an adjective or adverb (powerful enough, sufficiently far enough), and weakly on sufficiency words like ' sufficient' and ' minimum'. Members are mostly detectors of ' enough', ' sufficient' and ' necessary'.
result.label: "enough" sufficiency marker

result.description: Fires on the token ' hair' and on 'net' in 'hairnet', plus some hyphens in compounds like 'face-'. It fires on the first element or piece of a compound, and is silent on many other hyphens such as 'in-', 'socio-' and 'future-'.
result.label: hair / hairnet and compound hyphens
Mid-word fragments u/rop/ep (eruption)
result.description: Fires on word-internal pieces such as 'u' in "eruptions", 'rop' in "anthropic", and 'ep' in "steep", mostly early fragments of multi-token words. Strongest on "er-u-ption" in volcano text. Silent on ordinary whole-word text.

Fires on the token right after "user" (hyphen, experience, interface, feedback, profiles) in UX/design text. Silent on hyphens after other words like "real-", "high-", "well-". Members detect "user" and interface/experience words.
result.label: word after "user" in UX text

result.description: Fires mostly on ' Old' in mid-sentence language-name contexts (Old English, Old French, Old Norse) and on word pieces like 'ene'/'ut' in 'hermeneutic'. Silent on ' Old' at the very start of a document.
result.label: ' Old' in Old-language names, hermeneutic pieces

result.description: Fires mostly on the digit '3' (also 5, 6, and symbols like 's', 'x', 'b') inside technical notation such as isotope numbers, chemical or math expressions, and digit strings. It stays quiet on '3' in years like "1830s".
result.label: Digit 3 in technical notation
